name: ASCIIText
description: Waving ASCII text that tilts toward the pointer, scrambles on hover and ripples on click.

props.name: text
props.description: Text rendered in ASCII.

props.name: ascii_font_size
props.description: Height of each character cell in pixels. Smaller cells give finer detail.

props.name: charset
props.description: Characters from darkest to brightest. Any string works, including Unicode blocks.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font for the text and the characters.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the rendered text.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the text behind the characters.

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient for the characters, from the center outward. Up to three colors.

props.name: text_scale
props.description: Size of the text relative to the container.

props.name: blocks
props.description: Opacity of the colored pixel blocks under the characters, from 0 to 1.

props.name: waves
props.description: Strength of the wavy motion. 0 keeps the text flat.

props.name: wave_speed
props.description: Speed of the wavy motion.

props.name: chroma
props.description: Amount of color fringing around the letters.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the text turns toward the pointer.

props.name: hue_shift
props.description: Rotates the hue as the pointer circles the text. 0 keeps the colors fixed.

props.name: scramble
props.description: Size and strength of the glitchy scramble under the pointer, from 0 to 1.

props.name: click_ripple
props.description: Sends a ring of characters across the canvas from where you click.

props.name: intro
props.description: Decodes the text out of random characters on load.

props.name: idle
props.description: Sways the text gently when nobody interacts.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Reacts to the pointer with tilt, hue, scramble and ripples.

props.name: theme
props.description: Light inverts the colors so the effect works on white pages.

name: BlurText
description: Text starts blurred then crisply resolves for a soft-focus reveal effect.

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to animate.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay between animations for each word/letter (in ms).

props.name: animate_by
props.description: Whether each word or each letter comes into focus on its own.

props.name: direction
props.description: Side the words or letters move in from. Drift always glides sideways, from the right only when set to right.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Intersection threshold for triggering the animation.

props.name: root_margin
props.description: Root margin for the intersection observer.

props.name: animation_from
props.description: Custom starting keyframe. Replaces the effect, blur, distance and direction settings.

props.name: animation_to
props.description: Custom keyframes to animate through after animationFrom.

props.name: easing
props.description: Motion easing applied to every step. Each effect uses its own tuned curves when this is left out.

props.name: on_animation_complete
props.description: Called each time the text finishes coming in.

props.name: step_duration
props.description: The time taken for each step of the animation (in seconds).

props.name: blur
props.description: How blurred each word or letter starts, in px.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far each word or letter travels into place, in px. 0 keeps them still so they only come into focus.

props.name: effect
props.description: How each piece comes in. Blur slides in from a side, zoom shrinks down from large, tilt swings in on a slight 3D angle, focus sharpens in place like a camera focus pull and drift glides in sideways with a lean that relaxes.

props.name: stagger_from
props.description: Where the stagger starts: the first piece, the middle, the last piece or a shuffled order.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the text comes in. View waits until it scrolls into view and load starts right away. Hover and click show the text and replay it each time it is hovered or clicked.

props.name: loop
props.description: Keeps replaying: the text holds, blurs back out and comes in again.

props.name: loop_delay
props.description: How long the text stays sharp before it blurs out again when looping, in seconds.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: from_color
props.description: Color each word or letter starts in before it settles on the text color. Leave it out to keep one color.

props.name: focus_on_hover
props.description: Hovering a word keeps it sharp while the other words soften and dim.

name: CircularText
description: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

props.name: text
props.description: The text laid out around the ring. End it with a separator for a seamless loop.

props.name: spin_duration
props.description: Seconds for one full turn. 0 keeps the ring still until it is dragged.

props.name: on_hover
props.description: What happens while the pointer is over the ring. It eases into the new speed and back out, and goBonkers also shrinks it a little.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the ring turns.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the ring, in px.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Size of the letters, in px.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the letters.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Extra space between letters, in em. Applies when fill is off.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the letters and center content. Leave empty to follow the surrounding text color.

props.name: start_angle
props.description: Where the first letter sits, in degrees clockwise from the top.

props.name: fill
props.description: Spreads the letters evenly around the whole ring. Turn it off to keep natural letter spacing and leave a gap.

props.name: repeat
props.description: How many times the text repeats around the ring. With fill off, each copy gets its own gap.

props.name: ring
props.description: Draws a thin circle just inside the letters.

props.name: ring_color
props.description: Color of the inner circle. Leave empty to match the letters.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Leans the ring back in perspective, in degrees, so it orbits around the center content like a planet ring.

props.name: hover_tilt
props.description: How far the ring tilts in 3D toward the pointer, in degrees. 0 turns the tilt off.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people grab the ring and fling it. It coasts with inertia, then eases back to its cruise speed.

name: CountUp
description: Animated number counter supporting formatting and decimals.

props.name: to
props.description: The target number to count up to.

props.name: from_
props.description: The initial number from which the count starts.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of the count; can be "up" or "down". When this is set to "down", "from" and "to" become reversed, in order to count down.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay in seconds before the counting starts.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the count takes, in seconds. It lands on the final number right on time.

props.name: start_when
props.description: A boolean to control whether the animation should start when the component is in view. It basically works like an if statement, if this is true, the count will start.

props.name: separator
props.description: Character to use as a thousands separator in the displayed number.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text shown before the number, like a currency sign.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text shown after the number, like a percent sign or a unit.

props.name: mode
props.description: Count swaps the digits as the value climbs. Roll turns every digit into a column that spins to its place like an odometer, staggered per column with a soft motion blur while it moves.

props.name: easing
props.description: Pace of the count. Spring overshoots slightly and settles on the final number.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fixed number of decimals. When not set, it follows the decimals in from and to.

props.name: format
props.description: Compact shortens large numbers to 1.2K, 3.4M or 5.6B.

props.name: trigger
props.description: View starts the count when the number scrolls into view, load starts it right away.

props.name: replay_on_hover
props.description: Replays the count on hover. In roll mode every column spins once more and lands on the same number.

props.name: on_start
props.description: Callback function that is called when the count animation starts.

props.name: on_end
props.description: Callback function that is called when the count animation ends.

name: CurvedLoop
description: Flowing looping text path along a customizable curve with drag interaction.

props.name: marquee_text
props.description: The text that loops along the path. Repeats are joined with a space.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the text travels along the path. 0 keeps it still until dragged or scrolled.

props.name: curve_amount
props.description: How far the path bends. On the arc it is the dip at the middle (negative arches up), on the wave it sets the wave height.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the text travels. On a circle, right turns clockwise. A drag flips it to the way it was thrown.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets people drag the text and fling it. Rings follow the pointer around. It glides back to its normal speed afterwards.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Eases the text to a stop while the pointer is over it.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text, or of its outline when outline is on. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: How much of each side fades out, from 0 to 1. At 1 only the middle stays fully visible.

props.name: shape
props.description: The path the text travels on. Circle closes the loop into a ring that always fits a whole number of repeats.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Letter size in px for a 1440px wide loop. The whole loop scales with its container.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the letters.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Extra space between letters in px, measured like fontSize.

props.name: outline
props.description: Draws the letters as outlines instead of solid text.

props.name: separator
props.description: A mark placed between repeats, such as ✦ or /. Leave empty to join repeats with a space.

props.name: separator_color
props.description: Paints the separator in its own solid color. Matches the text when left unset.

props.name: scroll_boost
props.description: How much page scrolling speeds the loop up for a moment before it eases back. 0 turns it off.

name: DecryptedText
description: Hacker-style decryption cycling random glyphs until resolving to real text.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to decrypt.

props.name: speed
props.description: Time between steps, in ms.

props.name: max_iterations
props.description: How many steps the letters scramble before settling when not sequential. Also sets how long letters keep scrambling after the cursor passes with hoverRadius.

props.name: sequential
props.description: Reveals one letter per step instead of all at once.

props.name: reveal_direction
props.description: Where the sequential reveal starts. Random uncovers the letters in a shuffled order.

props.name: use_original_chars_only
props.description: Scrambles using only the letters already in the text.

props.name: characters
props.description: The pool of characters used while scrambling.

props.name: parent_class_name
props.description: Class names for the wrapper around all letters.

props.name: encrypted_class_name
props.description: Class names for letters that are still scrambled.

props.name: animate_on
props.description: What starts the decryption. View and click start scrambled, so the real text never flashes first.

props.name: click_mode
props.description: With click, decrypt once or toggle back and forth. Only applies when animateOn is 'click'.

props.name: effect
props.description: How letters decode. Scramble swaps glyphs in place, flip rolls each glyph in vertically and lands the real letter with a soft bounce, fade keeps scrambled glyphs faint and brightens them as they resolve.

props.name: scramble_color
props.description: Color of letters while they are scrambled. Each letter eases back to the text color as it decodes. Leave empty to keep the text color.

props.name: loop
props.description: After decrypting, holds, scrambles the text again and repeats. Pauses while off screen.

props.name: loop_delay
props.description: How long the decrypted text holds before scrambling again when looping, in ms.

props.name: hover_radius
props.description: With hover, only letters within this many px of the cursor scramble, fading out toward the edge, and they settle once it passes. 0 decrypts the whole text on hover.

name: DepthText
description: Layered extruded type with parallax that shifts against the pointer.

props.name: text
props.description: The word or short phrase rendered as extruded type.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of stacked copies that form the extrusion. Clamped to protect the DOM.

props.name: depth
props.description: Spacing in pixels between each layer of the extrusion.

props.name: face_color
props.description: Color of the crisp front face. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: depth_color
props.description: Tint the extrusion fades into toward the back.

props.name: gradient_depth
props.description: Paints the extrusion in the depth color right behind the face and fades it out to the background toward the back.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Resting angle and maximum pointer-driven rotation, in degrees.

props.name: pointer_tracking
props.description: Enables smoothed pointer parallax on fine pointer devices.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Damping amount used to ease rotation toward the pointer target.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in pixels for the 3D stack.

props.name: auto_orbit
props.description: Adds a subtle orbit when pointer tracking is unavailable or idle.

props.name: orbit_speed
props.description: Speed of the fallback orbit in cycles per second.

props.name: hover_push
props.description: How far hovering presses the text into the page, from 0 to 1. The extrusion compresses on a spring, pressing pushes a little deeper and releasing bounces back. 0 turns it off.

props.name: float_
props.description: Lets the text bob and sway gently while it is not hovered.

props.name: font_size
props.description: CSS font-size value for the display word.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight used for every layer.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Casts a soft drop shadow behind the extrusion.

props.name: outline
props.description: Draws the extrusion as stacked outlines instead of solid layers.

props.name: intro
props.description: Grows the extrusion out from the flat face on mount.

name: EchoText
description: Ghosted copies trail behind the text and settle into a single word.

props.name: text
props.description: Text rendered by the crisp front copy and every echo.

props.name: echoes
props.description: Number of ghost copies behind the front text, up to 24.

props.name: lag
props.description: How slowly deeper echoes catch up with the text, and how far apart they spread along the auto trail.

props.name: offset
props.description: How far the echoes spread on entrance, how far the text leans toward the cursor and how wide the drift and click burst reach, in px.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the entrance trail settles in from.

props.name: fade
props.description: How much of its opacity each echo keeps from the one in front of it.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur on the deepest echo, in px. Echoes in between blur less.

props.name: tint
props.description: Color blended into the echoes, stronger toward the back. Pass false for plain echoes.

props.name: echo_colors
props.description: Two colors the echoes fade between, from the echo nearest the text to the deepest one. Replaces the tint when set.

props.name: echo_style
props.description: Draws the echoes as filled text or as thin outlines.

props.name: echo_scale
props.description: Size of the deepest echo relative to the text. Below 1 the trail recedes, above 1 it looms.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether the echoes play on entrance, run the live trail, or both. "pointer" means trail only, whatever drives it.

props.name: trail
props.description: What drives the live trail. Pointer follows the cursor, auto drifts the echoes on a slow figure-eight whenever the cursor is away, scroll stretches them behind the text as the page scrolls.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking the text releases a burst of echoes that expand from the click point and fade.

props.name: cursor_radius
props.description: Distance in px over which the cursor pulls the text to full offset. With the auto trail, the drift resumes once the cursor leaves this radius.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the entrance takes to settle, in ms.

props.name: ease
props.description: Timing curve of the entrance.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the text.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the text.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the front copy. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

name: FallingText
description: Text that breaks apart and tumbles into a pile you can drag, throw and swipe, then flies back into place.

props.name: text
props.description: The text that falls apart.

props.name: highlight_words
props.description: Words that start with any of these strings get the accent color, or the accent tile in the tiles variant.

props.name: highlight_class
props.description: Extra class added to highlighted words.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the fall. Scroll starts it when the text scrolls into view.

props.name: variant
props.description: Plain falling text, or words on tiles that stack like blocks.

props.name: split
props.description: Whether whole words or single letters fall.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Strength of gravity. Negative values fall upward.

props.name: bounciness
props.description: How much pieces bounce when they land, from 0 to 1.

props.name: scatter
props.description: How much spin and sideways push each piece gets as it drops, from 0 to 1.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between pieces dropping, in seconds.

props.name: order
props.description: Which pieces drop first. Falling pieces knock loose the ones they land on.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people pick up, drag and throw pieces.

props.name: mouse_constraint_stiffness
props.description: How tightly a dragged piece follows the pointer, from 0 to 1.

props.name: cursor_push
props.description: How hard a quick swipe knocks the fallen pieces around. 0 turns it off.

props.name: restore_delay
props.description: Seconds after the pile settles, with the pointer away, before the text flies back into place and can fall again. 0 keeps it fallen.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the text.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of highlighted words, or of their tiles in the tiles variant.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the tiles.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Background of the area the text falls into.

props.name: wireframes
props.description: Outlines each piece to show its physics shape.

props.text: Some sentences are built to last. This one falls apart on contact.

name: FoldText
description: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to split and fold into place. Line breaks are kept.

props.name: split_by
props.description: Whether each character, word or line folds as its own panel.

props.name: hinge
props.description: The edge each panel folds around. For blinds and flip it picks the axis and the turning direction.

props.name: fold_style
props.description: How each piece folds. Paper swings open from its hinge edge, blinds splits it into two slats that turn open one after the other, and flip turns it over like a card, lifting toward you mid-turn.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long each panel takes to unfold, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between panels, in seconds.

props.name: stagger_from
props.description: Where the cascade starts.

props.name: fold_angle
props.description: How far the panels start folded away, in degrees. Past 90 they flip over from behind. Flip always turns a full half turn.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP ease used for the unfold.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Camera distance for the fold, in px. Lower values look deeper.

props.name: crease_shading
props.description: How dark the crease shading gets while a panel is folded, from 0 to 1.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the text unfolds. Loop holds the text, folds it back up and plays again.

props.name: loop_delay
props.description: How long the unfolded text holds before folding back up, in seconds. Only applies when trigger is 'loop'.

props.name: hover_refold
props.description: Panels near the cursor fold partly away and ease back open once it passes.

props.name: refold_radius
props.description: How far from the cursor panels react with hoverRefold, in px. The fold fades out toward the edge.

props.name: refold_angle
props.description: How far a panel right under the cursor folds away with hoverRefold, in degrees.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the text. Numbers are in px.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the text.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

name: FuzzyText
description: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size as any CSS size or a number in px. Responsive sizes are redrawn when the window resizes.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the text.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font family of the text. 'inherit' uses the font of the surrounding text.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default, including theme switches.

props.name: enable_hover
props.description: Raises the fuzz to the hover intensity while the pointer is over the text, when trigger is 'hover'.

props.name: base_intensity
props.description: How strong the fuzz is at rest.

props.name: hover_intensity
props.description: How strong the fuzz is while hovered. With trigger 'always' it is the constant level, with 'click' it sets how hard each burst hits.

props.name: fuzz_range
props.description: Furthest the strips can shift, in px.

props.name: fps
props.description: Frame rate cap. Lower values look choppier and use less CPU.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the strips shift.

props.name: transition_duration
props.description: How many frames the fuzz takes to ease between intensities. 0 switches instantly.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: Gives a short burst of full intensity on click when trigger is 'hover' or 'always'.

props.name: glitch_mode
props.description: Adds bursts of full intensity at a regular interval.

props.name: glitch_interval
props.description: Time between glitch bursts, in ms.

props.name: glitch_duration
props.description: Length of each glitch burst, in ms.

props.name: gradient
props.description: Two or more colors to fill the text with a left to right gradient instead of a single color.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Extra space between letters, in px.

props.name: slice_size
props.description: Thickness of each shifted strip, in px. 1 gives a fine fuzz, larger values tear the text into bands.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What raises the fuzz. 'hover' reacts to the pointer, 'always' holds the hover intensity, 'click' fires a burst that eases back.

props.name: intro
props.description: Fades the text in as heavy, coarse static that resolves into clean letters the first time it is seen.

props.name: intro_duration
props.description: How long the intro takes to resolve, in ms.

props.name: color_split
props.description: Splits the text into offset red, green and blue copies that tear apart with the fuzz, from 0 to 1. Dark text splits into print-style cyan, magenta and yellow instead.

name: GlitchText
description: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the animation speed. Higher values slow down the glitch effect.

props.name: enable_shadows
props.description: Toggle the glitch colors. Without them every mode stays in the text color.

props.name: enable_on_hover
props.description: Same as trigger="hover": the glitch only runs while the text is hovered.

props.name: offset
props.description: How far the glitched slices shift sideways, in px. The colored shadows grow with it.

props.name: shadow_colors
props.description: The two glitch colors: the shadows on the shifted slices, the split channels and the swapped glyphs.

props.name: mode
props.description: Style of glitch. Slices shifts bands of the text sideways, rgb splits it into jittering color channels, scan sweeps a displaced band down through it and noise briefly swaps letters for glyphs.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How often and how far it glitches, from 0 (calm) to 1 (constant, wide jolts).

props.name: skew
props.description: How far the text shears sideways during a jolt, in degrees.

props.name: flicker
props.description: Adds quick, subtle dips in opacity while it glitches.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When it glitches: all the time, while hovered, or in a short burst on each click.

props.name: burst_duration
props.description: Length of the burst played on each click with the click trigger, in seconds.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the text. Numbers are in px.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the text.

name: GradientText
description: Living gradients inside your text: a sliding sweep, a drifting mesh or a swinging conic fan.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the gradient, in order. The first color is repeated at the end so loops stay seamless.

props.name: animation_speed
props.description: Seconds for one full cycle of the animation.

props.name: variant
props.description: How the colors move. Linear slides a gradient through the text, flow drifts soft blobs of color around like a living mesh gradient and conic swings colors around the center.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of the gradient in degrees. 90 runs left to right, 180 top to bottom.

props.name: scale
props.description: How broad the colors are. Higher values show fewer colors at once in longer, calmer bands.

props.name: yoyo
props.description: Eases back and forth instead of scrolling the gradient in one direction forever.

props.name: glow
props.description: A soft bloom of the gradient colors around the letters, from 0 to 1.

props.name: show_border
props.description: Wraps the text in a pill with an animated gradient outline that works on any background.

props.name: border_width
props.description: Thickness of the outline in px.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Holds the colors still while the pointer is over the text.

props.name: follow_pointer
props.description: While hovered, the colors are drawn toward the pointer.

name: MaskedHeading
description: A headline with a drifting colour mesh or image showing through, revealed word by word.

props.name: text
props.description: Heading copy.

props.name: tag_
props.description: Element the heading renders as, so it can carry the right semantics.

props.name: media_type
props.description: Whether the source showing through the letters is an image or a looping muted video. Videos stay paused for people who prefer reduced motion.

props.name: src
props.description: Image or video URL.

props.name: poster
props.description: Poster frame used while a video loads.

props.name: fill_scale
props.description: How far the media is zoomed past the heading. The overscan is what parallax travels into.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the media slides under the letters as the pointer moves, in px.

props.name: drift
props.description: Amplitude of the slow idle motion, in px. 0 holds the media still.

props.name: hover_zoom
props.description: Extra zoom the media eases into while the pointer is over the heading. 0.1 is 10% closer.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Brightness of the media.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Saturation of the media.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Render the media in black and white.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colorizes the media in one color while keeping its light and shadow, like a duotone print. Leave empty for the original colors.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: Dims and desaturates the media except for a soft pool of light that eases after the pointer. Without a pointer, the light wanders slowly across the letters.

props.name: spotlight_radius
props.description: Radius of the spotlight, in px.

props.name: outline
props.description: Draws a thin stroke around every letter. It is visible before the entrance, so the media fills the outlines as it arrives.

props.name: outline_color
props.description: Color of the outline. Leave empty to follow the surrounding text color.

props.name: outline_width
props.description: Thickness of the outline, in px.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Entrance style: words rise into place, letters grow in one after another, the letters draw together while the heading pulls into focus, a wipe sweeps across, or the whole block fades up.

props.name: duration
props.description: Entrance duration, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between words, in seconds, for the rise reveal. The scale reveal steps letter by letter at about a third of it.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the entrance runs.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment.

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight.

props.name: tracking
props.description: Letter spacing, in em.

props.name: line_height
props.description: Line height.

props.name: text_scale
props.description: Type size as a fraction of the container width, so the heading stays responsive.

name: ParticleText
description: Text assembles from drifting particles that scatter and reform on demand.

props.name: text
props.description: The words sampled into particle targets.

props.name: particle_size
props.description: Rendered size of each particle in CSS pixels.

props.name: density
props.description: Pixel sampling step for the offscreen glyph canvas. Lower values create more particles.

props.name: color
props.description: Particle color at rest. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: highlight_color
props.description: Color particles take on while they fly in or get pushed around. Also colors the glow and the scan line.

props.name: highlight_mode
props.description: Motion lights up particles while they are away from their spot and cools them as they land. Gradient blends the highlight across the text from left to right.

props.name: shape
props.description: How each particle is drawn. Line draws short strokes that stretch along their motion and settle into an even hatch.

props.name: intro
props.description: How the text forms. Gather pulls scattered particles together, rain drops them in from above, spiral swirls them into place, and scan assembles the text behind a sweeping line.

props.name: scatter
props.description: How far particles begin from their final spots in the gather and spiral intros.

props.name: gather_duration
props.description: Milliseconds for the intro to form the text.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Maximum per-particle delay in milliseconds before it starts moving.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking blows the particles away from the click point, then they spring back into the text. Off while trigger is click.

props.name: burst_strength
props.description: How hard and how wide a click burst pushes.

props.name: pointer_repel
props.description: Strength of the cursor pushback.

props.name: repel_radius
props.description: Cursor influence radius in pixels.

props.name: idle_drift
props.description: Subtle resting motion after the text has formed.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the intro plays again after the first formation: never, on hover, or on click.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Canvas text size used for glyph sampling.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight used for sampling.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font family used for sampling. Inherit waits for the surrounding font before sampling.

props.name: glow
props.description: Adds a soft bloom in the highlight color around highlighted particles.

name: RotatingText
description: Cycles through multiple phrases with 3D rotate / flip transitions.

props.name: texts
props.description: The texts to rotate through.

props.name: transition
props.description: Overrides the Motion transition used for every letter. Each effect brings its own by default.

props.name: initial
props.description: Overrides the state each letter enters from. Leave unset to use the effect.

props.name: animate
props.description: Overrides the state each letter settles into.

props.name: exit
props.description: Overrides the state each letter leaves to.

props.name: effect
props.description: How letters swap. Flip rolls them over like a drum, blur dissolves them, scale zooms through and drop lets them fall in with a small bounce.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way letters travel. Drop always falls from above.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Puts the rotating text on a colored block that smoothly resizes to fit each new text, with a text color picked for contrast.

props.name: highlight_color
props.description: Color of the highlight block. Hex or rgb colors also set a readable text color automatically.

props.name: animate_presence_mode
props.description: 'wait' lets the old text leave before the new one enters, 'sync' runs both at once.

props.name: animate_presence_initial
props.description: Animates the first text in on mount.

props.name: rotation_interval
props.description: Time each text stays on screen, in milliseconds.

props.name: stagger_duration
props.description: Delay between letters, in seconds.

props.name: stagger_from
props.description: Which letter moves first. A number starts from that letter, random shuffles the order.

props.name: loop
props.description: Goes back to the first text after the last one.

props.name: auto
props.description: Rotates on its own. Turn off to drive it with the ref methods.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Holds the current text while the pointer is over it.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blurs letters as they come and go, in px. The blur effect uses 10 when this is 0.

props.name: split_by
props.description: How each text is split into moving pieces. Any other string is used as the separator.

props.name: on_next
props.description: Called with the new index whenever the text changes.

props.name: main_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the outer element.

props.name: split_level_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for each group of letters. Add overflow hidden here for a masked slide.

props.name: element_level_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for each moving letter.

name: ScrambledText
description: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the pointer, in px, within which letters react.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long a letter right under the pointer keeps scrambling, in seconds. Also sets the pace of the intro and the click burst.

props.name: speed
props.description: How often a scrambling letter swaps to a new character. Higher values flicker faster.

props.name: scramble_chars
props.description: The characters shown while a letter is scrambled.

props.name: scramble_color
props.description: Color of letters while they are scrambled. Leave empty to keep the text color.

props.name: effect
props.description: What happens to letters near the pointer: they scramble, rise, blur, or swell like a lens. Each one eases in and out with a soft falloff.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far letters lift, how much they blur, or how much they magnify.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long lifted, blurred or magnified letters take to settle after the pointer moves on, in seconds. Scrambling uses duration instead.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking sends a scramble wave outward from the click point, carrying the current effect with it.

props.name: intro
props.description: Decodes the whole text from scrambled characters the first time it scrolls into view.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font of the text. Leave empty to keep the default monospace.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text. Leave empty to follow the surrounding text color.

children: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Similique pariatur dignissimos porro eius quam doloremque et enim velit nobis maxime.

name: ScrollFloat
description: Text gently floats / parallax shifts on scroll.

props.name: scroll_container_ref
props.description: Ref to the element that scrolls. Leave it out to use the page.

props.name: container_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the heading.

props.name: text_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the text.

props.name: effect
props.description: How the pieces arrive. Float stretches them up out of a slot, flip rolls them in on a drum, scatter assembles them from random spots, blur pulls them into focus and wave makes them swell in on a rolling wave.

props.name: split_by
props.description: Animate each letter on its own or each word as one piece.

props.name: direction
props.description: Whether the pieces come in from below or from above.

props.name: order
props.description: Which pieces go first. The order is fixed, so random looks the same on every visit.

props.name: from_color
props.description: Color the pieces start in before they settle into the text color. Keep currentColor for no color change.

props.name: animation_duration
props.description: Length of each piece's move compared to the stagger. Higher values move the pieces more together.

props.name: ease
props.description: Any GSAP ease, such as 'power3.out', 'elastic.out(1, 0.45)' or 'none'.

props.name: scroll_start
props.description: Scroll position where the animation starts, in ScrollTrigger syntax.

props.name: scroll_end
props.description: Scroll position where the pieces settle. Text near the end of the page still settles fully.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between pieces. Higher values make the text form one piece at a time.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far the pieces travel, as a percentage of their height. For flip it sets the size of the drum they roll around, for scatter how widely they start apart.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How tall the pieces are stretched while they rise in the float and wave effects. 1 keeps their shape.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Seconds the pieces take to catch up with the scroll. 0 ties them to it directly.

name: ScrollReveal
description: Text gently unblurs and reveals on scroll.

props.name: scroll_container_ref
props.description: Ref to the element that scrolls. Leave it out to use the page.

props.name: enable_blur
props.description: Starts each piece out of focus and sharpens it as it appears.

props.name: base_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the pieces before they are revealed, from 0 to 1.

props.name: base_rotation
props.description: Tilt of the whole block before it levels out, in degrees. 0 keeps it level.

props.name: blur_strength
props.description: How blurred the pieces start, in px.

props.name: base_offset
props.description: How far below its place each piece starts, in px. Pieces rise into place as they appear.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Spacing between pieces. Higher values reveal them one at a time instead of in a soft wave. In enter mode it is in seconds.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Seconds the reveal takes to catch up with the scroll. 0 ties it to the scroll directly.

props.name: split_by
props.description: What each step of the reveal is. 'lines' groups the words of each rendered line and regroups on resize.

props.name: effect
props.description: How each piece appears. 'fade' brightens in place, 'rise' slides up from behind its own baseline, 'flip' stands up from flat and 'scale' pops up from small.

props.name: mode
props.description: 'scrub' ties the reveal to the scroll position, 'enter' plays it once when the text scrolls into view.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each piece takes to appear when mode is 'enter'.

props.name: highlight_color
props.description: Accent each word lights up to while it is being revealed, before it settles to the text color. Leave empty for no highlight.

props.name: container_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the heading.

props.name: text_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the text.

props.name: rotation_end
props.description: Scroll position where the block finishes leveling out in scrub mode, in ScrollTrigger syntax.

props.name: word_animation_end
props.description: Scroll position where every piece is fully revealed in scrub mode. Text near the end of the page still finishes.

children: When does a man die? When he is hit by a bullet? No! When he suffers a disease? No! When he ate a soup made out of a poisonous mushroom? No! A man dies when he is forgotten!

name: ScrollVelocity
description: Text marquee animatio - speed and distortion scale with user's scroll velocity.

props.name: scroll_container_ref
props.description: Optional ref for a custom scroll container to track scroll position.

props.name: texts
props.description: Array of items to display as scrolling content. Accepts strings, JSX elements, icons, or any valid React node.

props.name: velocity
props.description: Base velocity for scrolling; sign is flipped for odd indexed texts.

props.name: damping
props.description: Damping value for the spring animation.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Stiffness value for the spring animation.

props.name: num_copies
props.description: Number of copies of the text rendered for a continuous scrolling effect.

props.name: velocity_mapping
props.description: Mapping from scroll velocity to a movement multiplier for dynamic scrolling.

props.name: parallax_class_name
props.description: CSS class for the parallax container.

props.name: scroller_class_name
props.description: CSS class for the scroller container.

props.name: parallax_style
props.description: Inline styles for the parallax container.

props.name: scroller_style
props.description: Inline styles for the scroller container.

props.name: separator
props.description: Shown between the repeated copies, like a dot or a slash. Empty leaves just a space.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Glides the rows to a stop while the pointer is over them.

props.name: fade_edges
props.description: Softly fades the rows out at the left and right edges.

props.name: skew_with_velocity
props.description: How far the rows lean into their motion while you scroll or fling them, in degrees at full speed. Eases back to upright when they slow down.

props.name: scale_with_velocity
props.description: How much the rows stretch taller at full speed, as a fraction of their height. Negative values squash them instead.

props.name: outline_alternate
props.description: Draws every other row as outlined text.

props.name: gap
props.description: Extra space between the repeated copies in pixels, split evenly around the separator.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Size of the row text. Numbers are pixels. Leave it out to use the stylesheet size.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the row text. Leave it out to use the stylesheet weight.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color of the rows. Follows the surrounding text color when left out.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets you grab a row to scrub it, then throw it to glide on with inertia.

name: ShinyText
description: A sheen of light that sweeps across text, from soft bands to chrome-like reflections.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to shine. Children work too.

props.name: color
props.description: Base color of the text.

props.name: shine_color
props.description: Color of the light passing over it.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for one sweep across the text.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds of rest between sweeps.

props.name: angle
props.description: Tilt of the band of light in degrees. 90 is upright, higher leans it forward.

props.name: shine_width
props.description: How wide the band of light is, as a percentage of the text.

props.name: softness
props.description: How gently the band fades at its edges, from 0 for a crisp glint to 1 for a soft sheen.

props.name: bands
props.description: How many bands of light follow each other, like reflections sliding across chrome.

props.name: glow
props.description: A soft bloom of light that travels with the band, from 0 to 1.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the light travels.

props.name: easing
props.description: Feel of each sweep. Smooth glides in and out, linear keeps an even pace and snappy flashes across with a pause between.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When it shines: on a loop, once each time the pointer enters, or once when scrolled into view.

props.name: yoyo
props.description: Sweeps back and forth instead of always starting from the same side.

props.name: follow_pointer
props.description: While hovered, the light glides after the pointer, then slides off when it leaves.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Freezes the sweep while the pointer is over the text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows plain text with no shine.

name: Shuffle
description: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to shuffle.

props.name: shuffle_direction
props.description: Direction letters travel. Flip turns around the matching axis.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration (s) of each letter’s shuffle.

props.name: max_delay
props.description: Longest random delay (s) before a letter starts, when animationMode is "random".

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP ease for the motion and color shift. Back eases make letters overshoot as they land.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Portion of the element that must enter view before starting.

props.name: root_margin
props.description: ScrollTrigger start offset (px, %, etc.).

props.name: tag_
props.description: HTML tag to render for the text container.

props.name: text_align
props.description: Text alignment applied via inline style.

props.name: on_shuffle_complete
props.description: Called after a full run completes (and on each loop repeat).

props.name: shuffle_times
props.description: How many interim glyphs each letter passes through before it lands.

props.name: animation_mode
props.description: Order the letters start in: odd letters then even ones, left to right, outward from the middle, or after random delays.

props.name: loop
props.description: Repeat the shuffle indefinitely.

props.name: loop_delay
props.description: Delay (s) between loop repeats.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay (s) between letters starting, in every mode except "random".

props.name: scramble_charset
props.description: Characters to use for interim scrambles; empty keeps original copies.

props.name: color_from
props.description: Color each letter starts in, fading to its final color as it lands.

props.name: color_to
props.description: Color each letter fades to as it lands, and keeps afterwards.

props.name: trigger_once
props.description: Auto-run only on first scroll into view.

props.name: respect_reduced_motion
props.description: Shows the text right away, without shuffling, if the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: trigger_on_hover
props.description: Allow re-playing the animation on hover after it completes.

props.name: effect
props.description: How each letter cycles: a reel that slides past, a card that flips in 3D through random glyphs, or glyphs that spin in place with motion blur and settle sharp.

props.name: hover_radius
props.description: With hover replay on, only letters within this distance (px) of the cursor reshuffle, closer ones longer and through more glyphs. 0 replays the whole text.

props.name: motion_blur
props.description: Smears the sliding reel along its direction while it moves fast, then lands sharp. Slide effect only.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Follows the surrounding text color when unset.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of the interim glyphs while letters are in flight. Settled letters keep the text color.

name: SplitFlapText
description: Mechanical split-flap departure board that clacks through to each new phrase.

props.name: words
props.description: Phrases to cycle through like a departure board.

props.name: text
props.description: Optional single phrase. When set, it takes precedence over words, and changing it flips the board.

props.name: flip_duration
props.description: Duration, in seconds, of each individual flap turn.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay, in seconds, between each tile starting its cascade.

props.name: cycle_delay
props.description: Hold time, in milliseconds, before cycling to the next phrase.

props.name: charset
props.description: Characters used for the intermediate flip glyphs.

props.name: flips_per_char
props.description: Number of intermediate glyphs each changed tile flips through.

props.name: tile_color
props.description: Base color of each mechanical tile.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the glyphs on every flap. "currentColor" follows the surrounding text, handy for the minimal style.

props.name: tile_radius
props.description: Corner radius for each tile.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between adjacent flap tiles.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Tile type size. Numeric values are treated as pixels.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the phrase array repeats after the final phrase.

props.name: pad_to
props.description: Fixed tile count used to keep the board width stable.

props.name: align
props.description: Where phrases shorter than the board sit on it.

props.name: intro
props.description: Starts the board blank and flips it to the first phrase on mount.

props.name: glare
props.description: Strength, from 0 to 1, of the soft light sheen that sweeps down each tile as its flap falls.

props.name: depth
props.description: How physical the board feels, from 0 (flat) to 1: hinge shadow, flap shading as it turns, the shadow a falling flap casts and the thickness of its edge.

props.name: order
props.description: Where the cascade starts: from the left, from the right, out from the middle, or in a random order.

props.name: tile_style
props.description: Mechanical tiles, or bare characters that flip on their own, split by a hinge line.

name: SplitText
description: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to animate.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay between animations for each letter (in ms).

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each letter animation (in seconds).

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing for the reveal. Each effect brings its own ease when not set.

props.name: split_type
props.description: Split type: "chars", "words", "lines", or "words, chars".

props.name: from_
props.description: Custom starting GSAP properties for each piece, replacing the effect. Defaults to { opacity: 0, y: 40 }.

props.name: to
props.description: Custom target GSAP properties for each piece, replacing the effect. Defaults to { opacity: 1, y: 0 }.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Intersection threshold to trigger the animation (0-1).

props.name: root_margin
props.description: Root margin for the ScrollTrigger.

props.name: text_align
props.description: Text alignment: 'left', 'center', 'right', etc.

props.name: tag_
props.description: HTML tag to render: "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "p" or "span".

props.name: stagger_from
props.description: Where the stagger starts, so pieces can ripple out from the middle, the ends or in random order.

props.name: mask
props.description: Clips each piece to its own box so it slides out from behind an edge instead of floating in.

props.name: effect
props.description: Reveal style. Rise slides pieces up, fade dissolves them in, blur pulls them into focus, flip swings them up in 3D, pop scales them in with a soft overshoot, skew slides them in leaning and wave lets a crest travel across. Ignored when from or to is set.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the reveal plays. View waits until the text scrolls into view, load plays right away, hover and click play it in view and replay it on every hover or click.

props.name: loop
props.description: Animates the pieces out and back in again, over and over.

props.name: loop_delay
props.description: Pause in seconds between the end of a reveal and the next loop.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: Interaction after the reveal. Lift raises the pieces near the cursor with a soft falloff, wave sends a ripple through the text from where the cursor enters.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Follows the surrounding text color when not set.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color each piece passes through while it reveals before settling on the text color.

props.name: on_letter_animation_complete
props.description: Callback function when the first reveal completes.

name: StrokeText
description: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

props.name: text
props.description: The heading copy rendered as measured SVG glyphs.

props.name: stroke_color
props.description: Color used for the drawing outline.

props.name: fill_color
props.description: Color that floods into the glyphs after the outline draw. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: stroke_width
props.description: Width of the SVG text outline.

props.name: draw_duration
props.description: Seconds each character outline spends drawing on.

props.name: fill_delay
props.description: Seconds to wait after the outline draw before the fill begins.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay in seconds between each character animation.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing used for the outline draw.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Chooses when the draw timeline starts. Loop draws on, then plays back out before drawing again.

props.name: fill_mode
props.description: Controls whether fill appears with a fade, a directional wipe, or not at all.

props.name: wipe_from
props.description: Side the wipe fill sweeps in from. Bottom fills the letters like liquid rising.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Largest font size in px. The wordmark scales down to fit narrower containers.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the rendered letterforms.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font family of the letterforms. Inherits the surrounding font by default.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Tracking in px applied during measurement and rendering.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Draws the stagger from the final character back to the first.

props.name: stroke_style
props.description: Line style of the outline. Dashed and dotted outlines still draw on along each letter.

props.name: dash_length
props.description: Length of each dash in px, or the distance between dots for a dotted outline.

props.name: marching
props.description: Keeps dashes or dots flowing around the letters once they are drawn.

props.name: hover_redraw
props.description: Fades the outline out and draws it again whenever the pointer enters, after the first draw.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Adds a soft offset shadow under the filled letters that lifts into place as the fill lands.

props.name: shadow_color
props.description: Color of the shadow. Uses the stroke color when left unset.

name: TechText
description: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

props.name: text
props.description: The wordmark to render.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Any font family loaded on the page. Leave empty to inherit the font of the container.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the wordmark.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Largest font size in px. The wordmark shrinks to fit narrower containers.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Extra space between letters, in em.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the letters and their outlines. Follows the surrounding text colour by default.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Colour of the selection frame, connector, specks and labels.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the wordmark sits across the container.

props.name: reach
props.description: Radius around the pointer where the letters turn into vector outlines, in px.

props.name: softness
props.description: How gradually the fill hands over to the outlines. 0 is a hard edge.

props.name: dash_length
props.description: Length of each outline dash, in px.

props.name: dash_gap
props.description: Space between outline dashes, in px.

props.name: stroke_width
props.description: Thickness of the outline, in px.

props.name: line_style
props.description: How the outlines under the pointer are drawn. Only the outer silhouette is traced either way.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Area fades the letters into outlines inside a circle around the pointer. Letter turns only the active letter into its outline. Off keeps every letter solid.

props.name: specks
props.description: Tiny squares that blink and respawn around the active letter, seeded per letter. 0 turns them off.

props.name: selection
props.description: Frame the letter under the pointer. The frame glides from letter to letter.

props.name: labels
props.description: Label the frame with the letter and its size, or with its offset while dragged.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Let letters be dragged off the baseline. They spring back home on release.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much a released letter overshoots on its way home, from 0 (none) to 1 (very springy).

props.name: sweep
props.description: Sweep the reveal across the wordmark on its own while the pointer is away.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the idle sweep.

props.name: click_kick
props.description: Clicking a letter kicks it upward on its spring and sends a ripple through its neighbours, each leaving its outline behind while it moves.

props.name: intro
props.description: Entrance played once the wordmark is in view. Type places each letter as an outline under the selection frame, assemble flies pixel specks into the letters, metrics rules the font lines first and fills the letters zone by zone between them.

props.name: intro_duration
props.description: Length of the intro, in seconds.

props.name: guides
props.description: Rule the baseline, x-height, cap height and descender across the wordmark while a letter is active.

name: TextCursor
description: Text or emoji that trails your cursor as stamped copies, a following chain or a ribbon of letters.

props.name: text
props.description: The text or emoji the trail is made of.

props.name: mode
props.description: Stamp leaves copies along the path, chain makes copies follow each other like a snake, and ribbon lays the letters along the path.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between copies, in px. In ribbon mode, extra space between letters.

props.name: max_points
props.description: Most copies shown at once in stamp and chain modes.

props.name: follow_mouse_direction
props.description: Turns the text to face the direction the cursor moves.

props.name: random_float
props.description: Lets stamped copies sway gently, and makes chains and ribbons ripple.

props.name: exit_duration
props.description: How long a stamped copy takes to shrink away, in seconds.

props.name: removal_interval
props.description: How quickly the trail pulls back into the cursor once it stops, in ms per copy.

props.name: shrink
props.description: How much smaller the trail gets toward its end, from 0 to 1.

props.name: fade
props.description: How much the trail fades toward its end, from 0 to 1.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Softens the path the trail follows, from 0 to 1. Higher values lag a little behind the cursor.

props.name: pop_in
props.description: Makes new copies pop in with a little overshoot.

props.name: keep_upright
props.description: In stamp mode, keeps copies from turning upside down when the cursor moves left.

props.name: hide_cursor
props.description: Hides the system cursor over the element.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the text.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the text, in px.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the text.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font family of the text.

name: TextLoop
description: A seamless text marquee that flows along curved SVG paths.

props.name: text
props.description: The phrase repeated along the curve.

props.name: shape
props.description: Built-in curve the text flows along.

props.name: path
props.description: Custom SVG path data, drawn in a 1200x520 viewBox. Overrides shape when provided.

props.name: speed
props.description: Travel speed along the path, in units per second.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the text scrolls around the curve.

props.name: separator
props.description: Glyph placed between each repetition.

props.name: curviness
props.description: Amplitude of the wave, or the radius of the closed shapes.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Rotates the whole loop, in degrees. A slight tilt on a line turns it into a slanted banner.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the looping text.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the looping text.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Extra tracking between letters.

props.name: uppercase
props.description: Renders the phrase in uppercase.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color of the text. Defaults to white on the ribbon and to the surrounding text color without it.

props.name: ribbon
props.description: Draws a solid band behind the text along the path.

props.name: ribbon_color
props.description: Color of the band behind the text.

props.name: ribbon_width
props.description: Thickness of the band behind the text.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fades the loop out toward the left and right edges, from 0 (hard edges) to 1 (wide, soft fade).

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Eases the loop to a stop while the pointer is over it, and back up to speed when it leaves.

props.name: cross
props.description: Adds a second band crossing the first in an X and running the other way, with a soft shadow where the top band passes over it. Waves weave into a braid, arches into a lens and circles gain a tilted orbit.

props.name: cross_color
props.description: Color of the crossing band. Defaults to a pale tint of ribbonColor, and its text picks black or white for contrast. Without a ribbon it colors the crossing text, which is dimmed by default.

props.name: cross_angle
props.description: Angle between the two bands, in degrees. The pair stays centered on tilt.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Drag the loop to scrub it, or spin it on a circle. A throw keeps its momentum, then eases back to the normal speed.

props.name: scroll_boost
props.description: How strongly page scrolling pushes the loop. Scrolling down speeds it up, scrolling up slows or reverses it, and it eases back once scrolling stops. 0 turns it off.

props.name: outline
props.description: Draws the letters as outlines instead of solid fills.

props.name: outline_width
props.description: Stroke width of the outlined letters.

name: TextPressure
description: Characters scale / warp interactively based on pointer pressure zone.

props.name: text
props.description: Text content that will be displayed and animated.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Name of the variable font family.

props.name: font_url
props.description: Stylesheet URL that loads the variable font. The font needs width, weight and italic axes.

props.name: width
props.description: Varies the width axis of the font with pressure.

props.name: weight
props.description: Varies the weight axis of the font with pressure.

props.name: italic
props.description: Varies the italic axis of the font with pressure.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Fades letters out the further they are from the cursor.

props.name: flex
props.description: Spreads the letters across the full width.

props.name: stroke
props.description: Draws an outline behind each letter.

props.name: scale
props.description: Stretches the text vertically to fill the height of its container.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the cursor's pull reaches, as a fraction of the text width. Also sets the length of the idle wave.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How softly the letters follow the cursor, from 0 for instant to 1 for a slow, floaty glide.

props.name: idle
props.description: What the letters do while the pointer is away. A wave rolls a swell across the word, a pulse makes it breathe in and out.

props.name: idle_speed
props.description: Speed of the idle wave or pulse. 2 plays it twice as fast.

props.name: click_ripple
props.description: Clicking sends a wave of pressure rippling outward through the letters.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Fill color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: pressure_color
props.description: Letters blend toward this color as they swell under pressure. Leave empty to keep one color.

props.name: stroke_color
props.description: Color of the outline when stroke is on.

props.name: stroke_width
props.description: Width of the outline when stroke is on, in px. About half of it shows around the letters.

props.name: min_font_size
props.description: Sets a minimum font-size to avoid overly tiny text on smaller screens.

name: TextType
description: Typewriter effect with blinking cursor and adjustable typing cadence.

props.name: text
props.description: A sentence, or a list of sentences typed one after another.

props.name: as_
props.description: The element to render, such as h1 or span.

props.name: typing_speed
props.description: Delay between typed characters, in ms.

props.name: initial_delay
props.description: Wait before a sentence starts typing, in ms.

props.name: pause_duration
props.description: How long a finished sentence stays before it is cleared, in ms.

props.name: deleting_speed
props.description: Delay between deleted characters, in ms. In select mode, how fast the highlight grows.

props.name: delete_mode
props.description: How a sentence is cleared: erased one character at a time, or highlighted like selected text and then removed at once.

props.name: loop
props.description: Starts over after the last sentence. When off, the last sentence stays.

props.name: show_cursor
props.description: Shows a blinking cursor at the typing position.

props.name: hide_cursor_while_typing
props.description: Fades the cursor out while characters are being typed or cleared.

props.name: cursor_style
props.description: Shape of the cursor. Bar, block and underscore are drawn to fit the font. Character uses cursorCharacter.

props.name: cursor_character
props.description: Character or React node used as the cursor when cursorStyle is character.

props.name: cursor_color
props.description: Color of the cursor. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: cursor_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the cursor.

props.name: cursor_blink_duration
props.description: Half the length of one blink, in seconds. The cursor fades softly and stays solid while typing.

props.name: cursor_glide
props.description: Glides the cursor smoothly to each new position instead of jumping.

props.name: type_effect
props.description: How each character appears as it is typed: instantly, fading in, sharpening from a blur, or rising into place.

props.name: mistakes
props.description: From 0 to 1. How often a wrong key is hit. The typo is noticed after a beat, erased, and corrected, like a person typing.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Static text shown before the typed part, such as "We build " in front of rotating words.

props.name: prefix_color
props.description: Color of the prefix. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: text_colors
props.description: Colors for the sentences, used in turn.

props.name: variable_speed
props.description: Types each character after a random delay between min and max ms, for a human feel.

props.name: on_sentence_complete
props.description: Called with the sentence and its index each time a sentence is cleared.

props.name: start_on_visible
props.description: Waits until the text scrolls into view before typing.

props.name: reverse_mode
props.description: Reveals each sentence from its last character back to its first.

name: TrueFocus
description: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.

props.name: sentence
props.description: The text to display with the focus animation.

props.name: separator
props.description: String used to split the sentence into words.

props.name: manual_mode
props.description: Moves the focus to the hovered word instead of cycling on its own.

props.name: focus_style
props.description: How the focused word is marked: corner brackets, a full outline, a bar underneath, or a soft filled block behind the word.

props.name: order
props.description: Moves the focus to the next word in reading order, or to a random other word.

props.name: easing
props.description: How the frame moves between words: a smooth glide, or a spring that slightly overshoots and settles.

props.name: blur_amount
props.description: Blur on the words that are out of focus, in px.

props.name: focus_scale
props.description: Scales up the focused word, for example 1.06. The frame grows with it.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Color of the brackets, box or underline.

props.name: highlight_color
props.description: Color of the block in the highlight style, drawn softly so the text stays readable. Uses the border color when not set.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: Color of a soft glow around the brackets, box or underline. No glow by default.

props.name: animation_duration
props.description: How long the frame takes to move to the next word, in seconds.

props.name: pause_between_animations
props.description: How long the focus rests on each word before moving on, in seconds.

props.name: corner_size
props.description: Length of each corner bracket, in px.

props.name: border_width
props.description: Thickness of the brackets, box or underline, in px.

props.name: unfocused_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the words that are out of focus, from 0 to 1.

name: VariableProximity
description: Letter styling changes continuously with pointer distance mapping.

props.name: label
props.description: The text content to display.

props.name: from_font_variation_settings
props.description: The variation settings letters rest at, away from the cursor.

props.name: to_font_variation_settings
props.description: The variation settings to reach at cursor proximity.

props.name: container_ref
props.description: Optional element around the text. Letters skip their distance checks while the cursor is farther than the radius from it.

props.name: radius
props.description: Proximity radius to influence the effect.

props.name: falloff
props.description: Type of falloff for the effect.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How gently letters ease toward their new settings, from 0 (instant) to 1 (a slow, trailing wake).

props.name: from_color
props.description: Color letters rest at. Leave unset to keep the text color.

props.name: to_color
props.description: Color letters shift toward as the cursor gets close. Leave unset to keep the text color.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size a letter grows to right under the cursor. 1 keeps letters at their normal size.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far, in em, a letter right under the cursor rises.

props.name: idle_wave
props.description: While the cursor is away, a gentle wave of weight travels across the text. It fades out as the cursor comes near.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the text. Numbers are pixels. Inherits the surrounding size when unset.

props.label: Hover me! And then star React Bits on GitHub, or else...

name: WarpText
description: WebGL warp that bends and refracts the text around the pointer.

props.name: text
props.description: The headline text rendered into the WebGL texture. Use \n for line breaks.

props.name: color
props.description: Text fill color before the glass refraction pass. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

props.name: warp_strength
props.description: Amount of ambient glass distortion at rest.

props.name: warp_scale
props.description: Size of the moving distortion cells.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the ambient undulation.

props.name: pointer_influence
props.description: Radius of the cursor lensing area.

props.name: pointer_strength
props.description: Strength of cursor-driven bending and magnification.

props.name: refraction
props.description: Subtle RGB channel split for the glass edge.

props.name: chromatic
props.description: Color fringing inside the lens and click ripples, like light splitting through real glass. 0 is off, 1 is strong.

props.name: ripple
props.description: Adds a soft ripple to the pointer lens.

props.name: click_ripple
props.description: Clicking sends a shockwave ring through the text that bends the letters as it passes and fades out.

props.name: idle_drift
props.description: How strongly the lens keeps wandering over the text while the cursor is away, from 0 (it fades out) to 1 (a full-strength lens roaming across the words).

props.name: lens
props.description: How the cursor bends the text: magnify it, pull it inward or twist it around the pointer.

props.name: intro
props.description: Fades the text in from a strong warp that settles once it first comes into view.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Canvas raster font size. Numbers are pixels. The text shrinks to fit the container.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight used when rasterising the text texture.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font family used when rasterising the text texture.

props.name: letter_spacing
props.description: Tracking applied while drawing the text into the texture.

props.name: line_height
props.description: Line height for multi-line text.

name: AnimatedContent
description: Wrapper that reveals its content on scroll with slides, blur, 3D tilts, soft wipes and staggered children.

props.name: container
props.description: Scroll container that drives the animation, as a selector or an element. Defaults to the page.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far the content travels into place, in px.

props.name: direction
props.description: Axis the content travels along.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Comes in from the opposite side: from above, or from the left.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the animation, in seconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: Any GSAP ease, such as 'expo.out', 'back.out(1.6)' or 'elastic.out(1, 0.5)'.

props.name: initial_opacity
props.description: Opacity the content starts from.

props.name: animate_opacity
props.description: Fades the content in. Turn off to keep it fully opaque while it moves.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale the content starts from.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur the content starts from, in px. It comes into focus as it lands.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Rotation the content starts from, in degrees.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Tips the content back in 3D, in degrees, so it flips up into place.

props.name: wipe
props.description: Reveals the content behind a soft moving edge instead of all at once.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far into the viewport the top of the content must be before it animates, from 0 to 1.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the animation starts, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Animates each direct child in turn, this many seconds apart. Great for lists and grids.

props.name: stagger_from
props.description: Which child goes first when staggering.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Animate when the content scrolls into view, or right away.

props.name: once
props.description: Plays once. Turn off to replay every time the content scrolls in, and reverse when it scrolls back out.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Ties the animation to the scroll position. A number smooths it, in seconds.

props.name: disappear_after
props.description: Hides the content again this many seconds after it appears. 0 keeps it shown.

props.name: disappear_duration
props.description: Length of the hide animation, in seconds.

props.name: disappear_ease
props.description: GSAP ease of the hide animation.

props.name: on_start
props.description: Called when the animation starts.

props.name: on_complete
props.description: Called when the animation finishes.

props.name: on_disappearance_complete
props.description: Called when the hide animation finishes.

name: BlobCursor
description: Liquid metal blob cursor that stretches, sloshes and bursts into droplets, in chrome, jelly, pearl or ink.

props.name: material
