props.description: What the blob is made of. Chrome is liquid metal, jelly a glossy colored gel, pearl an iridescent shell and ink a flat goo.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the blob. Tints the reflections on chrome and pearl, and fills jelly and ink.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the main blob in pixels.

props.name: morph
props.description: How far the blob drifts from a perfect sphere, from 0 for a round bead to 1 for a restless, shapeshifting puddle.

props.name: morph_speed
props.description: How fast the shape keeps changing, from 0 for a frozen shape to 1 for a boiling one.

props.name: depth
props.description: How tall the liquid stands, from 0 for a flat puddle to 1 for a full, round bead.

props.name: trail
props.description: How many links the liquid tail has, from 0 for no tail to 16 for a long tail that curves along your path.

props.name: lag
props.description: How lazily the blob follows the pointer, from 0 for tight to 1 for slow and floaty.

props.name: goo
props.description: How thick and syrupy the liquid is where the tail and droplets meet the blob, from 0 for crisp to 1 for gooey.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far the blob pulls out into a teardrop as it moves, from 0 for short to 1 for a long comet.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How bouncy and jelly-like it is when it stops, turns or gets clicked.

props.name: drip
props.description: How many droplets fling off the tail on fast moves. They stay on the page until they dry up or the blob soaks them back up.

props.name: splash
props.description: Clicking bursts droplets out of the blob. They fly off the page and the blob grows back.

props.name: splash_count
props.description: How many droplets each click throws out, from 1 to 32.

props.name: splash_speed
props.description: How fast the droplets fly, from 0 for a gentle spill to 1 for a hard burst.

props.name: splash_size
props.description: Size of the droplets relative to the blob. Bigger droplets take more of the blob with them.

props.name: splash_gravity
props.description: Pulls the droplets down as they fly, from 0 for straight lines to 1 for a heavy arc.

props.name: regrow
props.description: How quickly the blob grows back to full size after a splash.

props.name: shine
props.description: Strength of the highlights and reflections.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Casts a soft shadow under the blob so it sits on the page.

props.name: blend
props.description: How the blob mixes with the page under it. Difference with a white ink blob inverts whatever it covers.

props.name: hide_cursor
props.description: Hides the system cursor over the area so the blob becomes the cursor.

name: ClickSpark
description: Bursts of sparks at every click, as dashes, comets, dots or stars, that can spill around buttons.

props.name: spark_color
props.description: Color of the sparks. Pass a list to mix colors through each burst.

props.name: spark_size
props.description: Length of each spark, in px.

props.name: spark_radius
props.description: How far the sparks travel from the click, in px.

props.name: spark_count
props.description: Number of sparks in each burst.

props.name: spark_width
props.description: Thickness of each spark, in px.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of a burst, in ms.

props.name: easing
props.description: How the sparks slow down as they fly out. Spring overshoots a little and settles back.

props.name: extra_scale
props.description: Multiplies how far the sparks travel.

props.name: shape
props.description: Look of each spark: a short dash, a comet with a fading tail, a round dot, or a twinkling star.

props.name: randomness
props.description: Varies the angle, length and speed of each spark, from 0 to 1. 0 gives a perfect star.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Pulls the sparks down as they fly, from 0 to 2.

props.name: spread
props.description: Angle the sparks fan across, in degrees. 360 is a full circle.

props.name: direction
props.description: Where a partial spread points, in degrees. 0 is up and 90 is right.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft light around each spark, from 0 to 1.

props.name: ring
props.description: Adds a thin ring that expands from the click.

props.name: layer
props.description: Draws the sparks over your content, or behind it so they burst out around buttons and cards.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops new bursts.

name: Crosshair
description: Crosshair cursor with live coordinates that locks onto links and buttons and measures them.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the lines, labels and brackets.

props.name: container_ref
props.description: Keeps the crosshair inside this element, which needs a position other than static. Without it the crosshair covers the whole viewport.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line thickness in px.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of everything the crosshair draws.

props.name: line_style
props.description: Stroke style of the two lines.

props.name: gap
props.description: Empty space in px left around the pointer where the lines would cross.

props.name: fade
props.description: How much the lines fade out toward the edges, from 0 to 1.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How far the lines trail behind the pointer. 0 sticks to it.

props.name: show_coordinates
props.description: Shows the pointer position where the lines meet the edges, and the size of a locked target.

props.name: target_effect
props.description: What happens over a target. Lock frames it with corner brackets and measures it, glitch shakes the lines like a bad signal.

props.name: target_selector
props.description: CSS selector for the elements the crosshair reacts to.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Sends a ring out from the pointer on every click or tap.

props.name: hide_cursor
props.description: Hides the system cursor inside the crosshair area and marks the pointer with a dot instead.

props.name: blend_mode
props.description: Difference inverts whatever is under the lines, so they stay visible on any background.

name: CrystalizedBall
description: A glass ball with a crackling electric rim and glowing dust that swirls with the cursor.

props.name: preset
props.description: A complete starting look, color included. Any prop marked from preset overrides the preset value when you pass it.

props.name: color
props.description: The one color of the ball. The white-hot rim, its glow and flares, the dust tones, sparks and haze are all derived from it.

props.name: theme
props.description: The background the ball sits on. Dark renders it as emitted light. Light draws it in crisp ink with a white-hot rim core.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the ball as a fraction of the smaller side of the container.

props.name: strands
props.description: Number of electric strands braided around the rim, from 1 to 8.

props.name: crackle
props.description: How far the strands bend and jitter. Low values hum quietly, high values crackle.

props.name: flares
props.description: How far the glow licks outward from the rim in slow, travelling flares.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the halo around the rim.

props.name: sparks
props.description: How often small arcs discharge along the inside of the rim. 0 turns them off.

props.name: particle_count
props.description: Number of dust particles in the ball, up to 40000.

props.name: fill
props.description: How full the ball is. Low values pool the dust at the bottom, high values float it up to the top.

props.name: motion
props.description: How the dust moves. Rise floats like embers, fall drifts down like snow, drift wanders and orbit loops in small circles.

props.name: particle_shape
props.description: Crisp square pixels or soft round dots.

props.name: depth
props.description: Strength of the depth cues. Dust at the back of the ball gets smaller and dimmer.

props.name: sway
props.description: How much the dust turns back and forth inside the glass, showing its depth.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: How much the dust sparkles on and off.

props.name: haze
props.description: Strength of the glow that pools under the dust and along the inside of the glass.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed of the rim, flares and sparks.

props.name: dust_speed
props.description: Animation speed of the dust.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets the cursor touch the ball. The rim heats up and flares toward it, the dust swirls in its wake and turns toward it, and a click shakes the ball.

props.name: hover_strength
props.description: How strongly the ball reacts to the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: On mount the rim powers up and the dust lights up from the bottom of the ball.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation. The dust can still be stirred.

name: Cubes
description: A grid of outlined 3D cubes that turn to face the cursor, spin when swept and ripple on click.

props.name: grid_size
props.description: Number of cubes on each side of the grid.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cubes, as a fraction of a cell.

props.name: face_color
props.description: Color of the cube faces. Match it to your page background for a clean cut-out look.

props.name: edge_color
props.description: Color of the cube outlines.

props.name: edge_width
props.description: Width of the outlines in px.

props.name: edge_style
props.description: How the cube outlines are drawn.

props.name: face_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the faces, from 0 for see-through wireframes to 1 for solid cubes.

props.name: shading
props.description: How much the sides of turned cubes pick up light, so they read as solid 3D shapes.

props.name: max_angle
props.description: How far cubes turn to face the cursor, in degrees.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the cursor reaches, in cubes.

props.name: speed
props.description: How quickly cubes respond.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much cubes overshoot and wobble as they settle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: brush
props.description: How strongly fast cursor sweeps spin the cubes they pass over.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Camera perspective, from 0 for a flat front view to 1 for strong depth.

props.name: auto_animate
props.description: Drifts a gentle wave across the grid while the cursor is away.

props.name: ripple_on_click
props.description: Clicking sends a ripple through the cubes that lights up their edges.

props.name: ripple_color
props.description: Color the ripple lights the cubes with.

props.name: ripple_speed
props.description: Speed of the ripple.

props.name: intro
props.description: Cubes tumble into place from the center on mount.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: CursorGrid
description: A crisp grid whose cells light up and fade behind the cursor, with grid styles, tiles and click pulses.

props.name: cell_size
props.description: Size of each grid cell, in px.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of lit cells and pulses. Defaults to near black in light mode.

props.name: grid_color
props.description: Color of the grid lines. Defaults to near black in light mode.

props.name: radius
props.description: Reach of the cursor, in px, for both the lit area and the spotlight.

props.name: falloff
props.description: How quickly cells dim toward the edge of the radius.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Light every cell within the radius around the cursor, or only the cell under it.

props.name: hold_time
props.description: How long a cell stays lit before fading, in ms.

props.name: fade_duration
props.description: How long a lit cell takes to fade out, in ms.

props.name: line_width
props.description: Width of the grid lines, in px.

props.name: max_opacity
props.description: Brightness of a fully lit cell outline.

props.name: fill_opacity
props.description: Soft fill inside lit cells.

props.name: grid_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the grid lines at rest. 0 shows only lit cells.

props.name: grid_style
props.description: How the grid is drawn: solid lines, dashed lines, dots or plus marks where the lines meet.

props.name: cell_radius
props.description: Corner radius of lit tiles, in px.

props.name: cell_gap
props.description: Inset of lit cells, in px. Above 0, lit cells become separate tiles.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: How much the grid lines brighten around the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking sends a ring of lit cells out from the click.

props.name: pulse_speed
props.description: Speed of the click ring, in px per second.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Lets random cells glow softly on their own, from 0 to 1.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fades the grid out toward the edges, from 0 to 0.5.

props.name: intro
props.description: Draws the grid out from the center with a pulse on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Uses near black lines and cells by default, for light pages.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: DitherVeil
description: A 1-bit dithered photo the cursor burns through to full colour, knitting back cell by cell.

props.name: src
props.description: Image to veil. Must be served with CORS headers.

props.name: fit
props.description: Show the whole image on the ink, or crop it to fill the container.

props.name: pattern
props.description: How the image is broken into dots: an ordered Bayer grid, blue noise stipple, Atkinson or Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion, or diagonal engraving lines.

props.name: pixel_size
props.description: Size of each dither cell, in px.

props.name: levels
props.description: Tones per channel. 2 is pure 1-bit, higher values add in-between shades.

props.name: palette
props.description: Duotone maps brightness between the ink and paper colours. RGB dithers each channel for a retro colour look.

props.name: ink_color
props.description: Colour of the darkest tone.

props.name: paper_color
props.description: Colour of the lightest tone.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Tonal contrast applied before dithering.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Shifts the image lighter or darker before dithering.

props.name: reveal_radius
props.description: Radius of the full-colour window around the cursor, in px.

props.name: softness
props.description: How much of the reveal edge dissolves through the dither. 0 is a hard cut.

props.name: linger
props.description: Seconds the revealed trail takes to knit back into dither. 0 turns the trail off.

props.name: rim_color
props.description: Colour of the cells along the dissolving edge.

props.name: rim
props.description: Thickness of the coloured rim on the dissolving edge. 0 hides it.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Start in full colour and dither wherever the cursor goes.

props.name: wander
props.description: Let the reveal drift around on its own while the pointer is away.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking sends a ring of colour rippling out across the image.

name: ElasticMesh
description: Turns text or any logo into a puffy inflated shape you can press, poke and stretch like jelly.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to inflate. Use \n for more lines.

props.name: src
props.description: URL of an SVG or PNG to inflate instead of text. Its transparent pixels define the shape.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font used for the text. Heavy, rounded faces inflate best.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the text.

props.name: color
props.description: Base color of the material.

props.name: image_colors
props.description: Keeps the colors of the image passed to src instead of using color.

props.name: material
props.description: Surface finish: glossy balloon, mirror chrome, glowing jelly or soft matte clay.

props.name: inflate
props.description: How puffy the shape is. 1 gives round tubes.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How firm the material feels, from 0 for soft and stretchy to 1 for firm and quick.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How long it jiggles after a poke or a pull, from 0 to 1.

props.name: grab_radius
props.description: Size of the area the cursor grabs and presses, in pixels.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far the material can be pulled, from 0 to 1.

props.name: press
props.description: Depth of the dent under the cursor and of a poke.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Strength of the soft drop shadow.

props.name: intro
props.description: Inflates the shape letter by letter on mount.

props.name: theme
props.description: Lighting setup for dark or light pages.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: ElectricBorder
description: Wraps any element in crackling strands of current that surge near the cursor and leap off in sparks.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the current. The strands burn whiter at their core.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: Color of the glow around the strands. Defaults to color.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the current crackles and moves.

props.name: chaos
props.description: How jagged the strands are, from 0 to 2.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the strands wander from the edge, from 0 to 2.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Thickness of the strands, in px.

props.name: strands
props.description: Number of strands running along the edge, from 1 to 6.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the glow around the border.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness of the current.

props.name: arcs
props.description: How often sparks leap off the border. 0 turns them off.

props.name: flicker
props.description: How much the current flickers, from 0 to 1.

props.name: border_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the border, in px. Match it to your content.

props.name: offset
props.description: Moves the border outward from the edge of the content, in px. Negative values move it inward.

props.name: active
props.description: Powers the border on or off. Turning it on sends the current racing around the edge again.

props.name: intro
props.description: The current races around the edge from the top when the border mounts.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The current surges near the cursor and clicks send a jolt around the edge.

props.name: cursor_radius
props.description: Size of the area around the cursor where the current surges, in px.

props.name: theme
props.description: Glowing light for dark pages, or crisp ink with a white core for light ones.

children.$jsx: Your content

name: ElectricLogo
description: Turns any logo into a living lightning outline, with arcs that leap off its edges.

props.name: src
props.description: Any image URL. SVGs and transparent PNGs are traced by their alpha, opaque images by keying out their backdrop colour.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the hot core of every strand.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: Colour of the glow around the strands, the bloom and the interior fill.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the logo as a fraction of the container. The glow and arcs extend beyond it.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness of the effect.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the halo around strands and the soft bloom around the shape.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of the main strand, in px. Satellite strands are thinner, and every strand swells and thins as it flows.

props.name: strands
props.description: Number of filaments tracing the outline, from 1 to 6. Extra strands come and go along the edge.

props.name: bend
props.description: How far the strands sway and ripple away from the outline. The main strand stays closest.

props.name: crackle
props.description: Size of the fine crinkle along every strand and arc.

props.name: arcs
props.description: How often short arcs leap off the edge and land further along it. 0 turns them off.

props.name: flicker
props.description: How much the whole effect pulses and each strand shimmers in brightness.

props.name: fill
props.description: Translucent glow inside the shape, brightest near its edges.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed. 0 freezes the current frame.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Turn on pointer interactions. Hovering charges the lightning around the cursor, and a click sends a ripple through it with a burst of arcs.

props.name: cursor_intensity
props.description: How strongly the lightning charges up around the cursor. 0 turns the hover charge off.

props.name: cursor_radius
props.description: Radius of the charged area around the cursor, in px.

props.name: theme
props.description: The background the logo sits on. Dark renders the lightning as emitted light. Light renders crisp electric ink with a white-hot core and a lighter fill.

props.name: on_render
props.description: Called immediately after each rendered frame. Copy the canvas synchronously to capture the current frame for effects such as live reflections.

name: FadeContent
description: Wrapper that fades content in on scroll, plain or out of focus, from washed-out gray, or through grain, mist and pixel blocks.

props.name: container
props.description: Scroll container that drives the fade, as a selector or an element. Defaults to the page.

props.name: effect
props.description: How the content appears: a plain fade, out of focus, from washed-out gray, through fine grain, through drifting mist, or block by block.

props.name: blur
props.description: Extra blur the content starts from, in px. true adds 10px.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the fade, in seconds. Values above 10 are read as milliseconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: Any GSAP ease, such as 'power3.out', 'expo.out' or 'none'.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the fade starts, in seconds. Values above 10 are read as milliseconds.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far into the viewport the top of the content must be before it fades in, from 0 to 1.

props.name: initial_opacity
props.description: Opacity the content starts from.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Fades each direct child in turn, this many seconds apart. Great for lists and grids.

props.name: stagger_from
props.description: Which child goes first when staggering.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Fade in when the content scrolls into view, or right away.

props.name: once
props.description: Fades in once. Turn off to fade back out whenever the content scrolls back below the view.

props.name: exit
props.description: Fades the content back out as it scrolls off the top, and in again when it comes back.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Ties the fade to the scroll position instead of playing it. A number smooths it, in seconds.

props.name: disappear_after
props.description: Fades the content out again this many seconds after it appears. 0 keeps it shown.

props.name: disappear_duration
props.description: Length of the fade out, in seconds.

props.name: disappear_ease
props.description: GSAP ease of the fade out.

props.name: on_start
props.description: Called when the fade starts.

props.name: on_complete
props.description: Called when the fade finishes.

props.name: on_disappearance_complete
props.description: Called when the fade out finishes.

name: GhostCursor
description: A ghost of glowing smoke that floats after the cursor and curls away as it rises.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the smoke. Dense parts glow lighter.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Brightness of the smoke.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the ghost, in px.

props.name: trail_length
props.description: How long the smoke lingers behind the cursor, from 1 to 200.

props.name: inertia
props.description: How far the ghost floats behind the cursor and glides on when the cursor leaves, from 0 to 0.99.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: How much the smoke swirls and curls as it drifts, from 0 to 2.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the smoke rises. Negative values let it sink.

props.name: detail
props.description: How wispy the smoke is, from 0 for a soft glow to 1 for billowing wisps.

props.name: grain_intensity
props.description: Film grain over the smoke, from 0 to 1.

props.name: bloom_strength
props.description: Strength of the soft glow around the smoke.

props.name: bloom_radius
props.description: How far the glow spreads, from 0 to 3.

props.name: bloom_threshold
props.description: How bright smoke has to be before it glows. Higher values keep the glow on the core.

props.name: edge_intensity
props.description: Fades the smoke out toward the edges of the area, from 0 to 1.

props.name: click_puff
props.description: Clicking releases a puff of smoke.

props.name: intro
props.description: The ghost floats across once when it first appears, before the cursor arrives.

props.name: theme
props.description: Glowing smoke for dark pages, or soft ink smoke for light ones.

props.name: mix_blend_mode
props.description: CSS blend mode for the canvas.

props.name: fade_delay_ms
props.description: Time after the cursor stops before the ghost starts to fade, in ms.

props.name: fade_duration_ms
props.description: How long the fade takes, in ms.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

props.name: target_pixels
props.description: Pixel budget for the smoke. Large areas render it at a lower resolution to stay fast.

props.name: z_index
props.description: Stacking order of the effect over your content.

name: GlareHover
description: A glossy light streak that sweeps across any element in the direction the cursor moves.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the element.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the element.

props.name: background
props.description: Background of the element.

props.name: border_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the element.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Border color of the element.

props.name: glare_color
props.description: Color of the glare. Any CSS color.

props.name: glare_opacity
props.description: Brightness of the glare, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glare_angle
props.description: Direction the glare travels, in degrees.

props.name: glare_size
props.description: Width of the glare as a percentage of the element's diagonal.

props.name: softness
props.description: How soft the core of the glare is, from 0 to 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the glare: one bright streak, a double streak like glass, or a soft wide sheen.

props.name: blend_mode
props.description: How the glare mixes with the content: screen, normal, overlay or soft-light.

props.name: rim_glint
props.description: Lets the edge catch the light where the glare crosses it.

props.name: mode
props.description: Sweep on hover, follow the cursor, shine on a timer, or sweep on click.

props.name: transition_duration
props.description: How long one sweep takes, in milliseconds.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between shines in loop mode.

props.name: play_once
props.description: In hover mode, sweeps only on the way in instead of again on the way out.

props.name: intro
props.description: Sweeps once when the element first scrolls into view.

name: GlowCursor
description: Light that pours from the cursor, drifts softly through the air and cools as it fades.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the light where it is freshly drawn.

props.name: secondary_color
props.description: Color the light cools to as it drifts. Leave it out for a deeper shade of the main color.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the light.

props.name: trail_width
props.description: Thickness of the light where it is drawn, in pixels.

props.name: linger
props.description: Seconds the light stays visible before it fades.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the soft glow around the light.

props.name: hotspot
props.description: Strength of the white-hot core near the cursor.

props.name: follow_speed
props.description: How tightly the light follows the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: grain
props.description: Amount of film grain in the light.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Releases a burst of light when you click.

props.name: quality
props.description: Resolution of the simulation. Lower it for weaker devices.

props.name: theme
props.description: Use light on light backgrounds for an ink-like look.

props.name: blend_mode
props.description: CSS blend mode of the canvas. Defaults to screen in dark and normal in light.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Maximum pixel density of the canvas.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Stops drawing new light while keeping what is already there.

name: GradualBlur
description: Progressive edge blur for headers, footers, captions and carousels, with an optional fade to color that hides at the ends of a scroll.

props.name: position
props.description: Edge the blur grows toward.

props.name: target
props.description: Sit inside the nearest positioned parent, or stay fixed to the edge of the viewport.

props.name: height
props.description: How far the blur reaches in from the edge. For left and right this is its width. Numbers are px.

props.name: width
props.description: For top and bottom, a narrower centered band. For left and right, overrides height.

props.name: strength
props.description: How blurry the very edge gets. Each step adds about 12px of blur.

props.name: layers
props.description: Blur layers stacked across the ramp. More layers give a smoother falloff, fewer show visible steps.

props.name: curve
props.description: How the blur builds across the ramp. bezier is a smooth S-curve.

props.name: exponential
props.description: Doubles the blur toward the edge so it starts gently. Turn off for an even ramp.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the blur layers. Lower values let the sharp content show through.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Color boost of the blurred content, building toward the edge, for a glassy look.

props.name: tint
props.description: Color the content fades into at the edge, such as your page background. Use rgba for a lighter wash.

props.name: auto_hide
props.description: Fades the blur out when the scroll container reaches this edge, so it only shows while there is more to scroll.

props.name: container
props.description: Scroll container watched by autoHide. Defaults to a scrollable sibling or the parent, or the page when target is page.

props.name: hover_intensity
props.description: Multiplies the blur while the cursor is over it. 0 clears it on hover, 2 doubles it.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the hover and autoHide transitions, in seconds or as a CSS time.

props.name: easing
props.description: CSS easing of those transitions.

props.name: z_index
props.description: Stacking order of the overlay.

name: HalftoneReveal
description: A halftone print of an image whose dots swell into the real photo under the cursor.

props.name: src
props.description: Image to print. Transparent or plain backgrounds are left unprinted. Must be served with CORS headers.

props.name: fit
props.description: Show the whole image, or crop it to fill the container.

props.name: mode
props.description: One ink, two inks at different screen angles, or full color: CMYK on light paper and RGB light on dark paper.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the halftone marks.

props.name: cell_size
props.description: Spacing of the halftone screen, in px.

props.name: angle
props.description: Rotation of the screen, in degrees.

props.name: dot_scale
props.description: Scales every mark. Below 1 keeps them apart, above 1 lets them merge sooner.

props.name: ink_color
props.description: Color of the printed marks.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Second ink used in duotone mode.

props.name: paper_color
props.description: Background the image is printed on. Match it to your page.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Tonal contrast applied before printing.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Shifts the image lighter or darker before printing.

props.name: invert
props.description: Prints a negative of the image.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Gives the marks ragged, ink-spread edges, from 0 to 1.

props.name: misregistration
props.description: Offsets the ink layers like a slightly misaligned press, from 0 to 1.

props.name: reveal_radius
props.description: Radius of the area around the cursor where the dots swell into the real photo, in px.

props.name: softness
props.description: Width of the band where the dots grow into the photo. 0 is a hard edge.

props.name: linger
props.description: Seconds the revealed trail takes to shrink back into print. 0 turns the trail off.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Start as the photo and print wherever the cursor goes.

props.name: wander
props.description: Lets the reveal drift around on its own while the pointer is away.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking sends a ring of color rippling out through the print.

props.name: intro
props.description: Grows the dots in from the center on load.

name: ImageTrail
description: Cursor-based image trail with several built-in variants.

props.name: items
props.description: Image URLs shown in the trail, in order.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of each image in pixels, or any CSS length.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Width divided by height for each image.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the images.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far the cursor travels, in pixels, before the next image appears.

props.name: lifetime
props.description: Seconds an image stays before it fades out.

props.name: appear_scale
props.description: Size an image starts at as it appears. 0 grows it from nothing and 1 shows it at full size right away.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How far each photo starts zoomed in before settling inside its frame. 1 turns it off.

props.name: flash
props.description: Brightness flash as an image appears, from 0 to 1.

props.name: exit_scale
props.description: Size an image shrinks or grows to while it fades out. 1 keeps its size.

props.name: drift
props.description: How far images keep flying in the direction of the cursor as they fade, from 0 to 1.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Random tilt of each image, in degrees.

props.name: size_variance
props.description: Random size variation between images, from 0 to 1.

props.name: align_to_motion
props.description: Turns each image to face the direction the cursor is moving.

props.name: stack
props.description: Keeps this many of the newest images on screen in a pile, instead of fading each one on its own. 0 turns it off.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Tilts images in 3D toward the edge where they appear, in degrees.

name: LaserFlow
description: A beam of light that splashes onto your content and pours over its corners.

props.name: surface_ref
props.description: Element the beam lands on. The light spreads along its top edge and spills over its corners.

props.name: beam_position
props.description: Horizontal position of the beam, from 0 at the left edge to 1 at the right edge.

props.name: surface_level
props.description: Where the beam lands when no surfaceRef is given, from 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the light. Every other tone is derived from it.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness of the light.

props.name: beam_width
props.description: Thickness of the beam and its glow.

props.name: flare
props.description: Size of the splash where the beam meets the surface.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the light travels along the surface.

props.name: spill
props.description: How much light pours over the corners of the surface.

props.name: fog
props.description: Amount of smoke lit up by the beam. 0 turns it off.

props.name: dust
props.description: Amount of glittering dust flowing with the light.

props.name: streaks
props.description: Brightness of the fine lines flowing along the splash.

props.name: dots
props.description: Strength of the fine dot texture in the glow.

props.name: pulse
props.description: How much the splash breathes over time.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed. 0 holds the light still.

props.name: seed
props.description: Changes the shape of the smoke.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: Brightens the light, smoke and dust softly around the cursor.

props.name: reveal_image
props.description: Image revealed through the light around the cursor, such as a screenshot of your UI.

props.name: reveal_radius
props.description: Radius of the reveal around the cursor, in pixels.

props.name: reveal_opacity
props.description: Strength of the revealed image. 0 hides it.

props.name: intro
props.description: Drops the beam in and lets the light run along the surface on mount.

props.name: theme
props.description: Use light for light page backgrounds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: LogoLoop
description: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.

props.name: logos
props.description: Logos to show. Each item is either { node } for any React node, like an icon, or { src, alt } for an image. Both accept an optional title, href and hoverColor, the brand color a logo takes on when hovered.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed in pixels per second. Negative values reverse the direction.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the logos travel.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loop.

props.name: logo_height
props.description: Height of each logo in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between logos in pixels.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Set to false to keep full speed on hover. Ignored when hoverSpeed is set.

props.name: hover_speed
props.description: Speed while the loop is hovered or a logo has keyboard focus. 0 pauses it and a small value slows it down. By default it pauses.

props.name: fade_out
props.description: Fades the logos out softly at both ends. It is a transparent mask, so it works on any background.

props.name: fade_out_width
props.description: Size of each fade as a fraction of the length, from 0 to 0.5.

props.name: scale_on_hover
props.description: Grows the hovered logo slightly.

props.name: layout
props.description: Path the logos travel along: a straight line, a wave, an arc, or a ring that turns in 3D.

props.name: bend
props.description: How strongly the path bends, from -1 to 1. It sets the height of the wave, the curve of the arc or the tilt of the orbit. Negative values flip it.

props.name: focus
props.description: A lens in the middle, from 0 to 1. Logos grow and make room as they pass the center while the outer ones dim.

props.name: magnify
props.description: Dock-style magnification under the cursor, from 0 to 1. Nearby logos move aside to make room.

props.name: tilt_x
props.description: Tilts the loop back or forward in 3D, in degrees.

props.name: tilt_y
props.description: Turns the loop to the side in 3D, in degrees.

props.name: step
props.description: Moves one logo at a time and pauses, centering each logo in turn. Speed sets the pace.

props.name: muted
props.description: Greys out and dims the logos until one is hovered or centered, from 0 to 1.

props.name: labels
props.description: Shows each logo's title beside it, below it, or as a small caption when it is hovered or centered.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people drag or swipe the loop and fling it. Links still open with a normal click.

props.name: scroll_boost
props.description: Speeds the loop up while the page scrolls and reverses it when scrolling up, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: Logos fade and rise in from left to right the first time the loop comes into view.

props.name: render_item
props.description: Custom render function for each logo, for full control over how it looks.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name for the loop.

name: Magnet
description: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.

props.name: padding
props.description: Distance in pixels around the element where the cursor starts to pull it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the effect off and lets the element spring back to rest.

props.name: magnet_strength
props.description: How far the element follows the cursor. The offset is divided by this value, so 1 follows the cursor and higher values move less.

props.name: max_offset
props.description: Caps how far the element can move from its resting place, in pixels.

props.name: exclusive
props.description: When several magnets are in range, only the nearest exclusive one is pulled. Turn it off to let a group, like dock icons, lean toward the cursor together.

props.name: axis
props.description: Limits the movement to one axis.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Maximum 3D tilt toward the cursor, in degrees.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale of the element while the cursor pulls it.

props.name: spring
props.description: Spring that drives the movement. Higher stiffness reacts faster, lower damping lets it overshoot and wobble back.

props.name: on_active_change
props.description: Called when the cursor enters or leaves the magnetic area. The wrapper also gets a data-magnet-active attribute.

props.name: wrapper_class_name
props.description: Class name for the outer wrapper, which stays in place.

props.name: inner_class_name
props.description: Class name for the inner element that moves.

name: MetaBalls
description: Liquid metaballs that merge, stretch and pinch apart, with a cursor blob that pushes through them.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the blobs.

props.name: cursor_ball_color
props.description: Color of the cursor blob. It blends smoothly into any blob it merges with.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the motion.

props.name: enable_mouse_interaction
props.description: The cursor blob follows the pointer and pushes the others aside. It orbits on its own otherwise.

props.name: hover_smoothness
props.description: How quickly the cursor blob catches up with the pointer. Lower is smoother.

props.name: animation_size
props.description: Size of the world shown in the view. Higher values zoom out and make the blobs smaller.

props.name: ball_count
props.description: Number of blobs, up to 50.

props.name: clump_factor
props.description: How far the blobs travel from the center. Lower values pack them together.

props.name: cursor_ball_size
props.description: Size of the cursor blob.

props.name: enable_transparency
props.description: Renders on a transparent background instead of black.

props.name: variant
props.description: Filled blobs, a single outline, or an outline with contour rings around it.

props.name: motion
props.description: How the blobs move: orbiting a cluster, drifting across the area, or rising and sinking like a lava lamp.

props.name: gooeyness
props.description: How far blobs reach toward each other before merging, from 0 to 1. 0.5 is the classic look.

props.name: stickiness
props.description: How strongly merged blobs cling together before the neck between them snaps, from 0 to 1.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much blobs stretch in the direction they move, from 0 to 1.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How much blobs jiggle after stretching or being pushed, from 0 to 1.

props.name: line_width
props.description: Width of the lines in the outline and contour variants, in px.

props.name: rings
props.description: Number of contour rings around the outline.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking makes the cursor blob pulse and splash the others outward before they flow back.

props.name: intro
props.description: Starts as a single drop that buds into the blobs the first time it comes into view.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: MetallicPaint
description: Liquid chrome that flows over your logo or text, adapted from Paper's Liquid Metal shader.

props.name: image_src
props.description: URL of the logo or image to paint. SVGs work best. Transparent pixels are left empty.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to paint instead of an image. Takes priority over imageSrc.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font used for text.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight used for text.

props.name: color
props.description: Tint of the metal. White keeps it chrome, warm tones turn it gold or copper.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Color behind the shape. By default the canvas is transparent.

props.name: density
props.description: How many reflection bands run across the shape.

props.name: softness
props.description: Softness of the reflection edges, from 0 for crisp chrome to 1 for brushed metal.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Rainbow fringes where the reflections bend, from 0 to 1.

props.name: distortion
props.description: How much the reflections ripple as they flow, from 0 to 1.

props.name: edge_bend
props.description: How strongly the reflections bend around the edges of the shape, from 0 to 1.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction the reflections flow in, in degrees.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the flow. 0 freezes it.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the shape inside the canvas.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the shape, in degrees.

props.name: mouse_tilt
props.description: How much the reflections shift as the cursor moves, as if tilting the metal.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Adds a soft dark rim and dims the brightest highlights so the shape reads on light pages.

props.name: intro
props.description: Pours the metal in from the outline on mount.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Device pixel ratio cap. Renders at 2× or more for clean edges.

name: Noise
description: Film grain overlay for photos and pages, from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and TV static.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Strength of the grain, from 0 to 1.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of each grain in CSS pixels. 0.5 is one device pixel on retina screens.

props.name: fps
props.description: How many times per second the grain changes. 0 keeps it still, like a paper texture.

props.name: blend_mode
props.description: How the grain mixes with what is underneath. Overlay and soft light add texture without graying the image.

props.name: contrast
props.description: From soft, fine grain at 0 to harsh, punchy grain at 1.

props.name: colored
props.description: Uses colored grain instead of gray.

props.name: dust
props.description: Specks, hairs and fibers that flicker over the frame like dust on a film print, from 0 to 1.

props.name: scratches
props.description: How often thin vertical scratches run down the frame for a few seconds, from 0 to 1.

props.name: scanlines
props.description: Adds rolling horizontal lines, like an old screen, from 0 to 1.

props.name: flicker
props.description: Makes the grain strength jump a little every frame, like a film projector.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Covers the whole viewport instead of the nearest positioned parent.

props.name: z_index
props.description: Stacking order of the overlay.

name: OrbitImages
description: SVG Path customizable orbiting images effect

props.name: images
props.description: Images that travel along the path, as URLs or objects with their own alt text.

props.name: alt_prefix
props.description: Prefix for the alt text of images given as plain URLs.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the path the images follow.

props.name: custom_path
props.description: Your own SVG path, drawn in a baseWidth by baseWidth space. Used when shape is custom.

props.name: base_width
props.description: Size of the coordinate space for the radii, the item size and custom paths.

props.name: radius_x
props.description: Horizontal radius for the ellipse, rectangle, infinity and wave.

props.name: radius_y
props.description: Vertical radius for the ellipse, rectangle, infinity and wave.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius for the circle, square, triangle, star and heart.

props.name: star_points
props.description: Number of points on the star.

props.name: star_inner_ratio
props.description: Inner radius of the star as a fraction of the outer one.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the whole path in degrees. Images stay upright.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full lap.

props.name: item_size
props.description: Size of each image, in the same units as the radii.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the images travel.

props.name: fill
props.description: Spreads the images evenly around the whole path. Turn it off to make them follow each other in a train.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the container. The orbit scales to fit.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the container. Auto matches the shape of the orbit, any other value fits the orbit inside.

props.name: show_path
props.description: Draws the path the images follow.

props.name: path_color
props.description: Color of the path line.

props.name: path_width
props.description: Width of the path line in pixels.

props.name: path_dash
props.description: Dash length of the path line in pixels. 0 draws a solid line.

props.name: easing
props.description: Easing applied to each lap.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stops the orbit. Dragging still works.

props.name: depth
props.description: Sense of depth, from 0 to 1. Images at the back get smaller, dimmer and pass behind the center content, and images at the front grow and pass in front of it.

props.name: item_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the images, in the same units as itemSize, or any CSS length. Half of itemSize makes circles.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Strength of the soft shadow under each image, from 0 to 1.

props.name: hover_scale
props.description: How much an image grows when hovered.

props.name: hover_speed
props.description: Speed while the orbit is hovered, as a fraction of the normal speed. 0 pauses it and 1 keeps full speed.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people drag or swipe sideways to spin the orbit, and fling it.

props.name: click_to_front
props.description: Clicking an image glides it around to the front.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when an image is clicked. When set, the images become keyboard-focusable buttons.

props.name: align_to_path
props.description: Turns each image to follow the curve instead of staying upright.

props.name: intro
props.description: Images fan out from the front around the path, and the line draws in, when the orbit first comes into view.

props.name: center_content
props.description: Content in the middle of the orbit. With depth, images pass behind and in front of it.

name: PixelSwap
description: New content builds in pixel by pixel in a springy wave that starts wherever the cursor enters.

props.name: first_content
props.description: Content shown at rest.

props.name: second_content
props.description: Content that builds in pixel by pixel.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Order the pixels arrive in. Pointer starts the wave where the cursor enters, leaves or clicks.

props.name: pixel_size
props.description: Edge length of each pixel in px. Grows automatically when the grid would pass 600 pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between pixels in px while they grow.

props.name: pixel_radius
props.description: Corner rounding of the pixels while they grow, as a percentage. 50 starts them as dots.

props.name: pixel_scale
props.description: Size each pixel pops in at, from 0 to grow out of nothing to 0.9 for a hard pop.

props.name: pixel_spin
props.description: Degrees each pixel turns as it grows in.

props.name: duration
props.description: Time in ms the wave takes to cross the content.

props.name: pixel_duration
props.description: Time in ms a single pixel takes to grow.

props.name: randomness
props.description: Noise mixed into the pattern, from 0 for a clean wave to 1 for a scatter.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How far each pixel overshoots before it settles, from 0 to 1.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the swap. With none, drive it with active.

props.name: intro
props.description: Builds the first content in from pixels on mount.

props.name: initial_active
props.description: Starts on the second content.

props.name: active
props.description: Controls which content shows. Pair it with onActiveChange.

props.name: on_active_change
props.description: Called when the trigger asks to swap.

props.name: on_complete
props.description: Called when a swap finishes.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Aspect ratio of the root.

name: PixelTrail
description: Glossy pixels melt into a fluid goo trail behind the cursor, with color shifts and drips.

props.name: grid_size
props.description: Number of pixels across the longer side.

props.name: trail_size
props.description: Radius of the trail brush, as a fraction of the longer side.

props.name: max_age
props.description: How long each part of the trail lasts, in ms.

props.name: interpolate
props.description: How many in-between points fill gaps on fast moves. Higher is smoother.

props.name: easing_function
props.description: Easing curve for how the trail swells in and fades out.

props.name: gooey_filter
props.description: Melts neighbouring pixels into liquid blobs. Higher strength rounds them more. Pass false for separate pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Pixel color.

props.name: trail_color
props.description: A second color the trail shifts to as it ages. Leave it out for a single color.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of each pixel when goo is off.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between pixels, as a fraction of a pixel. With goo on it draws fine seams between them.

props.name: decay
props.description: How pixels disappear: fading out, shrinking away or dropping out in a dither pattern.

props.name: flow
props.description: How much the trail keeps drifting in the direction the cursor moved, from 0 to 1.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Makes the trail sag down as it fades. Negative values make it rise, from -1 to 1.

props.name: sparkle
props.description: Makes fading pixels flicker, from 0 to 1.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking splashes a ring of trail out from the cursor.

props.name: shine
props.description: Glossy light on the pixels: bevels on every step, a brighter core and highlights, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: A soft glow around the trail, from 0 to 1.

props.name: image_src
props.description: An image the trail reveals. Each pixel takes the color of the image beneath it.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: PixelTransition
description: Retro pixel dissolve that covers a card in solid pixels, swaps the content underneath and clears again.

props.name: first_content
props.description: Content shown by default.

props.name: second_content
props.description: Content revealed by the transition.

props.name: grid_size
props.description: Number of pixels across the card. Rows follow so every pixel stays square.

props.name: pixel_color
props.description: Color of the pixels. Any CSS color works.

props.name: mosaic
props.description: Gives each pixel a slightly different tone of the pixel color, from 0 to 1.

props.name: animation_step_duration
props.description: Seconds the pixels take to cover the card, and again to clear it.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Order the pixels appear in. Ripple spreads from the pointer and wipe sweeps in from the edge it crossed.

props.name: randomness
props.description: Breaks up the ripple and wipe fronts, from 0 to 1.

props.name: pixel_animation
props.description: How each pixel appears and disappears.

props.name: pixel_shape
props.description: Shape of the pixels while the transition runs. They merge into a solid cover at the midpoint.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between pixels in pixels.

props.name: fps
props.description: Caps how often the pixels redraw for a choppy retro feel. 0 redraws every frame.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What starts the transition.

props.name: active
props.description: Controls the state from outside. Pair it with onActiveChange.

props.name: once
props.description: Keeps the second content once it has been revealed.

props.name: on_active_change
props.description: Called when hover, focus or a click asks for the other content.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Height of the card. Percentages work like padding-top ('125%'), anything else is a CSS ratio ('4 / 5').

name: Ribbons
description: Springy ribbons that trail the cursor, in lens, comet or even shapes with an optional wave.

props.name: colors
props.description: One ribbon is drawn for each color, in order from back to front.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of each ribbon at its widest, in pixels.

props.name: length
props.description: How far the ribbons trail behind the cursor. Higher values leave longer, lazier trails.

props.name: spread
props.description: Space between the ribbons, in pixels.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: How tightly the ribbons chase the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How far the ribbons overshoot and swing back when the cursor stops or turns, from 0 to 1.

props.name: shape
props.description: Width along each ribbon. Lens swells in the middle, comet is widest at the cursor, even stays level.

props.name: wave
props.description: A wave that rolls along each ribbon, from 0 to 1.

props.name: softness
props.description: Blurs the ribbon edges into soft light trails, from 0 to 1.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades each ribbon out toward its tail.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the ribbons.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Color behind the ribbons. By default the canvas is transparent.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: RippleDistortion
description: Pointer-driven water displacement that warps content and leaves a decaying wake.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL the ripples distort. Cover fitted to the container.

props.name: brush_size
props.description: Diameter of each ripple the pointer lays down, in px.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far the image is pushed, as a fraction of its size.

props.name: swirl
props.description: Full turns the push direction sweeps through as a ripple builds. 0 gives a flat push, higher folds the image into caustics.

props.name: rings
props.description: Concentric swells inside each ripple. 0 is a single plain blob.

props.name: spread
props.description: How many times its own size a ripple grows to before it dies.

props.name: fade
props.description: How long a ripple survives, in seconds.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Pointer travel between ripples, in px. Higher leaves a sparser trail.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Chromatic split between the red and blue channels as they refract.

props.name: glint
props.description: Sheen riding the shoulders of each ripple.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour the disturbed water takes on.

props.name: tint_amount
props.description: How strongly the tint colours the disturbed water.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Drain the colour out of the image so the folds read on tone alone.

props.name: highlight_color
props.description: Colour of the sheen.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What disturbs the surface: motion, clicks, or both.

props.name: click_strength
props.description: How much larger a click ripple starts than a hover one.

props.name: quality
props.description: Resolution of the displacement buffer. Lower trades crispness for fill rate.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Toggle the effect on or off.

name: ScrollExpand
description: A rounded media frame that grows to full bleed as it scrolls through the viewport.

props.name: src
props.description: Image or video URL shown inside the frame.

props.name: media_type
props.description: Whether the source is an image or a looping muted video.

props.name: poster
props.description: Poster frame used while a video loads.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the image.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline held over the frame that lifts away as the media takes over.

props.name: scroll_hint
props.description: Small cue shown under the resting frame that fades away as soon as the scroll begins.

props.name: start_width
props.description: Frame width before expanding, as a percentage of the stage.

props.name: start_height
props.description: Frame height before expanding, as a percentage of the stage.

props.name: start_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the resting frame, in px.

props.name: end_radius
props.description: Corner radius once fully expanded, in px.

props.name: media_zoom
props.description: How far the media is zoomed in at rest. It eases back to 1 as the frame opens up.

props.name: scroll_distance
props.description: Scroll length of the expansion, in multiples of the stage height.

props.name: hold_distance
props.description: Extra scroll the frame stays pinned at full bleed before releasing.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Follow time in seconds. 0 locks the frame exactly to the scrollbar.

props.name: overlay_scrim
props.description: Strength of the gradient scrim that fades in to keep overlay content readable.

props.name: use_window_scroll
props.description: Drive the expansion from the page scroll instead of the component’s own scroller.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Enable or disable the expansion.

children.$jsx: The frame opens up as you scroll and hands the whole stage to your media.
children.text: The frame opens up as you scroll and hands the whole stage to your media.

name: ShapeBlur
description: A crisp logo or shape that drifts out of focus under the pointer like a camera lens.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape to draw. A rectangle follows the container so it works as a frame.

props.name: src
props.description: URL of an SVG or transparent PNG to use as the shape instead. Its silhouette is traced, so outline, echoes and blur all work on it.

props.name: sides
props.description: Sides of the polygon or points of the star.

props.name: size
props.description: How much of the container the shape fills, from 0 to 1. 1 reaches the edges.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Rounds the corners, from 0 to 1.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line width in pixels.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills the shape instead of drawing its outline.

props.name: echoes
props.description: Number of lines. Outlines nest inward and filled shapes ripple outward.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between echoes in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Line color. Dark colors are drawn for light backgrounds.

props.name: blur
props.description: How far out of focus the lens pushes the shape, in pixels.

props.name: lens_size
props.description: Radius of the lens around the pointer, relative to the shorter side of the container.

props.name: lens_softness
props.description: How gradually the blur fades out toward the edge of the lens, from 0 to 1.

props.name: focus
props.description: Inverts the lens: the shape stays blurred and the pointer brings it into focus.

props.name: chroma
props.description: Color fringing in the blurred parts, like a real lens, from 0 to 1.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees.

props.name: spin
props.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second.

props.name: idle
props.description: Lets the lens drift on its own while the pointer is away.

name: SplashCursor
description: A fluid simulation that trails the cursor in swirling ink and bursts into a splash on click.

props.name: colors
props.description: Palette the ink cycles through when rainbow is off.

props.name: rainbow
props.description: Cycles through the full spectrum instead of the palette.

props.name: color_speed
props.description: How fast the colors shift while you move. 0 keeps one color per stroke.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How much ink each movement leaves behind.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the stroke and the splash.

props.name: force
props.description: How hard the cursor pushes the fluid.

props.name: swirl
props.description: Amount of curling eddies in the flow.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long the ink lingers before it fades. 2 lasts twice as long.

props.name: momentum
props.description: How long the fluid keeps moving after the cursor stops.

props.name: shading
props.description: Depth shading on the ripples, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft bloom around the brightest ink, from 0 to 1.

props.name: quality
props.description: Simulation detail. Lower settings are lighter on older devices.

props.name: click_splash
props.description: Bursts a splash where you click or tap.

props.name: intro
props.description: Plays a short stroke across the screen on mount.

props.name: contained
props.description: Fills the parent element instead of the whole viewport and only reacts inside it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Glowing ink for dark backgrounds or absorbing ink for light ones.

props.name: z_index
props.description: Stacking order of the effect over your content.

name: StarBorder
description: A twinkling star that travels the exact outline of any button, pill or card, trailing light and stardust.

props.name: as_
props.description: Element or component to render, for example a, div or a router Link.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the star and its glow. Defaults to white on dark and ink on light.

props.name: trail_color
props.description: Color the trail fades into behind the star. Defaults to color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one lap around the border. The star keeps the same pace on any shape.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Border width in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels. Values past half the height give a pill.

props.name: trail_length
props.description: Length of the trail as a share of the border. Trails stretch when the star speeds up.

props.name: stars
props.description: Stars spaced evenly around the border, up to 6.

props.name: glow
props.description: Bloom around the star and its trail, from 0 to 1. Light spills onto the surface and the page.

props.name: sparkle
props.description: Puts a small twinkling glint at the front of each trail and lets it shed fine stardust.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the star travels.

props.name: hover
props.description: What happens on hover and keyboard focus. Lap sends the star once around the border, brighten makes the light shine stronger, and reveal keeps it hidden until then.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Sends light racing around the border from the point you press.

props.name: theme
props.description: Picks the default surface, text, border and star colors.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Surface color. Follows the theme when not set.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Text color. Follows the theme when not set.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Color of the resting border the star travels on. Follows the theme when not set.

name: StickerPeel
description: A die-cut sticker you can peel at any edge, drag, throw and swing, in gloss, matte or holographic finishes.

props.name: image_src
props.description: Sticker image. Use a PNG with a transparent background so the die-cut outline shows.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the sticker in pixels.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Resting rotation of the sticker in degrees.

props.name: peel_direction
props.description: Edge that peels, in degrees clockwise from the top. With followPointer it is used when the cursor is near the middle.

props.name: peel_back_hover_pct
props.description: How far the sticker peels back on hover, as a percentage of its size.

props.name: peel_back_active_pct
props.description: How far the sticker peels back while pressed or dragged.

props.name: curl_radius
props.description: Radius of the curl where the sticker bends, in pixels. Larger values feel like thicker vinyl.

props.name: finish
props.description: Surface of the sticker. Holo turns light areas into foil with rainbow bands and glitter.

props.name: back_color
props.description: Color of the back of the sticker, seen on the peeled part.

props.name: lighting_intensity
props.description: Strength of the highlights that follow the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: shadow_intensity
props.description: Strength of the shadows under the sticker and the peeled part, from 0 to 1.

props.name: follow_pointer
props.description: Peels the edge or corner nearest the cursor, and the edge you grab while dragging.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the sticker be picked up, dragged and thrown around its parent.

props.name: swing
props.description: How much the sticker swings around the point you hold while dragging, from 0 to 3.

props.name: friction
props.description: How quickly a thrown sticker slides to a stop, from 0 (ice) to 1 (felt).

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much of its speed a thrown sticker keeps when it hits the edge of its parent.

props.name: intro
props.description: Drops the sticker onto the surface on mount and smooths its corner down.

props.name: initial_position
props.description: Starting position. An object offsets the sticker from the center of its parent, in pixels.

props.name: on_drag_start
props.description: Called when the sticker starts being dragged.

props.name: on_drag_end
props.description: Called when the sticker is released.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Strands
description: Spectral strands that twist inside a frosted glass orb and swell into a smooth bulge where they come together, like the new Siri.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the strands, in order: the red top edge of the bulge, orange, amber, the warm white core, cyan, blue and deep blue. Fewer colors are spread across these roles.

props.name: count
props.description: How many strands show inside the bulge of light, from 1 to 3.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the light turns. 0 holds it still.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: How tall the arch rises and how deeply the ribbon curves.

props.name: waviness
props.description: How tightly the ribbon twists along its length.

props.name: thickness
props.description: How thick the edges of the light are, and the white core where the ribbon turns edge-on.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the soft glow around the light.

props.name: taper
props.description: How quickly the light fades toward the sides of the orb.

props.name: spread
props.description: How wide the ribbon opens, fanning its colors out.

props.name: hue_shift
props.description: Rotates the colors of the light around the color wheel, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness of the light.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Color saturation of the light. 0 is greyscale.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity.

props.name: scale
props.description: Width of the light.

props.name: glass
props.description: Shows the glass orb. Turn it off for the light on its own.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How strongly the edge of the glass bends the light, wrapping the colors around its rim.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Amount of rainbow color separation along the edge of the glass.

props.name: glass_size
props.description: Size of the glass orb.

props.name: rim
props.description: Brightness of the glass rim and the light it catches.

props.name: energy
props.description: How lively the light is on its own, from 0 to 1. 0 rests as a calm white line, 1 keeps the ribbons fully open.

props.name: listening
props.description: Animates the orb as if it were hearing someone speak.

props.name: level
props.description: Drives the orb from your own audio level, from 0 to 1, for example a microphone volume. Overrides listening.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The light tilts toward the cursor and stirs as it gets close.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking sends a burst of motion through the light.

props.name: intro
props.description: The orb fades in and the light unfolds from the center when it first appears.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: For light pages. The orb turns into frosted white glass and the strands use deeper colors with a warm core.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: SwarmCursor
description: A liquid swarm of particles that flows after the cursor, curls into eddies and pours around hovered buttons.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of particles in the swarm, up to 2000.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of each particle, in px.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of each particle.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the particles. Defaults to near black in light mode.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color particles take on when they rush and when you click.

props.name: spread
props.description: Radius of the swarm around the cursor, in px.

props.name: speed
props.description: How lively the swarm churns and turns while the cursor rests.

props.name: swirl
props.description: How much the swarm curls into eddies and how long they keep turning, from 0 (calm) to 1 (stormy).

props.name: tail
props.description: How far the swarm streams behind a fast cursor, from 0 (tight) to 1 (a long trailing tail).

props.name: trail
props.description: Motion blur on fast particles.

props.name: wander
props.description: How restlessly the swarm folds and drifts on its own.

props.name: depth
props.description: How much near particles grow and blur and far ones shrink and fade, from 0 (flat) to 1 (deep).

props.name: targets
props.description: Elements inside the swarm that it pours around while hovered. Pass an empty string to turn this off.

props.name: idle
props.description: What the swarm does while the cursor is away: drift around the area, wait in the middle, or fade out.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: What a click does. Burst splashes the swarm outward in a curl, pulse sends a wave of light through it.

props.name: hide_cursor
props.description: Hides the system cursor over the component and marks the pointer with a dot, so the swarm becomes the cursor.

props.name: intro
props.description: Swirls the swarm in from across the area on mount.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Shows and animates the swarm.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Uses near black particles by default and keeps them crisp, for light backgrounds.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: TargetCursor
description: A reticle cursor whose corner brackets snap around targets, matching their shape.

props.name: target_selector
props.description: CSS selector for the elements the brackets lock onto.

props.name: cursor_color
props.description: Color of the brackets and dot.

props.name: cursor_color_on_target
props.description: Color the cursor blends to while locked onto a target.

props.name: spin_duration
props.description: Seconds per turn while the cursor roams. 0 stops the spin.

props.name: hover_duration
props.description: How long the brackets take to snap onto a target, in seconds.

props.name: parallax_on
props.description: Lets the locked brackets lean slightly toward the cursor.

props.name: hide_default_cursor
props.description: Hides the system cursor while this cursor is shown.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the reticle while roaming, in px.

props.name: corner_size
props.description: Length of each bracket arm, in px.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width of the brackets, in px.

props.name: padding
props.description: Gap between a locked target and the brackets, in px.

props.name: match_radius
props.description: Rounds the brackets to follow the target's corner radius.

props.name: dot_size
props.description: Size of the center dot, in px. 0 hides it.

props.name: blend_mode
props.description: CSS blend mode of the cursor. Difference keeps it visible on any background.

props.name: show_label
props.description: Shows the data-cursor-label text of a locked target above the brackets.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: Squeezes the brackets and dot while the mouse button is held.

props.name: container
props.description: Limits the cursor to one element. By default it works across the whole page.

name: AccordionGallery
description: Panels expand on hover or focus, revealing parallax imagery and captions.

props.name: items
props.description: The panels to render. Each needs an image, and optionally a label, link and alt text.

props.name: default_index
props.description: Index of the panel that is expanded on load, so the gallery never looks dead.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Colour of the caption accent bar and the focus ring.

props.name: overlay_color
props.description: Colour used for the bottom legibility gradient and the dimming of collapsed panels.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Colour of the caption text.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the row in pixels (width of the column when vertical).

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between panels in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of each panel in pixels.

props.name: expand_ratio
props.description: Fraction of the row the expanded panel occupies (0.2 – 0.9).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lay the accordion out as a row or a column.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the expand / collapse transition in seconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing used for every transition.

props.name: parallax
