props.description: Strength of the internal image drift as panels resize (0 disables it).

props.name: tilt
props.description: Degrees of 3D rotation applied to collapsed panels, easing to flat on the open one.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between the caption bar and text reveal, in seconds.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How a panel expands on pointer devices. Focus and tap always expand too.

props.name: show_labels
props.description: Whether captions reveal on the expanded panel.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Desaturate collapsed panels and restore full colour on the expanded one.

name: AnimatedList
description: A scrolling list whose rows spring into view, with a gliding selection and arrow keys.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows to show. Strings become plain rows. Objects can add an icon or image, a description and a label on the right.

props.name: on_item_select
props.description: Called when a row is clicked, or when Enter is pressed on the selected row.

props.name: render_item
props.description: Renders your own content inside each row instead of the built-in layout.

props.name: initial_selected_index
props.description: Which row starts selected. Use -1 for none.

props.name: select_on_hover
props.description: Moves the selection to the row under the cursor.

props.name: enable_arrow_navigation
props.description: Arrow keys, Home and End move the selection while the list is hovered or focused.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wraps keyboard navigation from the last row back to the first.

props.name: animation
props.description: How rows animate in as they scroll into view.

props.name: animate_once
props.description: Animates each row only the first time it appears.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between rows when the list first appears, in seconds.

props.name: show_gradients
props.description: Fades rows out at the top and bottom edges while there is more to scroll.

props.name: fade_size
props.description: Height of the edge fades, in px.

props.name: display_scrollbar
props.description: Shows a thin scrollbar when the list overflows.

props.name: frame
props.description: Shows the frosted panel around the list.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the panel and rows.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of the selection outline. Uses a soft tint of the text color when not set.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the rows, in px.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between rows, in px.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum width of the list.

props.name: max_height
props.description: Height at which the list starts to scroll.

props.name: item_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for each row.

name: BorderGlow
description: Glowing mesh-gradient border that follows cursor direction and intensifies near edges.

props.name: edge_sensitivity
props.description: How close the pointer must be to the edge for the glow to appear (0-100).

props.name: glow_color
props.description: HSL values for the glow color, as "H S L" (e.g. "40 80 80").

props.name: background_color
props.description: Background color of the card.

props.name: border_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the card in pixels.

props.name: glow_radius
props.description: How far the outer glow extends beyond the card in pixels.

props.name: glow_intensity
props.description: Multiplier for glow opacity (0.1-3.0).

props.name: cone_spread
props.description: Width of the directional cone mask as a percentage (5-45).

props.name: animated
props.description: Play an intro sweep animation on mount.

props.name: colors
props.description: Array of 3 hex colors for the mesh gradient border, distributed across positions.

name: BounceCards
description: A fan of photo cards that bounce in, then spread apart and straighten the one you hover.

props.name: images
props.description: Images for the cards, from left to right.

props.name: container_width
props.description: Width of the container in pixels.

props.name: container_height
props.description: Height of the container in pixels.

props.name: card_size
props.description: Width and height of each card in pixels.

props.name: spread
props.description: Horizontal distance between cards in pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Largest tilt in degrees. Each card leans by a different share of it, like a loose pile.

props.name: arc
props.description: Drops the outer cards by this many pixels so the fan curves. Negative values curve it up.

props.name: animation_delay
props.description: Seconds before the first card pops in.

props.name: animation_stagger
props.description: Seconds between cards popping in.

props.name: bounciness
props.description: How much the cards overshoot as they pop in, from 0 to 1.

props.name: enable_hover
props.description: Spreads the cards apart on hover.

props.name: push_distance
props.description: How far the other cards slide away from the hovered one, in pixels.

props.name: hover_scale
props.description: Scale of the hovered card as it straightens and comes to the front.

props.name: border_width
props.description: Width of the card border in pixels.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Color of the card border.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards in pixels.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Soft drop shadow that deepens on hover.

props.name: transform_styles
props.description: Optional custom positions such as "rotate(5deg) translate(-150px)". Overrides spread, rotation and arc.

props.name: on_card_click
props.description: Called with the card index on click or Enter. Cards become focusable buttons when it is set.

name: BubbleMenu
description: Floating circular expanding menu with staggered item reveal.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo content shown in the central bubble (string src or JSX).

props.name: on_menu_click
props.description: Callback fired whenever the menu toggle changes; receives open state.

props.name: menu_aria_label
props.description: Accessible aria-label for the toggle button.

props.name: menu_bg
props.description: Background color for the logo & toggle bubbles and base pill background.

props.name: menu_content_color
props.description: Color for the menu icon lines and default pill text.

props.name: use_fixed_position
props.description: If true positions the menu with fixed instead of absolute (follows viewport).

props.name: items
props.description: Custom menu items; each = { label, href, ariaLabel?, rotation?, hoverStyles?: { bgColor?, textColor? } }.

props.name: animation_ease
props.description: GSAP ease string used for bubble scale-in animation.

props.name: animation_duration
props.description: Duration (s) for each bubble & label animation.

props.name: stagger_delay
props.description: Base stagger (s) between bubble animations (with slight random variance).

name: CardNav
description: A navigation bar that springs open into a row of cards, each with its own links.

props.name: logo
props.description: Image URL or element shown in the middle of the bar.

props.name: logo_alt
props.description: Accessible label for the logo link.

props.name: logo_href
props.description: Where the logo links to.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards in the menu. Give a card a bgColor to tint it, and links without an href render as buttons.

props.name: cta
props.description: Button on the right of the bar. On narrow screens it moves to the bottom of the menu.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color scheme of the bar, cards and button.

props.name: surface
props.description: Frosted glass that blurs what is behind the bar, or an opaque fill.

props.name: open_on
props.description: Opens the menu from the button, or as soon as the pointer moves over the bar.

props.name: card_effect
props.description: How the cards arrive: rising into place, folding down from the bar, or fading in from a soft blur.

props.name: stagger
props.description: How far each card trails the one before it, from 0 to 0.3.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the menu overshoots as it opens, from 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the open and close animation.

props.name: card_height
props.description: Minimum height of the cards in px.

props.name: max_width
props.description: Maximum width of the bar in px.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of the button. Its label picks black or white for contrast.

props.name: menu_label
props.description: Shows Menu and Close next to the menu icon, rolling between them.

props.name: intro
props.description: Unrolls the bar from its center on mount.

props.name: default_open
props.description: Starts with the menu open.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls the menu from outside. Pair it with onOpenChange.

props.name: on_open_change
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: link_component
props.description: Renders the links, so you can pass your router's link. It receives href, className and children.

props.name: on_link_click
props.description: Called when a link is clicked. The menu closes afterwards.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

items.label: About
items.description: The people and the story behind the studio.

items.label: Projects
items.description: Selected work from the last few years.

name: CardSwap
description: A 3D stack of cards that sends the front card to the back on a timer, or when you fling it.

props.name: items
props.description: Cards to show when no children are passed. Each item takes title, image, icon and alt.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of each card, in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of each card, in px.

props.name: card_distance
props.description: Horizontal step between stacked cards, in px.

props.name: vertical_distance
props.description: Vertical step between stacked cards, in px.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far back each card sits, in px. More depth makes the cards behind smaller.

props.name: skew_amount
props.description: Slant of the cards, in degrees.

props.name: visible_cards
props.description: How many cards show in the stack. Extra cards wait hidden at the back.

props.name: delay
props.description: Time between swaps, in ms.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Sends the front card to the back on a timer.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Pauses the timer while the cursor is over a card.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people drag or fling the front card to send it to the back.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the swap animation.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the cards overshoot as they settle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How much the stack shifts in depth as the cursor moves, from 0 to 1.

props.name: hover_spread
props.description: How much the stack fans out while hovered.

props.name: dim
props.description: How much the cards behind fade back, from 0 to 1.

props.name: card_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards, in px.

props.name: intro
props.description: Fans the cards out from the front one on mount.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the cards.

props.name: on_card_click
props.description: Called when a card is clicked. Clicking a card behind also brings it to the front.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called with the index of the new front card after each swap.

name: CardSwap
description: A card inside a CardSwap.

props.name: custom_class
props.description: Extra class name for the card.

name: Carousel
description: Swipeable cards for feature tours, stories and galleries, with five transitions and an autoplay timer.

props.name: items
props.description: Cards to show. Objects with image, icon, title, description and alt get the built-in card, strings are used as image URLs and React elements are rendered as they are.

props.name: base_width
props.description: Width of the carousel in px, or any CSS width. It never grows past its container.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Width of a card divided by its height.

props.name: peek
props.description: Space on each side of the active card where the neighbours show, in px. Works with slide and scale.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the cards in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards in px.

props.name: frame
props.description: Holds the cards and controls in a panel that masks the cards as they slide out. Without it the cards fade out at the edges.

props.name: effect
props.description: How the cards move from one to the next.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Navigation under the cards. Bars fill up with the autoplay timer.

props.name: arrows
props.description: Shows previous and next buttons.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Moves to the next card on a timer.

props.name: autoplay_delay
props.description: Time on each card in ms while autoplay is on.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Pauses autoplay while the pointer is over the carousel.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wraps around from the last card to the first and back.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people drag, swipe or scroll sideways through the cards.

props.name: round
props.description: Turns the cards into circles.

props.name: initial_index
props.description: Card shown first.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color scheme of the cards, frame and controls.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called with the index of the new card whenever it changes.

items.title: Open fields
items.description: Bright skies over rapeseed in full bloom.

items.title: Moonrise
items.description: The same field, quiet under a full moon.

items.title: The pier
items.description: Clear water and a long walk out.

name: ChromaGrid
description: A grid of grayscale photo cards where a spotlight follows the cursor and brings back color.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards to show. Each item takes image, title, subtitle, accent and url. With a url the whole card becomes a link.

props.name: columns
props.description: The most columns the grid shows.

props.name: min_card_width
props.description: Narrowest a card can get, in px. The grid drops columns to keep cards at least this wide.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cards, in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Size of the color spotlight, in px.

props.name: softness
props.description: How gradually the spotlight fades at its edge, from 0 for a crisp circle to 1 for a soft glow.

props.name: damping
props.description: How smoothly the spotlight trails the cursor. 0 follows it exactly.

props.name: fade_out
props.description: How long the colors take to fade back to gray after the cursor leaves, in seconds.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: How much color is drained outside the spotlight, from 0 to 1.

props.name: dim
props.description: How much images darken outside the spotlight.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of each card's accent color glowing up from the bottom as it is revealed.

props.name: border_glow
props.description: Strength of each card's border lighting up in its accent color near the cursor.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Reveal color in a soft spotlight that follows the cursor, or one whole card at a time on hover.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Aspect ratio of the images, as a CSS aspect-ratio value.

props.name: card_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards, in px.

props.name: show_info
props.description: Shows the title and subtitle under each image.

props.name: frame
props.description: Wraps the grid in a frosted glass panel.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the cards.

name: CircularCarousel
description: A 3D ring of images with bendable cards, momentum drag, snapping and click to focus.

props.name: items
props.description: Images placed around the ring. The alt text is announced to screen readers, the title and optional subtitle are shown by captions. Passing a new list of the same length crossfades each card to its new image.

props.name: preset
props.description: Shape of the ring. Cylinder faces the cards outward, orbit keeps every card turned toward you, wheel spins top to bottom, and panorama puts the camera inside the ring.

props.name: intro
props.description: Entrance once the images load. Assemble glides the cards in from a wider ring, rise slides them in one by one from the edge of the frame, and spin lands a fast turn.

props.name: card_width
props.description: Card width in px. The whole ring scales down to fit its container when it needs to.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Card width divided by its height. Images are cropped to fill the card.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between neighbouring cards, in px.

props.name: curve
props.description: How far the cards bend to follow the ring, from flat at 0 to fully wrapped at 1. Ignored by orbit.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Camera angle in degrees. Negative values look down onto the ring.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Camera distance in px. Lower values exaggerate depth. Panorama sets its own, since the camera sits at the centre.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Drift turns the ring continuously, step moves one card at a time and settles on it, off only moves when you do.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed in degrees per second.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between moves in step mode.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the front cards travel. A flick changes it to the way you threw the ring. On the wheel, left means up.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets you grab and throw the ring with a mouse, finger or horizontal trackpad scroll.

props.name: momentum
props.description: How long a throw keeps gliding before it blends back into the autoplay speed, from 0 to 1.

props.name: snap
props.description: Settles on a card whenever the ring comes to rest.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Eases the ring to a stop while the pointer is over it.

props.name: focus_on_click
props.description: Clicking a card turns it to the front.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How much the camera leans toward the pointer, from 0 to 1.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much the ring swells outward when it spins fast, from 0 to 1.

props.name: depth_fade
props.description: How strongly cards fade into fadeColor as they turn away, from 0 to 1.

props.name: fade_color
props.description: Color distant cards fade toward. Match it to the background behind the carousel.

props.name: inner_shade
props.description: Brightness of the inside faces seen through the back of the ring, from 0 to 1.

props.name: corner_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards, in px.

props.name: captions
props.description: Shows the front card title, subtitle and position under the ring.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called when a different card reaches the front.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when a card is clicked, or when Enter is pressed on the carousel.

name: CircularGallery
description: A curved image gallery you can drag, scroll or tab through, with cards that open to the full image.

props.name: items
props.description: Images to show. `text` is the title under each card, `description` appears under the title when a card is open and `alt` names the image for screen readers.

props.name: bend
props.description: Curvature of the arc. Positive values arch the cards down at the edges, negative values lift them, 0 lays them flat.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the titles, the keyboard focus ring and the placeholder shown while images load.

props.name: border_radius
props.description: Corner radius as a fraction of the card size, from 0 (square) to 0.5 (fully round).

props.name: font
props.description: CSS font shorthand for the titles. The size scales with the cards, so 30px means the default size and larger values make the titles bigger.

props.name: font_url
props.description: Font to load for the titles. Accepts a stylesheet URL (e.g. a Google Fonts link) or a font file (.woff2, .woff, .ttf, .otf). The loaded family replaces the family in `font`.

props.name: scroll_speed
props.description: How far the gallery travels per drag or wheel movement.

props.name: scroll_ease
props.description: How quickly the gallery catches up with the input, from 0.001 (floaty) to 1 (instant).

props.name: item_size
props.description: Card height relative to the container, from 0.2 to 2.

props.name: item_aspect
props.description: Card width divided by height. Images are cropped to fill the card.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cards as a fraction of the card width.

props.name: wave
props.description: How much the cards ripple while the gallery moves. 0 keeps them flat.

props.name: fade_edges
props.description: Fades the cards out toward the left and right edges, from 0 to 0.5 of the width.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Strength of the soft shadow under each card.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Shows the images in grayscale and brings the color back on hover, focus or when opened.

props.name: show_titles
props.description: Shows the title of each card underneath it.

props.name: snap
props.description: Settles on the nearest card after dragging or scrolling.

props.name: auto_scroll
props.description: Speed of an automatic drift, where 1 moves about one card every four seconds and negative values drift the other way. It pauses on hover, while dragging, while a card is open and briefly after any input.

props.name: open_on_click
props.description: Clicking a card opens it to its full image. Click it again, click outside it, press Escape or use the close button to return. When off, clicking a card centers it.

props.name: intro
props.description: Glides the cards in when the gallery mounts.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when a card is clicked.

props.name: on_active_change
props.description: Called when a different card becomes the centered one.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Counter
description: An odometer-style number whose digits roll to every new value, with currency, separators and locales.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to show. Digits roll to every new value.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale used for separators, symbols and numerals.

props.name: format
props.description: Formatting options such as currency, percent, units or compact notation.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fixed number of decimal places. Leave it out to use the format defaults.

props.name: min_digits
props.description: Pads the whole part with leading zeros.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content shown before the number.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content shown after the number.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way digits roll. Auto rolls up as the number grows and down as it shrinks.

props.name: duration
props.description: Roughly how long a roll takes, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much digits overshoot before settling, from 0 to 0.9.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay in seconds between neighbouring digits, so changes ripple from the right.

props.name: motion_blur
props.description: Blurs digits along their path while they spin fast.

props.name: intro
props.description: Spins every digit once and lands it when the counter first scrolls into view.

props.name: fade
props.description: How far in em digits roll beyond the text before fading out. 0 clips them at the edge.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size in px, or any CSS size such as inherit.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Font weight of the number.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the number.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between digits and symbols in px.

props.name: padding
props.description: Extra height in px added to each digit, which also spaces out rolling digits.

props.name: tabular
props.description: Keeps every digit the same width. When off, widths ease between digits as they roll.

props.name: digit_style
props.description: Styles for each digit box, for example a tile background with padding and radius.

name: CurvedInput
description: Arc-bent input bar with text, caret and submit button all following the curve.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; leave undefined for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when the input is uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called with the new value on every keystroke.

props.name: on_submit
props.description: Called when the button is pressed or Enter is hit.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text rendered along the curve when empty.

props.name: button_text
props.description: Label of the curved submit button.

props.name: type
props.description: Semantic input type; email/number map to the matching mobile keyboard.

props.name: name
props.description: Name attribute forwarded to the underlying input.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible label; falls back to the placeholder.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color preset; any explicit color prop overrides its theme value.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the input bar (pixels or any CSS width value, e.g. "100%").

props.name: bend
props.description: How many pixels the center of the bar arches above its ends; negative bends downward, 0 is flat.

props.name: height
props.description: Thickness of the input bar in pixels.

props.name: corner_radius
props.description: Corner rounding of the bar; the button rounds proportionally.

props.name: border_width
props.description: Outline stroke width in pixels.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the curved text and button label.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Fill color of the input bar; overrides the theme.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the typed text and caret; overrides the theme.

props.name: placeholder_color
props.description: Color of the placeholder text; overrides the theme.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Color of the outline stroke; overrides the theme.

props.name: button_color
props.description: Fill of the submit button, the focus ring and the default icon chip; overrides the theme.

props.name: button_text_color
props.description: Color of the button label; overrides the theme.

props.name: icon_color
props.description: Fill of the icon chip; defaults to the button color.

props.name: shadow_size
props.description: Size of the soft drop shadow under the bar.

props.name: shadow_color
props.description: Tint of the drop shadow; overrides the theme.

props.name: show_button
props.description: Render the curved submit button.

props.name: show_icon
props.description: Render the leading icon chip.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom SVG content for the icon, centered at the origin; replaces the default envelope chip.

name: DecayCard
description: An image card that tears and melts as the pointer moves, then pulls itself back together.

props.name: image
props.description: Image URL. It fills the card like a cover.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Card height in pixels.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How far the image tears apart at full decay, from 0 to 2. The edges tear the most so the photo stays readable.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: How little pointer movement it takes to reach full decay, from 0 to 1.

props.name: hover_decay
props.description: Decay that stays while the pointer rests on the card, from 0 to 1.

props.name: recovery
props.description: Seconds the image takes to pull itself back together once the pointer slows down.

props.name: grain
props.description: Size of the tears, from broad melting shapes at 0 to fine shards at 1.

props.name: detail
props.description: Layers of noise in the tears, from 1 to 8. More layers give rougher edges.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Picks a different tear pattern.

props.name: idle
props.description: Keeps the edges slowly fraying and soft patches drifting while nobody interacts, from 0 to 1.

props.name: flow
props.description: Lets the tears churn while the card is decaying. 0 keeps them still.

props.name: chroma
props.description: Splits the color channels apart inside the tears.

props.name: travel
props.description: How far in pixels the card drifts toward the pointer before it slows down.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far in degrees the card rotates as the pointer moves sideways.

props.name: scope
props.description: Window follows the pointer anywhere on the page. Card only reacts while it is hovered.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the image in pixels.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Shows the image in grayscale.

name: DepthCarousel
description: Cards recede into depth on a 3D rail, with drag, keyboard and auto-advance.

props.name: items
props.description: Slides to display. Pass image URLs or objects with an image URL and alt text.

props.name: card_width
props.description: Width of each card in pixels.

props.name: card_height
props.description: Height of each card in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner rounding of the cards in pixels.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour multiplied over cards as they recede, shading the depth of the stack.

props.name: depth
props.description: Z distance in pixels between each card along the depth rail. Higher values push the stack further back.

props.name: spread
props.description: Lateral offset in pixels applied per card so the stack fans out to one side.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Degrees each receding card rotates around the vertical axis, revealing its edge.

props.name: tilt_direction
props.description: Which side the stack fans and tilts toward.

props.name: perspective
props.description: CSS perspective in pixels. Lower values exaggerate the depth foreshortening.

props.name: visible_cards
props.description: How many cards deep remain visible before further ones fade out.

props.name: falloff
props.description: How quickly brightness, tint and blur ramp up with depth.

props.name: blur
props.description: Maximum blur in pixels applied to the furthest visible card.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the advance transition in milliseconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing used for navigation transitions.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Auto-advance the carousel, pausing on hover or focus.

props.name: autoplay_delay
props.description: Delay between auto-advances in milliseconds.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap seamlessly from the last card back to the first.

props.name: show_controls
props.description: Show the previous / next arrow buttons.

props.name: show_indicators
props.description: Show the dot indicators.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called whenever the focused card changes.

name: Dock
description: macOS style dock with smooth magnification, launch bounce, badges and context menus.

props.name: items
props.description: The apps in the dock. Each item takes an icon, label and onClick, plus optional className, active (an open app, shown with a dot), badge (a number, text, or true for a plain dot) and menu. Add { separator: true } to divide groups.

props.name: position
props.description: The edge of the nearest positioned parent the dock sits on. Icons grow away from that edge and the dock stands vertically on the left and right.

props.name: theme
props.description: Colors of the panel, tiles, labels and menus, made for dark or light pages.

props.name: base_item_size
props.description: Size of each icon at rest, in px. The dock shrinks everything evenly when its parent is too small to fit it.

props.name: magnification
props.description: Size of the icon right under the pointer, in px. Set it to baseItemSize to turn magnifying off.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far from the pointer icons still grow, in px. Larger values spread the swell over more icons.

props.name: panel_height
props.description: Thickness of the dock bar, in px. Icons rise out of it as they grow.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between icons, in px.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Corner rounding of the tiles and the bar, from square at 0 to circles at 1.

props.name: spring
props.description: The spring icons grow and shrink with. Higher stiffness is faster, and low damping lets icons overshoot and wobble.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Icons hop when clicked, like apps launching on macOS.

props.name: auto_hide
props.description: Slides the dock off its edge until the pointer comes near that edge of the parent. It stays out while hovered, focused or showing a menu.

props.name: tiles
props.description: Draws a rounded tile behind each icon. Turn it off for bare glyphs, or when your icons are full app artwork.

props.name: show_labels
props.description: Shows the label of the hovered or focused icon in a tooltip.

props.name: show_indicators
props.description: Shows a dot next to items marked active, like open apps on macOS.

props.name: show_badges
props.description: Shows the notification badges set on items.

props.name: badge_color
props.description: Fill color of the notification badges.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of the highlighted row in menus and of the keyboard focus ring.

name: DomeGallery
description: Immersive 3D dome gallery projecting images on a hemispheric surface.

props.name: images
props.description: Array of image URLs (strings) or image objects with src and optional alt text

props.name: fit
props.description: Size factor for the dome radius based on container dimensions

props.name: fit_basis
props.description: Basis for calculating the dome size

props.name: min_radius
props.description: Minimum radius for the dome in pixels

props.name: max_radius
props.description: Maximum radius for the dome in pixels

props.name: pad_factor
props.description: Padding factor for the viewer area

props.name: overlay_blur_color
props.description: Color for the outer portion of the radial overlay blur

props.name: max_vertical_rotation_deg
props.description: Maximum vertical rotation angle in degrees

props.name: drag_sensitivity
props.description: Sensitivity of drag interactions

props.name: enlarge_transition_ms
props.description: Duration of image enlargement transition in milliseconds

props.name: segments
props.description: Number of segments for both X and Y to keep the dome proportional

props.name: drag_dampening
props.description: Damping factor for drag inertia (0-1, higher = more damping)

props.name: opened_image_width
props.description: Width of the enlarged image

props.name: opened_image_height
props.description: Height of the enlarged image

props.name: image_border_radius
props.description: Border radius for closed tile images

props.name: opened_image_border_radius
props.description: Border radius for opened/enlarged images

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Whether to render all images in grayscale

name: DriftWall
description: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past, lifting on hover.

props.name: items
props.description: Tiles to display. Each item has { image, title?, href? }.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of drifting columns.

props.name: tile_width
props.description: Width of each tile in pixels.

props.name: tile_height
props.description: Height of each tile in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between tiles and columns in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of each tile in pixels.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Perspective pitch of the wall (rotateX, degrees).

props.name: turn
props.description: Perspective yaw of the wall (rotateY, degrees).

props.name: roll
props.description: In-plane rotation of the wall (rotateZ, degrees).

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in pixels — smaller is more dramatic.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the wall sits back from the viewer in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Base drift speed in pixels per second.

props.name: direction
props.description: Primary drift direction; columns alternate around it.

props.name: variance
props.description: How much column speeds differ from each other (0–1).

props.name: parallax
props.description: Pointer-follow tilt strength (0 disables it).

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Pause the whole wall while the pointer is over it.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far a hovered tile lifts toward the viewer in pixels.

props.name: fade
props.description: Strength of the edge and depth dissolve (0–1).

props.name: dim
props.description: Resting opacity of unhovered tiles (0–1).

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Desaturate resting tiles; hover restores colour.

props.name: overlay_color
props.description: Tint laid over resting tiles, cleared on hover.

name: ElasticSlider
description: A slider that grows under your cursor and stretches like rubber when pulled past either end, then springs back.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair it with onChange.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: starting_value
props.description: Lowest value of the range.

props.name: max_value
props.description: Highest value of the range.

props.name: is_stepped
props.description: Snaps the value to stepSize increments.

props.name: step_size
props.description: Size of each step when isStepped is on.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called as the value changes.

props.name: on_change_end
props.description: Called when a drag, key press or scroll finishes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the track. Vertical sliders fill from the bottom.

props.name: left_icon
props.description: Icon at the start of the track. Pass null to hide it.

props.name: right_icon
props.description: Icon at the end of the track. Pass null to hide it.

props.name: icon_placement
props.description: Puts the icons beside the track, or inside it once the track is thick enough to hold them.

props.name: value_position
props.description: Where the value shows. Bubble rides above the fill while the slider is active.

props.name: format_value
props.description: Formats the shown value and the value read by screen readers.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Marks along the track. True marks every step, or every tenth when not stepped. An array marks those values.

props.name: thumb
props.description: Shows a round handle at the end of the fill.

props.name: fill_from
props.description: Value the fill grows from. Set it to the middle of the range for a centered, two-way fill.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Track thickness in px at rest.

props.name: active_thickness
props.description: Track thickness in px while hovered, focused or dragged.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the track in px. Fully round when left out.

props.name: rest_opacity
props.description: Opacity while idle. The slider brightens to full when active.

props.name: grow_on_hover
props.description: Hovering activates the slider. When off it only grows while pressed or focused.

props.name: max_stretch
props.description: Furthest the track stretches in px when pulled past an end. 0 turns the stretch off.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the track wobbles as it springs back, from 0 to 0.95.

props.name: jump_to_click
props.description: Pressing the track jumps to the pointer. When off, dragging moves the value from where it was.

props.name: wheel
props.description: Lets the scroll wheel change the value.

props.name: track_color
props.description: Color of the empty track.

props.name: range_color
props.description: Color of the fill.

props.name: icon_color
props.description: Color of the outside icons.

props.name: content_color
props.description: Color of icons, values and ticks over the empty track.

props.name: fill_content_color
props.description: Color of icons, values and ticks over the fill. Auto picks light or dark from the fill color.

props.name: thumb_color
props.description: Color of the handle.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns off interaction and dims the slider.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the slider.

name: FlexCarousel
description: An infinite image row that flows through invisible liquid glass at its edges.

props.name: items
props.description: Images shown in the row. Each keeps its natural aspect ratio unless fit is set. The alt text is announced to screen readers, the title and optional subtitle are shown above the row.

props.name: preset
props.description: A starting shape for the invisible glass. Every lens prop below overrides the preset value when you pass it.

props.name: intro
props.description: Entrance once the images load. Rise lifts the cards in from below, bloom fades them in while the bend forms, spin lands a fast flick, deal spreads the cards from the middle. Any input skips it.

props.name: card_height
props.description: Card height as a fraction of the container height.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cards, in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards, in px.

props.name: fit
props.description: Card shape. Natural keeps each image uncropped, the others crop every card to the same shape.

props.name: lens_width
props.description: Width of the invisible glass as a fraction of the container width.

props.name: lens_height
props.description: Height of the invisible glass as a fraction of the container width, so the bend keeps its shape at any size.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Rotation of the glass in degrees. It decides where its edge crosses the row.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Shape of the glass, from a rounded rectangle at 0 to a perfect ellipse at 1.

props.name: bend
props.description: How far the row flexes where it passes the edge of the glass. The glass itself is never drawn and the images always stay connected.

props.name: reach
props.description: Width of the curved edge of the glass. Small values give a tight kink, large values a long smooth bend.

props.name: curl
props.description: Which way the ends of the row flex. Twist sends the left end down and the right end up, rise lifts both, fall drops both.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Rainbow splitting of light, only where the edge of the glass bends the images.

props.name: liquid
props.description: How much the glass stretches and wobbles like a liquid when the row moves. Off in every preset.

props.name: follow_cursor
props.description: Let the lens drift after the cursor like a loupe, and return to the center when it leaves.

props.name: squeeze
props.description: How much the cards shrink while the row moves fast. 0 keeps them at full size.

props.name: focus_on_click
props.description: Clicking a card centers it and opens it: the others part, the bend melts away and the card grows. Click, drag, scroll or Escape closes it.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Advance one card at a time. Pauses on hover, focus and interaction, and when reduced motion is on.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between autoplay steps.

props.name: captions
props.description: Show the title of the centered card above the row and a counter below it.

props.name: capture_wheel
props.description: Let a vertical mouse wheel scroll the carousel while hovering. Horizontal wheels and trackpads always scroll it.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called whenever a different card reaches the center.

props.name: on_select
props.description: Called when the centered card is clicked or Enter is pressed. Clicking a side card centers it first.

items.alt: A figure on a white set
items.title: White Room

name: FlowingMenu
description: A full-height menu with a liquid band that glides between rows and reveals a scrolling marquee of each item.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu rows. marquee changes the text that scrolls in the band and meta adds a note at the end of the row.

props.name: speed
props.description: Marquee speed in px per second.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the marquee runs. Alternate flips every other row.

props.name: follow_cursor
props.description: How much moving the cursor sideways speeds up or reverses the marquee, from 0 to 1.

props.name: duration
props.description: Time in seconds the band takes to glide to a row.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much the band stretches like liquid while it moves, from 0 for rigid to 1.

props.name: magnet
props.description: How much the band leans toward the cursor inside a row, from 0 to 1.

props.name: band_inset
props.description: Gap in px between the band and the row edges.

props.name: band_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the band in px. Use a large value for a pill.

props.name: carry_content
props.description: Moves the marquee with the band instead of keeping it fixed in each row.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the menu text.

props.name: bg_color
props.description: Background color of the menu.

props.name: marquee_bg_color
props.description: Background color of the band.

props.name: marquee_text_color
props.description: Text color inside the band.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Color of the lines between rows.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Draws lines between rows.

props.name: dim_inactive
props.description: Fades the other rows while the band is on one.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the row labels.

props.name: show_index
props.description: Numbers each row.

props.name: show_arrow
props.description: Adds an arrow to the end of each row.

props.name: image_shape
props.description: Shape of the images in the band.

props.name: intro
props.description: Rows rise in, the lines draw and the band sweeps once down the menu on mount.

props.name: active_index
props.description: Marks the current page row.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when a row is clicked.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

name: FluidGlass
description: A 3D glass object that refracts your headline, image or video, follows the cursor and melts between shapes.

props.name: text
props.description: Headline drawn behind the glass, so the glass can bend it. Use \n for line breaks. It takes the font and color of the container unless you set them.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the text. Defaults to the CSS color.

props.name: font_family
props.description: Font of the text. Defaults to the font of the container.

props.name: font_weight
props.description: Weight of the text.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Size of the text in px. By default it scales to fill the width.

props.name: src
props.description: Image or video behind the glass. Videos (.mp4, .webm, .mov) play muted on a loop. Files from another site need CORS headers.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the image or video fills the area.

props.name: background
props.description: Color behind the text and media. Transparent lets your page show through.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the glass. The blob is a drop of liquid glass that keeps rippling. Changing the shape melts the glass smoothly into the new one.

props.name: shapes
props.description: Shapes the glass cycles through when clicked.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the glass in px. It shrinks to fit small areas.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How strongly the glass bends light, from 0 to 2. Around 0.66 behaves like water.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: How much light splits into rainbow fringes at the edges, from 0 to 1.

props.name: reflection
props.description: Strength of the highlights and reflections on the surface, from 0 to 2.

props.name: frost
props.description: Frosts the glass so what is behind it blurs, from 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the glass.

props.name: tint
props.description: How strongly the glass takes on its color. Thicker parts look deeper, like real colored glass.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Strength of the shadow and the focused light the glass casts below it, from 0 to 1.

props.name: elevation
props.description: How high the glass floats above the content. Higher magnifies more, until the image flips.

props.name: interaction
props.description: How the glass responds: it glides after the cursor, it can be picked up and thrown around, or it stays in place.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: How lazily the glass follows, from 0 (snappy) to 1 (floaty).

props.name: wobble
props.description: How much the glass stretches when it moves and wobbles when it stops, like a liquid. 0 keeps it rigid.

props.name: spin
props.description: Idle rotation speed for shapes like the cube and the torus. Negative values spin the other way.

props.name: idle
props.description: The glass drifts gently around its resting place while nobody interacts.

props.name: morph_on_click
props.description: Clicking the glass melts it into the next shape.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the glass rests, as fractions of the width and height.

props.name: intro
props.description: The glass pops into place on mount.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: FlyingPosters
description: 3D posters that twist and flip as you scroll or drag through an endless column.

props.name: items
props.description: Images for the posters. Each one is cropped to fill its poster, and they repeat to fill the view.

props.name: plane_width
props.description: Width of each poster in pixels at the default camera.

props.name: plane_height
props.description: Height of each poster in pixels at the default camera.

props.name: distortion
props.description: How far one corner of a poster turns ahead of the other, which gives the twist.

props.name: scroll_ease
props.description: How quickly the posters catch up with the wheel and drag. Lower values glide longer.

props.name: camera_fov
props.description: Field of view of the camera in degrees. Wider angles zoom out.

props.name: camera_z
props.description: Distance of the camera from the posters. Higher values show them smaller and flatter, lower values bring them close with stronger perspective.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between posters in pixels. Defaults to the original spacing, which follows the camera.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of poster columns.

props.name: column_gap
props.description: Space between columns in pixels.

props.name: alternate
props.description: Moves every other column in the opposite direction.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the posters in pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: How far each poster turns while it crosses the view, in degrees.

props.name: axis
props.description: Axis the posters turn around.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift in pixels per second while nobody scrolls. Negative values drift down.

props.name: lean
props.description: How far the posters lean back with fast scrolling.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the posters out toward the top and bottom edges, from 0 to 1.

props.name: shading
props.description: Darkens the posters as they turn away, from 0 to 1.

props.name: wheel
props.description: Scrolls the posters with the mouse wheel while hovered.

props.name: drag
props.description: Scrolls the posters by dragging them.

props.name: page_scroll
props.description: Moves the posters along with the page scroll, as a multiplier. 0 turns it off.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when a poster is clicked or tapped.

name: Folder
description: Folder that drops its flap open or swings open like a book, with pages you can pick.

props.name: items
props.description: What the folder holds, up to 6. Each item can be a string, { title, description }, { image, title, alt }, { content } or a React element.

props.name: label
props.description: Text on the tab. The tab grows to fit it.

props.name: mode
props.description: flap stands the folder up and drops the front flap open. book lays it flat and swings the cover over like a book.

props.name: variant
props.description: Material of the folder. glass turns the front into refracting glass that shows the pages inside.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the folder. Shades are derived from it.

props.name: paper_color
props.description: Color of the pages.

props.name: tab_position
props.description: Where the tab sits along the top edge.

props.name: layout
props.description: How the items are laid out once the folder is open.

props.name: size
props.description: Scale of the whole folder.

props.name: open_on
props.description: Opens the folder on click, or while the cursor is over it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls the folder from outside. Leave it out to let the folder manage itself.

props.name: default_open
props.description: Starts the folder open.

props.name: on_open_change
props.description: Called when the folder opens or closes.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when an item is clicked while the folder is open or after it was dragged out.

props.name: on_item_drop
props.description: Called when a dragged item is let go, with whether it landed back in the folder.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets people drag items out of the folder, leave them anywhere and drop them back in.

props.name: zoom_on_click
props.description: Clicking an item brings it up close. Click it again, press Escape or click away to put it back.

props.name: peek
props.description: Teases the items out on hover. In flap mode the page under the cursor rises highest.

props.name: intro
props.description: Plays an entrance when the folder scrolls into view: the pages drop in and the folder closes over them.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How much the folder tilts toward the cursor, from 0 to 1.5.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the flap, cover and pages overshoot as they settle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of every animation.

props.name: frost
props.description: How much the glass front blurs what is behind it, from 0 for clear glass to 1. Used by the glass variant.

props.name: close_on_outside_click
props.description: Closes the folder on a click outside it or on Escape.

props.name: theme
props.description: Tunes the shadows for dark or light pages.

name: GlassIcons
description: Liquid glass icons that bend the color behind them, for app grids, docks and social links.

props.name: items
props.description: Icons to show. Each item takes an icon, a label and a color, plus an optional href, target, onClick, id and className. Color is a preset name (blue, purple, red, indigo, orange, green, teal, pink, graphite, silver) or any CSS color or gradient.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of each icon in px.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the icons in px.

props.name: columns
props.description: Icons per row. They wrap to fewer columns when there is not enough room.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Corner rounding, from 0 for square to 1 for a circle.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How strongly the glass bends what is behind it around its edge. Works in Chromium browsers.

props.name: bevel
props.description: Width of the curved glass edge, from 0 to 1.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Rainbow fringing where the edge bends the light, from 0 to 1.

props.name: frost
props.description: How much the glass blurs what is behind it, from 0 to 1.

props.name: shine
props.description: Strength of the light catching the glass edge, from 0 to 1.

props.name: tint
props.description: Color of the glass.

props.name: tint_opacity
props.description: How strongly the tint colors the glass, from 0 to 1.

props.name: icon_color
props.description: Color of the icons on the glass. Defaults to white, or near black on clear glass in the light theme.

props.name: plate
props.description: Colored shape behind the glass: a tilted card, a shifted card, a disc or nothing for clear glass.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Angle of the tilted card in degrees.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the shifted card or disc peeks out from behind the glass, from 0 to 1.

props.name: hover
props.description: Hover animation. Lift raises the glass and swings the card, float raises the glass and press pushes it in.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the card behind the glass drifts with the pointer, from 0 to 1.

props.name: labels
props.description: When the labels under the icons are shown.

props.name: intro
props.description: Plays an entrance the first time the icons scroll into view: the glass settles and the cards swing out.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color scheme of the labels and glass edges.

name: GlassSurface
description: Apple-style liquid glass that bends what is behind it, in a rounded panel or any logo shape.

props.name: width
props.description: Width in px, or any CSS value like '100%'.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px, or any CSS value like '100vh'.

props.name: border_radius
props.description: Corner radius in px. Not used with a shape.

props.name: border_width
props.description: Width of the bending edge, as a fraction of the shorter side.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Brightness of the calm center, in %. 50 leaves it undistorted.

props.name: opacity
props.description: How strongly the calm center holds the view still, from 0 to 1.

props.name: blur
props.description: Softness of the transition from the bending edge to the calm center, in px.

props.name: displace
props.description: Blurs the light coming through the glass, for a frosted look.

props.name: background_opacity
props.description: Opacity of a soft frosted tint over the glass, from 0 to 1.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Saturation of what is seen through the glass.

props.name: distortion_scale
props.description: How strongly the edge bends what is behind it. Negative values pull the view inward.

props.name: red_offset
props.description: Extra bending for the red channel. Different offsets split light into colored fringes.

props.name: green_offset
props.description: Extra bending for the green channel.

props.name: blue_offset
props.description: Extra bending for the blue channel.

props.name: x_channel
props.description: Channel of the displacement map that moves pixels sideways.

props.name: y_channel
props.description: Channel of the displacement map that moves pixels up and down.

props.name: mix_blend_mode
props.description: How the two edge gradients of the displacement map are combined.

props.name: refraction
props.description: Bends what is behind the glass at its edges. Set it to false to use the frosted glass look everywhere.

props.name: renderer
props.description: How the glass bends light. Auto uses SVG filters in Chromium, which bend anything behind the glass, and WebGL in Safari and Firefox when a backdrop is given. Without a backdrop, those browsers get a frosted glass look. WebGL forces the WebGL glass whenever a backdrop is given.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: The image, video or canvas behind the glass. WebGL can only bend what it is given, so pass this to get real refraction outside Chromium. Images from another origin need CORS headers.

props.name: shape
props.description: URL of an SVG or transparent PNG that gives the glass its outline, fitted inside the width and height. Files from another origin need CORS headers.

name: GooeyNav
description: A navigation bar whose active pill breaks into goo that flows over to the item you pick.

props.name: items
props.description: The navigation items. Items without an href render as buttons.

props.name: initial_active_index
props.description: Which item starts selected.

props.name: active_index
props.description: Controls the selected item yourself. Use it together with onChange.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called when an item is selected.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the frame and text.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the active pill. Uses a high-contrast color for the theme when not set.

props.name: active_text_color
props.description: Text color inside the pill. Picked automatically from the pill color when not set.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors for the droplets. They blend as they merge. Uses the pill color when empty.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the items.

props.name: frame
props.description: Shows the frosted panel around the items.

props.name: animation_time
props.description: Roughly how long the droplets take to travel to the new item, in ms.

props.name: particle_count
props.description: How many droplets the pill breaks into when an item is selected.

props.name: time_variance
props.description: Random variation in each droplet’s timing, in ms.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the droplets scatter on their way to the new item, in px.

props.name: gooeyness
props.description: How readily the droplets and pills melt together, from 0 to 1.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How much the new pill wobbles as it forms, from 0 to 1.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: Shows a soft highlight behind the hovered item.

name: HoloCard
description: Collectible trading card with a real holographic foil and glitter that sparkles as it tilts.

props.name: image
props.description: Front of the card. Same-origin or CORS-enabled URL.

props.name: back_image
props.description: Back of the card. When set, a click or Enter flips the card over.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible description of the card.

props.name: preset
props.description: The holo pattern on the card face. Bursts are rings of foil dashes, shards are cracked ice, swirl is one big round rainbow and gold is a warm etched foil.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How strongly the foil shows through the print, from 0 for plain card to 1.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the holo pattern. Higher values pack in more, smaller elements.

props.name: edge_sparkle
props.description: Brightness of the glitter on the silver border as it catches the light.

props.name: frame
props.description: Width of the sparkling border as a percentage of the card width. Match it to your card art.

props.name: glare
props.description: Strength of the glossy highlight under the light.

props.name: foil_color
props.description: Colour of the metal under the print, silver by default.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in px. The height follows the image.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px.

props.name: tilt_max
props.description: Largest tilt in degrees as the pointer moves.

props.name: hover_scale
props.description: How much the card lifts while hovered.

props.name: idle
props.description: Drifts the light and tilt slowly when nobody is hovering, so the foil keeps shimmering.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Soft shadow under the card that follows the tilt.

name: InfiniteMenu
description: A draggable sphere of image tiles that snaps the nearest one forward and shows its title.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to show. They repeat around the sphere when there are fewer items than tiles.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of tiles on the sphere.

props.name: tile_size
props.description: Tile size relative to the space around it. Lower values leave wider gaps.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Tile shape, from 0 for squares to 1 for circles.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How close the camera sits to the active tile when the sphere is at rest.

props.name: pull_back
props.description: How far the camera pulls back while you drag. 0 keeps it still.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much the tiles stretch with fast motion.

props.name: inertia
props.description: How long the sphere keeps spinning after you let go, from 0 to 1.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Seconds between automatic steps to the next tile. 0 turns it off. Pauses on hover and focus.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Shows every tile except the active one in grayscale.

props.name: dim
props.description: Fades the tiles around the active one toward the background once the sphere settles, which keeps the text readable. From 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: Spins the sphere into place when it loads.

props.name: show_info
props.description: Shows the title, description and link button of the active item.

props.name: render_info
props.description: Replaces the default title, description and button with your own overlay.

props.name: theme
props.description: Colors of the text, the button and the placeholder tiles.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Background of the link button.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Background behind the sphere. Transparent by default.

props.name: on_active_change
props.description: Called when a new item settles in front.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when the active tile or its button is clicked, or Enter is pressed.

items.title: The Pier
items.description: Concrete and open water under a bright morning sky.

items.title: Moonlit Field
items.description: A single pole in a field of rapeseed under the full moon.

items.title: Rapeseed
items.description: The same field at noon, yellow all the way to the horizon.

name: InfiniteSpiral
description: An endlessly looping 3D helix of images with adjustable motion, depth and spacing.

props.name: items
props.description: Images shown in the spiral. Objects may also include alt, href, target, label and id.

props.name: speed
props.description: Automatic travel speed in cards per second and the sensitivity of scroll-controlled motion.

props.name: direction
props.description: Vertical travel direction.

props.name: animation_mode
props.description: Selects automatic motion, pointer dragging, page-scroll control or all interactions.

props.name: radius
props.description: Depth radius of the helix in pixels.

props.name: card_width
props.description: Card width in pixels.

props.name: card_height
props.description: Card height in pixels.

props.name: vertical_spacing
props.description: Vertical distance between neighboring cards.

props.name: perspective
props.description: CSS perspective applied to the 3D stage.

props.name: cards_per_turn
props.description: Number of cards used for one complete revolution.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Global angular offset in degrees.

props.name: card_tilt
props.description: Additional clockwise card tilt in degrees.

props.name: card_radius
props.description: Card corner radius in pixels.

props.name: center_scale
props.description: Scale multiplier for cards nearest the center.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fraction of the outer travel range used for fading.

props.name: edge_blur
props.description: Maximum blur applied near the edges.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Smoothly eases automatic motion to a stop while the gallery is hovered.

props.name: image_fit
props.description: Object fit used by every image.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Grayscale amount applied to every image, from 0 to 1.

name: Lanyard
description: Swinging 3D badge on a stretchy woven band that you can drag, throw or click to flip.

props.name: front_image
props.description: Image URL printed on the front of the card. Any size or aspect works.

props.name: back_image
props.description: Image URL printed on the back. Falls back to frontImage, then to a blank card.

props.name: image_fit
props.description: How the images fit the card. Cover fills and crops, contain fits inside on the card color.

props.name: card_color
props.description: Color of the card itself, shown when there is no image and around contained images.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Whether the card hangs tall or wide.

props.name: finish
props.description: Surface of the card. Holographic adds a sparkling foil whose colors shift as the card turns, metallic a brushed sheen.

props.name: corner_radius
props.description: Roundness of the card corners, from 0 for square to 1 for very round.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the card as a fraction of the container height.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Where the band hangs from along the top edge of the container.

props.name: strap_length
props.description: How far below the top edge the card hangs, from 0 for a short band to 1 for a long one.

props.name: strap_image
props.description: Image URL printed along the band. A wide image repeats along its length, with its height spanning the band width.

props.name: strap_color
props.description: Color of the band when there is no strap image.

props.name: strap_width
props.description: Width of the band relative to its default, from 0.4 to 2.

props.name: metal
props.description: Finish of the clamp and the ring that holds the card.

props.name: gravity
props.description: How strongly the card falls. Lower values float and swing slowly, 0 turns gravity off.

props.name: damping
props.description: How quickly the swinging dies down, from 0 for a long sway to 1 for a quick settle.

props.name: elasticity
props.description: How hard the band snaps the card back after it is stretched and released.

props.name: breeze
props.description: A gentle, ever-changing wind that keeps the card moving when nobody touches it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets visitors drag, stretch and throw the card, and click it to flip it over.

props.name: intro
props.description: On mount the card drops in from the side and swings into place.

name: LineSidebar
description: Static list navigation with a cursor-proximity effect that shifts and highlights nearby items.

props.name: items
props.description: Labels rendered as the list of sidebar entries.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color items and markers shift toward as the cursor gets close.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Resting color of the item labels.

props.name: marker_color
props.description: Resting color of the leading marker lines.

props.name: show_index
props.description: Show the zero-padded index before each label.

props.name: show_marker
props.description: Show the marker lines (and short ticks) beside each item.

props.name: proximity_radius
props.description: Vertical distance in pixels within which the cursor influences an item.

props.name: max_shift
props.description: Maximum horizontal shift in pixels the label slides at full proximity.

props.name: falloff
props.description: Curve mapping cursor distance to the proximity effect.

props.name: marker_length
props.description: Length in pixels of the marker line; the in-between ticks scale from this too.

props.name: marker_gap
props.description: Gap in pixels between the labels and the markers.

props.name: tick_scale
props.description: Length of the in-between ticks as a fraction of markerLength.

props.name: scale_tick
props.description: When true, the in-between ticks also grow with cursor proximity.

props.name: item_gap
props.description: Vertical gap between items in pixels.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the labels in rem.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Transition duration in milliseconds for the proximity response.

props.name: default_active
props.description: Index of the item selected on mount.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when an item is clicked; the clicked item also becomes active.

name: MagicBento
description: A bento grid of feature cards with live artwork, edge light that follows the cursor and a click wave.

props.name: items
props.description: Cards to show. Each takes label, title, description, icon, image, visual, content, href, onClick, colSpan and rowSpan.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns on wide screens. Drops to 2, then 1, as the grid gets narrower.

props.name: row_height
props.description: Height of one row, in px.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cards, in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards, in px.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the cards.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: Color of the lights and the accents in the artwork. Takes hex or "r, g, b".

props.name: text_auto_hide
props.description: Keeps titles to one line and descriptions to two.

props.name: enable_border_glow
props.description: Lights up the card edges near the cursor, across neighboring cards too.

props.name: enable_spotlight
props.description: A soft light follows the cursor inside the hovered card.

props.name: spotlight_radius
props.description: Size of the cursor light, in px.

props.name: enable_stars
props.description: Fine specks of light drift up around the cursor in the hovered card.

props.name: particle_count
props.description: Number of specks in each card.

props.name: enable_tilt
props.description: Tilts the hovered card toward the cursor.

props.name: enable_magnetism
props.description: The hovered card leans a few pixels toward the cursor.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: Clicking sends a ring of light across the grid and replays the card artwork.

props.name: intro
props.description: Cards rise in one by one and their artwork plays when the grid scrolls into view.

props.name: disable_animations
props.description: Turns off all motion. Reduced motion settings do the same.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when a card is clicked. Cards become focusable buttons.

name: Masonry
description: A masonry gallery that springs into place, reflows as it resizes and opens images in a lightbox.

props.name: items
props.description: Tiles to show. Give width and height to lay out instantly, otherwise the image is measured. span makes a tile cover more columns.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column count. Auto fits as many columns of columnWidth as the container allows.

props.name: column_width
props.description: Target column width in px for auto columns.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between tiles in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the tiles in px.

props.name: animate_from
props.description: Where tiles come from as they appear.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay in seconds between tiles appearing.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length in seconds of the springs that move tiles in and between places.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the tiles overshoot as they settle, from 0 to 0.9.

props.name: blur_to_focus
props.description: Tiles sharpen from a blur as they appear.

props.name: reveal_on_scroll
props.description: Tiles appear as they scroll into view instead of all at once.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: Zoom the image, lift the tile, or tilt it toward the cursor.

props.name: focus_on_hover
props.description: Fades the other tiles while one is hovered.

props.name: captions
props.description: When the title and description show over a tile.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far images drift inside their tiles as the page scrolls, from 0 to 1.

props.name: lightbox
props.description: Clicking a tile opens it full size. Arrow keys move between images and Escape closes.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Drag tiles with a mouse to reorder them. The grid reflows around the tile as it moves.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when a tile is clicked. Call event.preventDefault() to skip the lightbox or link.

props.name: on_reorder
props.description: Called with the new order after a drag.

name: ModelViewer
description: A product-style 3D model viewer that frames itself and floats over a soft shadow.

props.name: url
props.description: URL of the model. Supports glb, gltf, fbx and obj.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the viewer.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the viewer.

props.name: environment
props.description: Lighting environment: studio, city, sunset, dawn, warehouse, apartment, lobby, night, park, forest or 'none'.

props.name: environment_intensity
props.description: Strength of the environment lighting and reflections.

props.name: exposure
props.description: Overall brightness of the render.

props.name: auto_rotate
props.description: Slowly turns the model while idle.

props.name: auto_rotate_speed
props.description: Speed of the idle rotation.

props.name: auto_rotate_delay
props.description: Seconds after you let go before the idle rotation eases back in.

props.name: drag_rotate
props.description: Drag to turn the model, with momentum when you let go.

props.name: turntable
props.description: Limits dragging to left and right, like a product turntable.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Pinch or hold Ctrl or Cmd and scroll to zoom. Plain scrolling still scrolls the page.

props.name: min_zoom
props.description: How far out you can zoom.

props.name: max_zoom
props.description: How far in you can zoom.

props.name: hover_tilt
props.description: How much the model leans toward the cursor. 0 turns it off.

props.name: float_
props.description: Gentle floating above the shadow. 0 turns it off.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Soft contact shadow under the model.

props.name: shadow_opacity
props.description: Darkness of the shadow.

props.name: intro
props.description: How the model appears once it has loaded.

props.name: start_angle
props.description: Starting angle around the model, in degrees.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Starting tilt toward the viewer, in degrees.

props.name: offset_x
props.description: Moves the model sideways, from -1 to 1.

props.name: offset_y
props.description: Moves the model up or down, from -1 to 1.

props.name: fit
props.description: How much of the viewer the model fills. It is framed automatically.

props.name: reset_on_double_click
props.description: Double click to return to the starting view.

props.name: on_model_loaded
props.description: Called once the model has loaded.

name: MorphSlider
description: WebGL slider that melts between images with a displacement transition.

props.name: items
props.description: Slides to morph between. Each item is an image URL with an optional caption.

props.name: start_index
props.description: Index of the slide shown on mount.

props.name: transition
props.description: Character of the GPU displacement morph between slides.

props.name: duration
