props.description: Length of a full transition in seconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing curve used to drive the transition progress.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the displacement — how far the images warp during the morph.

props.name: scale
props.description: Frequency of the procedural noise field (affects the Melt transition most).

props.name: aberration
props.description: Amount of RGB split that peaks mid-transition and resolves to zero.

props.name: drift
props.description: Idle drift / breathing applied to the current image so it is never fully static.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Advance slides automatically; pauses on hover.

props.name: autoplay_delay
props.description: Seconds each slide holds before autoplay advances.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap around from the last slide back to the first.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the slider in pixels.

props.name: overlay_color
props.description: Tint used for the subtle edge vignette over the images.

props.name: show_captions
props.description: Show slide captions that animate in with each transition.

props.name: show_controls
props.description: Show the previous / next arrow buttons.

props.name: show_indicators
props.description: Show the slide indicator dots.

name: OptionWheel
description: Curved option picker that spins with scroll, drag or arrow keys, tilting items away.

props.name: items
props.description: Labels rendered as the wheel options.

props.name: default_selected
props.description: Index of the option selected on mount.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called whenever the wheel settles on a new option.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Resting color of the option labels.

props.name: active_color
props.description: Color an option blends toward as it reaches the middle of the wheel.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge of the container the wheel curves around.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Font size of the option labels in rem.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Vertical distance between options as a multiple of the font size.

props.name: curve
props.description: Depth of the circular curve; 0 flattens the wheel into a straight list.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Angle in degrees between neighboring options; higher values curl the wheel tighter.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur in pixels added per step away from the middle.

props.name: fade
props.description: Opacity lost per step away from the middle.

props.name: min_opacity
props.description: Opacity floor for the furthest options.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Easing time constant in milliseconds; higher values feel heavier.

props.name: inset
props.description: Padding in pixels between the anchored edge and the centered option.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap around infinitely instead of stopping at the first and last option.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Allow dragging the wheel with a pointer, in addition to scroll and arrow keys.

props.name: sound_url
props.description: URL of a short tick sound played when the selection changes; empty disables it.

props.name: sound_volume
props.description: Playback volume of the tick sound.

name: PillNav
description: A pill navigation bar where a fill rises through each link as its label rolls over, with a sliding active dot.

props.name: logo
props.description: Image URL or element shown in the round logo button. It spins on hover.

props.name: logo_alt
props.description: Accessible label for the logo link.

props.name: logo_href
props.description: Where the logo links to.

props.name: items
props.description: The navigation links. Items without an href render as buttons.

props.name: active_href
props.description: Marks the item with this href as the current page. Leave it out to let the nav track clicks itself.

props.name: default_active_index
props.description: Which item starts active when activeHref is not set.

props.name: on_item_click
props.description: Called when an item is clicked.

props.name: link_component
props.description: Renders the links, so you can pass your router's link. It receives href, className and children.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color scheme of the surfaces, labels and highlight.

props.name: layout
props.description: Split puts the logo in its own bubble beside the bar. Joined holds everything in one capsule.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and text size.

props.name: surface
props.description: Background of the bar and logo: frosted glass, an opaque fill, or nothing.

props.name: item_style
props.description: Pill gives every item its own raised pill. Plain shows the labels straight on the bar.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: Fill rises a circle through the hovered pill as its label rolls over. Glide slides one pill to the item under the cursor.

props.name: indicator
props.description: How the current page is marked: a small dot that slides between items, or a filled pill.

props.name: highlight_color
props.description: Color of the fill, the gliding pill and the dot. Labels on it pick black or white for contrast.

props.name: highlight_text_color
props.description: Overrides the label color on the highlight.

props.name: bar_color
props.description: Overrides the background of the bar and logo.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Overrides the label color.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the gliding pill and the dot overshoot as they settle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far the gliding pill stretches toward its target before the back edge catches up, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: Pops the logo in and unrolls the bar on mount.

props.name: collapse
props.description: When the links fold into a menu button. Auto folds them only when they no longer fit.

props.name: on_menu_toggle
props.description: Called when the folded menu opens or closes.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

name: PixelCard
description: A card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, rippling out from the center or the cursor.

props.name: variant
props.description: A ready-made palette with its own gap and speed. Any prop you pass overrides it.

props.name: colors
props.description: Pixel colors, as an array or a comma-separated string. Each pixel picks one at random.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between pixels, in px.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the pixels twinkle, from 0 to 100. 0 holds them still.

props.name: pixel_size
props.description: Largest size a pixel grows to, in px.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of each pixel.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the reveal wave starts: the middle of the card, or wherever the pointer enters.

props.name: reveal_duration
props.description: How long the wave takes to sweep across the card, in ms.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: How much pixels near the cursor swell and brighten, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the soft light under the pixels.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: Color of the soft light that follows the cursor across the card.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the pixels and glow. Lower it to keep text on the card easy to read.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the pixels out toward the middle so they frame your content, from 0 to 1.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What turns the effect on: hovering or focusing the card, clicking it on and off, or always on.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking sends a ripple of brighter pixels out from the click.

props.name: intro
props.description: Plays the reveal once when the card first scrolls into view.

props.name: intro_delay
props.description: Wait before the intro, in ms. Stagger it across a row of cards.

props.name: no_focus
props.description: Stops keyboard focus from triggering the effect.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the card.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the card, in px.

name: ProfileCard
description: A framed profile card that tilts toward the cursor, with holographic foil shining through a tiled pattern.

props.name: avatar_url
props.description: Portrait shown on the card.

props.name: icon_url
props.description: Tileable pattern, like a logo pattern. The holo foil shows only through it.

props.name: mini_avatar_url
props.description: Small round image next to the handle. Hidden when not set.

props.name: name
props.description: Name shown over the portrait.

props.name: title
props.description: Role shown under the name.

props.name: handle
props.description: Handle shown in the footer, without the @.

props.name: status
props.description: Status text shown under the handle.

props.name: status_color
props.description: Color of the status dot.

props.name: contact_text
props.description: Label of the contact button.

props.name: show_user_info
props.description: Shows the footer with the handle, status and contact button.

props.name: on_contact_click
props.description: Called when the contact button is clicked.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the frame and footer.

props.name: backdrop_color
props.description: Color behind the portrait. Shows around cut-out photos. Uses the theme color when not set.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the photo, in px.

props.name: holo
props.description: Strength of the holographic foil, from 0 to 1. It lights up where the cursor catches it.

props.name: glare
props.description: Strength of the light that follows the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: enable_tilt
props.description: Tilts the card toward the cursor.

props.name: tilt_strength
props.description: Largest tilt angle, in degrees.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the portrait shifts as the card tilts, in px.

props.name: enable_mobile_tilt
props.description: Tilts the card with the motion of the phone after a tap. Needs HTTPS.

props.name: mobile_tilt_sensitivity
props.description: How strongly phone motion tilts the card.

props.name: intro
props.description: Catches the light once as the card appears, then settles.

name: ReflectiveCard
description: A metal ID card that reflects your camera or a looping video and catches the light as it tilts.

props.name: name
props.description: Name shown on the card.

props.name: role
props.description: Role shown under the name.

props.name: badge
props.description: Label of the badge in the top left corner.

props.name: status
props.description: Label of the status chip in the top right corner.

props.name: status_color
props.description: Color of the status dot.

props.name: id_label
props.description: Small label above the ID number.

props.name: id_value
props.description: ID number shown in the footer.

props.name: theme
props.description: Dark graphite or light silver metal, with matching text.

props.name: video_src
props.description: Looping video the card reflects when the camera is off. Without one it reflects a soft studio.

props.name: webcam
props.description: Reflects the camera feed, mirrored. Asks for camera access and falls back to the video.

props.name: on_webcam_error
props.description: Called when camera access is denied or unavailable.

props.name: tint
props.description: Color of the metal. White gives plain steel.

props.name: metalness
props.description: How strongly the surface mirrors the scene, from 0 to 1. At 0 the card turns matte.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Brushed grain of the metal, from 0 to 1. Stretches reflections along the grain.

props.name: blur_strength
props.description: Blur of the reflection, in px.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Removes color from the reflection, from 0 to 1. Lower it to see the scene in color.

props.name: warp
props.description: Gentle bends in the surface that ripple the reflection.

props.name: warp_scale
props.description: Size of the bends.

props.name: shine
props.description: Brightness of the light band that sweeps across the card as it tilts.

props.name: bevel
props.description: Width of the polished edge that catches the light, in px.

props.name: glare
props.description: Strength of the light that follows the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: enable_tilt
props.description: Tilts the card toward the cursor.

props.name: tilt_strength
props.description: Largest tilt angle, in degrees.

props.name: intro
props.description: Fades the card in and sweeps the light across it once.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the card. Numbers are in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the card. Numbers are in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius, in px.

name: ScrollStack
description: Cards pin and stack as you scroll, settling back into a dimmed deck with smooth, jitter-free motion.

props.name: item_distance
props.description: Gap between cards before they stack, in px. Larger gaps mean more scrolling between cards.

props.name: item_stack_distance
props.description: How far each card rests below the one before it in the stack, in px. 0 piles them exactly.

props.name: stack_position
props.description: Where the stack pins, from the top of the viewport or container. A number is px, or use a % string.

props.name: item_scale
props.description: How much a card shrinks for each card stacked on top of it.

props.name: base_scale
props.description: The smallest a buried card can shrink to.

props.name: dim_amount
props.description: How much a card darkens for each card stacked on top of it, from 0 to 1.

props.name: blur_amount
props.description: Blur added for each card stacked on top, in px.

props.name: tilt_amount
props.description: How far buried cards lean back in 3D, in degrees.

props.name: rotation_amount
props.description: How far buried cards turn, alternating left and right like a loose pile, in degrees.

props.name: hold_distance
props.description: How long the finished stack stays pinned before it scrolls away, in px of scrolling.

props.name: smooth_scroll
props.description: Glides mouse wheel scrolling smoothly. Touch, keyboard and scrollbar scrolling stay native. With useWindowScroll it smooths the whole page while the stack is mounted.

props.name: snap
props.description: When scrolling stops near a card, glides it the rest of the way onto the stack.

props.name: use_window_scroll
props.description: Stacks the cards as the page scrolls instead of scrolling inside its own container. Avoid overflow: hidden on parent elements, which stops cards from pinning.

props.name: on_stack_complete
props.description: Called when the last card lands on the stack.

props.name: item_class_name
props.description: ScrollStackItem only. Extra class names for the card, for its size, colors and content.

name: ScrollStack
description: A card inside a ScrollStack.

props.name: item_class_name
props.description: Extra class name for the card.

name: SpecularButton
description: Glass button whose edge catches the light, with a highlight that glides toward the cursor.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and font size of the button.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px. Values past half the height make a pill.

props.name: tint
props.description: Color of the glass body.

props.name: tint_opacity
props.description: How strongly the tint fills the body, from 0 for clear glass to 1 for a solid button.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur of whatever sits behind the button, in px.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of the label.

props.name: line_color
props.description: Color of the light on the edge.

props.name: base_color
props.description: Color of the thin edge line that stays visible under the light.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the light on the edge.

props.name: idle_intensity
props.description: How much of the light stays on when the cursor is away, from 0 to 1.

props.name: shine_size
props.description: How much of the edge the light covers at full strength, in degrees around the button.

props.name: shine_fade
props.description: How far the light fades out past that, in degrees around the button.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of the lit edge in px.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft light around the lit edge and inside the glass. 0 keeps only the crisp line.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the light circles when autoAnimate is on.

props.name: follow_mouse
props.description: Moves the light to the part of the edge nearest the cursor.

props.name: proximity
props.description: Distance in px at which the light starts to follow the cursor and brighten.

props.name: auto_animate
props.description: Keeps the light on and circling the edge whenever the cursor is away.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type.

name: SpotlightCard
description: Card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, catches its edge and reaches nearby cards.

props.name: spotlight_color
props.description: Color of the light. Any CSS color works and its alpha is respected. Defaults to white on dark cards and near black on light ones.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the light on the card surface, from 0 to 1.

props.name: spotlight_size
props.description: Radius of the light in px.

props.name: softness
props.description: How gradually the light fades out. 0 gives a crisp disc, 1 a soft glow that fades from the center.

props.name: shape
props.description: Circle is a round spotlight around the pointer. Beam pours light down from the top edge toward it, like a stage light.

props.name: border_glow
props.description: How much the card edge catches the light near the pointer, from 0 to 1.

props.name: proximity
props.description: Distance in px outside the card at which the light starts to reach it. Cards placed together share one light this way. 0 lights a card only while hovered.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How far the light floats behind the pointer. 0 sticks to it.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Lets the light drift slowly across the card while nothing points at it, which keeps cards alive on touch screens.

props.name: flare
props.description: The light swells and brightens while the card is pressed.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain inside the light, from 0 to 1. A little removes banding from large soft gradients.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface, border and light treatment for dark or light pages. Override the colors with the --spotlight-card-surface and --spotlight-card-border CSS variables.

name: Stack
description: Pile of cards you can drag, flick or click through, with thrown cards tucking underneath.

props.name: cards
props.description: The cards in the stack, top first. Images fill the card automatically, any other content works too.

props.name: layout
props.description: How the cards behind sit. Fan tilts them out from a corner, cascade offsets them diagonally, deck stacks them upward and pile scatters them like loose photos.

props.name: visible
props.description: How many cards show, counting the top one. The rest wait hidden at the back.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the cards behind fan, offset or scatter, from 0 for a neat stack to 1 for a wide one.

props.name: depth
props.description: How much smaller and darker each card behind gets, from 0 for none to 1 for a strong recede.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards in pixels.

props.name: frame
props.description: Width of a border around each card in pixels, like the edge of a printed photo.

props.name: frame_color
props.description: Color of the frame around each card.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Gives every card a soft drop shadow.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the top card leans in 3D while it is dragged, in degrees. It tilts around the point you hold and leans into fast moves. Use 0 to keep it flat.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far in pixels the top card has to be dragged before it goes to the back. A quick flick works too.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of every animation, from 0.5 for slow and soft to 2 for fast and snappy.

props.name: send_to_back_on_click
props.description: Clicking the top card also sends it to the back.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Cycles through the cards on its own.

props.name: autoplay_delay
props.description: Time in milliseconds between automatic cycles.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Pauses autoplay while the pointer is over the stack.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called with the index of the new top card whenever the stack moves.

name: StaggeredMenu
description: Menu with staggered item animations and smooth transitions on open/close.

props.name: position
props.description: Anchor position for the menu panel (left or right side).

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors used for staggered underlay layers.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu items rendered inside the panel.

props.name: social_items
props.description: Social links displayed in the menu panel.

props.name: display_socials
props.description: Whether to display the social links section.

props.name: display_item_numbering
props.description: Whether to show numbering for menu items.

props.name: logo_url
props.description: Path to the logo image.

props.name: menu_button_color
props.description: Color of the menu toggle button when closed.

props.name: open_menu_button_color
props.description: Color of the menu toggle button when open.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Hover accent color for menu items.

props.name: change_menu_color_on_open
props.description: Whether to animate the button color when opening/closing.

props.name: close_on_click_away
props.description: Whether to close the menu when clicking outside.

props.name: on_menu_open
props.description: Callback function called when menu opens.

props.name: on_menu_close
props.description: Callback function called when menu closes.

name: Stepper
description: A multi-step flow with a gliding step indicator, spring transitions and horizontal or vertical layouts.

props.name: step
props.description: Controls the current step yourself. Use it with onStepChange.

props.name: initial_step
props.description: The step shown first.

props.name: on_step_change
props.description: Called when the step changes.

props.name: on_final_step_completed
props.description: Called when the last step is completed.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Style of the step indicators in the horizontal layout.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Indicators across the top, or a rail of numbered steps beside the content.

props.name: transition
props.description: How the content changes between steps. The height always animates.

props.name: linear
props.description: Only lets the indicators jump back to steps that have been reached.

props.name: disable_step_indicators
props.description: Stops the indicators from changing the step when clicked.

props.name: render_step_indicator
props.description: Renders your own numbered indicator.

props.name: show_footer
props.description: Shows the Back and Continue buttons.

props.name: back_button_text
props.description: Text of the Back button.

props.name: next_button_text
props.description: Text of the Continue button.

props.name: complete_button_text
props.description: Text of the Continue button on the last step.

props.name: back_button_props
props.description: Extra props for the Back button.

props.name: next_button_props
props.description: Extra props for the Continue button, such as disabled while a step is incomplete.

props.name: completed_content
props.description: Shown in place of the steps once the last one is completed.

props.name: theme
props.description: Color theme of the panel and controls.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of completed steps, the progress lines and the Continue button.

props.name: frame
props.description: Shows the frosted panel around the stepper.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the panel, in px.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum width of the stepper.

props.name: step_container_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the indicator row.

props.name: content_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the content area.

props.name: footer_class_name
props.description: Extra class names for the footer.

name: Stepper
description: A single step inside a Stepper; wrap the step content with it.

props.name: title
props.description: Label shown under the indicator, or beside it in the vertical layout.

props.name: description
props.description: Second line shown beside the indicator in the vertical layout.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown inside the indicator instead of the number.

name: TiltedCard
description: A 3D card that tilts toward the cursor, with glare, a soft shadow, floating layers and a flip side.

props.name: image_src
props.description: Photo that fills the card.

props.name: alt_text
props.description: Alternative text for the photo.

props.name: caption_text
props.description: Text in the small tag that follows the cursor and swings as it moves.

props.name: container_height
props.description: Height of the area that reacts to the cursor.

props.name: container_width
props.description: Width of the area that reacts to the cursor.

props.name: image_height
props.description: Height of the card.

props.name: image_width
props.description: Width of the card.

props.name: scale_on_hover
props.description: How much the card grows when hovered.

props.name: rotate_amplitude
props.description: How far the card tilts toward the cursor, in degrees.

props.name: show_tooltip
props.description: Shows the caption tag on hover.

props.name: overlay_content
props.description: Content that floats in front of the card, lifted off its surface.

props.name: display_overlay_content
props.description: Shows the overlay content.

props.name: overlay_depth
props.description: How far the overlay floats in front, in px.

props.name: back_content
props.description: Content for the back of the card. Clicking, tapping or pressing Enter flips the card over.

props.name: flip_on_click
props.description: Flips the card when it is clicked. Needs backContent.

props.name: flipped
props.description: Controls which side shows. Leave it unset to let clicks flip the card.

props.name: on_flip
props.description: Called with the new side whenever the card is flipped.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the card.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Viewing distance in px. Lower values give a stronger 3D effect.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: From 0 to 1. Low values snap to the cursor, high values glide and settle with a soft bounce.

props.name: glare
props.description: Strength of the light that catches the surface and edges as the card tilts, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glare_color
props.description: Color of the glare.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Strength of the soft shadow under the card, which shifts and grows as the card lifts, from 0 to 1.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far layers and the photo shift with the tilt. 0 keeps everything flat.

props.name: axis
props.description: Limits the tilt to following the cursor left and right, or up and down.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Tilts away from the cursor instead of toward it.

props.name: track_window
props.description: The card follows the cursor anywhere on the page, not only while hovered.

props.name: floating
props.description: The card drifts and sways gently while idle.

props.name: gyroscope
props.description: Tilts the card as a phone or tablet is moved. Asks for permission on iOS on the first tap.

props.name: intro
props.description: The card rises and settles into place when it first scrolls into view.

props.name: intro_delay
props.description: Wait before the intro, in ms. Stagger it across a row of cards.

back_content.$jsx: The back of the card

name: TiltedCard
description: Content floating above (positive depth) or sinking behind (negative) a TiltedCard's face.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the layer floats above the card face.

name: AcidSquares
description: A rolling field of glossy squares that ripples under two drifting colored lights.

props.name: color
props.description: Base color of the squares. Set it to your page background, the gaps show the page through.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color of the first light that drifts across the squares.

props.name: secondary_color
props.description: Color of the second light.

props.name: tile_size
props.description: Size of the squares.

props.name: gap
props.description: Width of the gaps between the squares.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Corner radius, from sharp squares at 0 to circles at 1.

props.name: softness
props.description: How softly the edges of each square round off into the gaps.

props.name: bulge
props.description: How much each square domes up like a cushion. 0 keeps the tops flat.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the grid, in degrees.

props.name: gloss

props.name: wave_speed

name: Balatro

props.name: background_color

name: FaultyTerminal
description: A flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs, with phosphor trails under the cursor and glitches on click.

props.description: Zoom of the pattern. Higher values show more, smaller glyphs.

props.name: grid_mul
props.description: Glyph density across and down, multiplied with scale.

props.name: digit_size
props.description: Space around each glyph. 1 packs them edge to edge, higher values leave wider gaps.

props.name: time_scale
props.description: Speed of the animation.

props.name: scanline_intensity
props.description: Strength of the soft halo and the bright band that rolls down the screen.

props.name: glitch_amount
props.description: How far the faulty bands of the screen shift sideways.

props.name: flicker_amount
props.description: How often the faulty bands appear.

props.name: noise_amp
props.description: Strength of the swirling pattern that decides which glyphs light up.

props.name: chromatic_aberration

props.name: dither
props.description: Fine noise that smooths color banding.

props.name: curvature
props.description: Bulge of the screen, like the glass of an old tube.

props.name: tint
props.description: Phosphor color of the glyphs. In light mode, light colors are deepened so they print clearly.

props.name: mouse_react

props.name: mouse_strength

props.name: page_load_animation

props.name: brightness

props.name: glyphs

props.name: glow

props.name: persistence

props.name: scramble
props.description: How fast characters change near the cursor. Only used with characters.

props.name: mouse_glow
props.description: How much the glyphs under the cursor heat up toward white while you move.

props.name: vignette
props.description: Darkens the edges of the screen so it fades into the page.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: What a click does: tear the screen into shifting bands, or send a wobbling degauss wave from the click.

props.name: variation
props.description: Picks a fixed pattern. Leave it out for a different one on every mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Prints the glyphs as crisp ink on a light page.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Ferrofluid
description: A glossy sea of magnetic fluid where swells of spikes roll in and the cursor raises a crown.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the studio lights reflected in the fluid: key light, side lights and fill light.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the swells roll across the surface.

props.name: scale
props.description: Zoom of the fluid. Higher values show bigger, fewer spikes.

props.name: spike_height
props.description: How tall the spikes grow in a strong field.

props.name: sharpness

props.name: turbulence

props.name: fluidity

props.name: tilt
props.description: Viewing angle in degrees. Low values look down from above, high values look across the fluid.

props.name: magnetism

props.name: variation

props.name: flow_direction

props.name: brightness

props.name: mouse_interaction

props.name: mouse_strength

props.name: mouse_radius

props.name: mouse_dampening

props.name: light_mode

props.name: transparent

props.name: color

props.name: opacity

props.name: paused

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

props.name: mix_blend_mode
props.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the container.

name: FloatingLines
description: Ribbons of fine glowing lines that drift in waves, part around the cursor and curl when clicked.

props.name: lines_gradient
props.description: Up to 8 colors blended across the lines of each wave.

props.name: enabled_waves

props.name: line_count

props.name: line_distance

props.name: top_wave_position

props.name: middle_wave_position
props.description: Offset, height and curl of the middle wave.

props.name: bottom_wave_position
props.description: Offset, height and curl of the bottom wave.

props.name: animation_speed

props.name: amplitude

props.name: line_width

props.name: line_style

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the glow around the lines.

props.name: brightness

props.name: depth_of_field

props.name: interactive

props.name: bend_radius

props.name: click_swirl

props.name: mix_blend_mode

props.name: background_color

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the lines as ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: FluxLines

props.name: glow

props.name: line_width

props.name: flow_direction

props.name: opacity

props.name: mouse_interaction

props.name: mouse_strength

props.name: mouse_radius
props.description: Reach of the cursor magnet, as a fraction of the height.

props.name: mouse_dampening
props.description: Time in seconds the magnet takes to catch up with the cursor. 0 follows instantly.

props.name: click_swirl
props.description: Clicking stirs the fluid into a swirl.

props.name: intro
props.description: Fades the lines in on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the lines as ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: transparent
props.description: Lets the page show through. When off, the lines sit on the background color.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Background color when transparent is off. Defaults to white in light mode.

props.name: paused

props.name: mix_blend_mode
props.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the container.

name: Galaxy

props.name: focal
props.description: Center of the starfield, from 0 to 1.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Fixed rotation of the starfield as a [cos, sin] pair.

props.name: star_speed
props.description: How fast you travel through the stars.

props.name: density

props.name: hue_shift

props.name: glow_intensity

props.name: saturation

props.name: repulsion_strength

props.name: twinkle_intensity
props.description: How much the stars twinkle, from 0 to 1.

name: GhostFibers
description: Layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers that twist, fold and drift through soft depth of field.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: Main color of the fibers.

props.name: line_color
props.description: Color of the bright folds, sparkles and tips. Leave it out to use a pale tint of the glow color.

props.name: secondary_color
props.description: Second color the gradient blends toward. Leave it out to use a deeper shade of the glow color.

props.name: gradient
props.description: How the two colors blend: by distance, along the length of the ribbons, or across their width.

props.name: speed

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the whole effect.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Tilt of the whole effect, in degrees.

props.name: roll_speed
props.description: How fast the ribbons roll around their length.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of ribbons, from 1 to 3.

props.name: twist
props.description: How often the ribbons turn over along their length.

props.name: threads
props.description: Number of fibers in each ribbon.

props.name: volume
props.description: Thickness of each ribbon, from a single flat sheet at 0 to a layered bundle.

props.name: spread
props.description: Width of the ribbons.

props.name: density
props.description: Number of dots along each fiber.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Size of the dots.

props.name: flow
props.description: Speed of the dots along the fibers. Negative values reverse them.

props.name: fiber_style
props.description: Draws the fibers as rows of dots, short dashes or continuous lines.

props.name: fold_glow
props.description: Brightness of the light where the ribbons fold edge-on.

props.name: perspective
props.description: How far the ribbons turn into the distance, from side-on at 0 to steeply receding at 1.

props.name: depth_of_field

props.name: focus_depth

props.name: particles

props.name: sparkle

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the bloom around the bright areas.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: vignette
props.description: How much the edges fade out, from 0 to 1.

props.name: grain

props.description: Two to eight colors for the light, from the edge of the shadow to the brightest or farthest point. Dark areas stay transparent.

props.description: Share of characters drawn out of focus, from 0 to 1.
