props.description: Blends the crisp blocks into a smooth liquid warp, from 0 to 1.

props.name: chroma
props.description: Splits the color channels on displaced cells, from 0 to 1.

props.name: idle
props.description: A slow wandering distortion that keeps the image alive while the pointer rests. 0 turns it off.

props.name: click_ripple
props.description: Sends a ring of displaced cells out from every click.

props.name: intro
props.description: Scrambles the cells when the image loads and lets them settle into place.

name: GridMotion
description: A tilted wall of drifting tiles that slides with the pointer and lights up where it rests.

props.name: items
props.description: Tile content. Image URLs and paths render as photos, other strings as text, and JSX as is. Items repeat to fill the wall.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of tiles. More rows means smaller tiles.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: Width of each tile divided by its height. Below 1 gives portrait tiles.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between tiles in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the tiles in pixels. Large values give pills.

props.name: angle
props.description: Rotation of the whole wall in degrees.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Leans the wall back in 3D, in degrees. 0 keeps it flat.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed of the rows in pixels per second. 0 keeps them still.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the rows drift. Alternate sends neighbouring rows in opposite directions.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the rows slide against each other as the pointer moves across the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: Size of the area around the pointer where dimmed or grayscale tiles come back to full color, from 0 to 1. 0 turns it off.

props.name: dim
props.description: Fades the tiles outside the spotlight, which keeps text on top readable. From 0 to 1.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Shows the tiles in grayscale until the spotlight brings their color back.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges of the wall into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: tile_color
props.description: Background of text and empty tiles. Follows the theme when not set.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Color of text tiles. Follows the theme when not set.

props.name: theme
props.description: Picks the default tile and text colors.

name: GridScan
description: A 3D grid room swept by a scanning light that follows your view.

props.name: lines_color
props.description: Color of the grid lines. Light mode defaults to a pale gray.

props.name: scan_color
props.description: Color of the scan, its trail, the points and the click ping. Light mode defaults to a deeper blue.

props.name: cells
props.description: Number of grid cells from the floor to the ceiling.

props.name: line_thickness
props.description: Thickness of the grid lines in pixels.

props.name: line_style
props.description: Style of the grid lines.

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the room goes, relative to its height. High values turn it into a long corridor.

props.name: depth_fade
props.description: How much the room fades into the distance, from 0 (evenly bright) to 1 (gone by the back wall).

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the view shifts as the cursor moves, as if you were moving your head in front of a window. 0 keeps it still.

props.name: points
props.description: Scatters points over the walls that sparkle as the scan passes, like a LiDAR capture.

props.name: reflection
props.description: How much the glossy floor reflects the scan and pings, from 0 to 1.

props.name: shading
props.description: Soft light and corner shadows on the walls, from 0 (pure wireframe) to 1.

props.name: scan_direction
props.description: Whether the scan travels into the room, out of it, or alternates.

props.name: scan_duration
props.description: Seconds each scan takes to cross the room.

props.name: scan_delay
props.description: Seconds between scans.

props.name: scan_width
props.description: Thickness of the scan line, from 0.2 to 5.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long the walls keep glowing behind the scan, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: Bloom around the scan line and points, from 0 to 1.5.

props.name: auto_scan
props.description: Runs scans on a loop. Turn it off to scan only on click.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Moves the view with the cursor and lights up the walls under it.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: What a click does. Ping sends a ring of light across the walls from that spot, scan starts a new scan.

props.name: enable_webcam
props.description: Moves the view with your head through the webcam. The face tracker is loaded from a CDN the first time it turns on.

props.name: show_preview
props.description: Shows a small camera preview with the tracking status while the webcam is on.

props.name: models_path
props.description: Where the face tracking model is loaded from. Point it at your own copy to self-host.

props.name: enable_gyro
props.description: Moves the view as a phone or tablet tilts. iOS asks for permission on the first tap.

props.name: intro
props.description: Reveals the room with a first scan on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Renders a bright room with dark shading for light backgrounds.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Hyperspeed
description: Night highway of glowing light trails on a winding road that warps into hyperspace while you hold.

props.name: curve
props.description: Shape of the road. Switching between curves morphs the road smoothly.

props.name: curvature
props.description: How strongly the road bends. 0 is straight.

props.name: speed
props.description: Cruising speed of the traffic, poles and road markings.

props.name: boost
props.description: Speed multiplier while the pointer is held down. The lights stretch into longer trails as it kicks in.

props.name: fov
props.description: Camera field of view in degrees.

props.name: boost_fov
props.description: Field of view while boosting. The camera springs between the two for a punchy warp.

props.name: lanes
props.description: Lanes on each side of the road.

props.name: road_width
props.description: Width of each side of the road.

props.name: median_width
props.description: Width of the strip between the two sides.

props.name: density
props.description: Cars on each side of the road, up to 160.

props.name: trail_length
props.description: Length of the light trails.

props.name: light_size
props.description: Thickness of the light trails.

props.name: poles
props.description: Light poles on each shoulder, up to 80. 0 removes them.

props.name: pole_height
props.description: Height of the light poles.

props.name: dust
props.description: Speed streaks flying past in the air, up to 1500. They stretch into warp lines while boosting.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft bloom around every light. Dense traffic glows brighter. 0 turns it off.

props.name: reflections
props.description: How much the lights reflect on the road, like wet asphalt at night.

props.name: steer
props.description: How far the camera drifts and turns toward the pointer.

props.name: tail_colors
props.description: Colors of the lights moving away on the left road. Defaults to magentas and violet.

props.name: head_colors
props.description: Colors of the oncoming lights on the right road. Defaults to cyan and deep blues.

props.name: pole_colors
props.description: Colors of the light poles along both shoulders.

props.name: road_color
props.description: Color of the asphalt. The median strip takes a slightly lighter shade. Follows the theme when not set.

props.name: road_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the road and its markings. Lower it to let your page show through under the traffic. Reflections fade with it.

props.name: line_color
props.description: Color of the lane markings. Follows the theme when not set.

props.name: background
props.description: Color behind the road, which the road fades into. Leave it unset to keep the canvas transparent so your page shows through.

props.name: theme
props.description: Dark renders glowing light trails. Light renders crisp colored trails on a pale road.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Click and hold to boost, and let the camera follow the pointer.

props.name: boosting
props.description: Turns the boost on from your own code, for example while something loads.

props.name: on_boost_start
props.description: Called when the user starts boosting.

props.name: on_boost_end
props.description: Called when the user lets go.

name: Iridescence
description: Liquid iridescent surface with shifting folds that you can stir with the cursor.

props.name: color
props.description: Tint multiplied over the colors. Any CSS color, or an RGB array from 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed. 0 holds the pattern still.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: How far the pattern drifts toward the pointer.

props.name: mouse_react
props.description: Turns the pointer interactions on or off: parallax, stir and sheen.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the pattern. Higher values give broader folds.

props.name: detail
props.description: How many layers of folds are stacked. Lower is softer, higher is more intricate.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the pattern in degrees.

props.name: warp
props.description: How strongly the folds bend into each other.

props.name: hue_shift
props.description: Rotates the hues, in degrees.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Color intensity. 0 gives a monochrome chrome look.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Contrast between the folds.

props.name: stir
props.description: Drags the folds along with the pointer like a liquid. 0 turns it off.

props.name: sheen
props.description: Brightens the surface softly around the pointer.

props.name: click_swirl
props.description: Stirs a swirl into the surface wherever you click, which slowly unwinds.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain over the surface, from 0 to 1.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1. The canvas is transparent where it fades.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Render scale. Lower values trade sharpness for speed on large screens.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

name: LetterGlitch
description: A calm field of letters that flicker, scramble and glitch in color, stirred by the cursor and torn by clicks.

props.name: glitch_colors
props.description: Up to 8 colors that glitching letters light up in. Light mode defaults to dark ink tones.

props.name: base_color
props.description: Color of the letters at rest. Light mode defaults to near black.

props.name: characters
props.description: Characters to draw. Repeat a character to make it appear more often.

props.name: font_family
props.description: CSS font family for the letters. Web fonts are drawn once they have loaded.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Size of the letters in pixels.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Room around each letter relative to the font size. 0 packs them like lines of text.

props.name: density
props.description: Share of the grid that shows a letter at rest, from 0 to 1. Empty cells still flicker when they glitch.

props.name: base_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the letters at rest, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glitch_amount
props.description: How often letters glitch, from 0 (never) to 1 (constantly).

props.name: speed
props.description: Tempo of the scrambling and glitches. 0 freezes the letters.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Fades glitching letters in and out. When off, they flicker on and off instantly.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lights up and scrambles the letters near the cursor, leaving a trail of glitches when it moves.

props.name: cursor_radius
props.description: Radius of the area around the cursor that reacts, in pixels.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: What a click does. Tear rips a horizontal glitch through the rows, burst sends glitches outward.

props.name: flow
props.description: Strength of the soft waves of light that drift across the letters, from 0 to 1.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fades the letters out toward the edges, from 0 to 0.5.

props.name: center_fade
props.description: Clears the letters behind the middle of the container to keep content readable, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: Boots the letters in with a flicker on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Switches the default colors to dark ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Paints an opaque background behind the letters. Leave it unset for a transparent canvas.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: LightPillar
description: A swirling pillar of light that ignites on load, leans toward the cursor and surges on click.

props.name: top_color
props.description: Color of the lower, denser part of the pillar.

props.name: bottom_color
props.description: Color the light fades into toward the top.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: rotation_speed
props.description: How fast the pillar turns. Also drives the overall animation speed.

props.name: flow
props.description: How fast the light streams along the pillar, relative to the rotation.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The pillar leans, drifts and turns toward the cursor.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking sends a surge of light racing up the pillar.

props.name: glow_amount
props.description: How much light the strands gather. Higher values burn brighter and whiter.

props.name: bloom
props.description: Soft halo around the brightest strands, from 0 to 1.

props.name: pillar_width
props.description: Width of the pillar.

props.name: pillar_height
props.description: Vertical stretch of the strands. Higher values pack them tighter.

props.name: pillar_rotation
props.description: Tilts the pillar, in degrees.

props.name: twist
props.description: How much the strands swirl around each other.

props.name: detail
props.description: Layers of turbulence in the strands, from 1 to 6. Fewer layers are smoother and faster.

props.name: noise_intensity
props.description: Strength of the film grain.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: The pillar ignites from the bottom and widens when it first appears.

props.name: mix_blend_mode
props.description: CSS blend mode for the canvas. Screen lets the page show through the dark areas.

props.name: quality
props.description: Render resolution of the light. The pillar is soft, so lower settings look almost the same.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Exact render scale relative to the element size, from 0.25 to 2. Overrides quality.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the pillar as colored light on a white background.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

name: LightRays
description: Volumetric light rays from any edge, with source glow and haze. The cursor steers the beam and casts a shadow.

props.name: rays_origin
props.description: Where the light comes from: 'top-center', 'top-left', 'top-right', 'left', 'right', 'bottom-center', 'bottom-left' or 'bottom-right'.

props.name: rays_color
props.description: Color of the light.

props.name: rays_speed
props.description: Animation speed. 0 freezes the rays.

props.name: light_spread
props.description: How wide the beam opens. Lower values give a tight spotlight.

props.name: ray_length
props.description: How far the rays reach, in container widths.

props.name: ray_density
props.description: How many separate shafts the beam splits into.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Turns the beam by this many degrees.

props.name: ray_sharpness
props.description: How crisp the edges of the shafts are, from 0 to 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: Brightness of the glow around the light source.

props.name: haze
props.description: Drifting haze that breaks the shafts up, like dust in the air, from 0 to 1.

props.name: atmosphere
props.description: How much the light cools toward blue as it travels away from the source, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness of the light.

props.name: pulsating
props.description: The rays slowly breathe brighter and dimmer.

props.name: fade_distance
props.description: How far the rays travel before they dim, in container widths.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Color saturation of the light.

props.name: follow_mouse
props.description: The beam turns toward the cursor.

props.name: mouse_influence
props.description: How far the beam turns toward the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: cursor_shadow
props.description: The cursor blocks the light and casts a soft shadow down the rays.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking sends a wave of light down the rays.

props.name: noise_amount
props.description: Film grain over the rays, from 0 to 1.

props.name: distortion
props.description: Makes the rays waver as if seen through heat.

props.name: intro
props.description: The rays grow out from the source on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Prints the light as soft colored ink so it sits on light pages.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity, from 0 to 1.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: LightTunnel
description: A swirling fibre-optic tunnel where comets of light race into depth, steered by the cursor.

props.name: cable_color
props.description: Color of the fibres.

props.name: pulse_color
props.description: Color of the light pulses.

props.name: tunnel_color
props.description: Color of the soft glow around the fibres, shown when tunnelOpacity is above 0.

props.name: tunnel_opacity
props.description: Strength of the soft glow around the fibres that tints the tunnel walls.

props.name: speed
props.description: Overall speed of the tunnel.

props.name: flow_direction
props.description: Whether the pulses race into the tunnel or rush out toward you.

props.name: pulse_speed
props.description: How fast the pulses travel.

props.name: pulse_length
props.description: Length of each pulse and its tail.

props.name: pulse_blend
props.description: Softness of the pulses, from crisp sparks (0) to long soft streaks (1).

props.name: pulse_width
props.description: Width of the pulses relative to the fibres.

props.name: pulse_density
props.description: How many pulses are travelling at once, from 0 to 1.

props.name: cable_count
props.description: Number of fibres around the tunnel.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Thickness of the fibres.

props.name: rim_width
props.description: How far the glow spreads around each pulse.

props.name: waviness
props.description: How much the fibres swirl along the tunnel.

props.name: sway
props.description: How much the tunnel slowly rocks back and forth.

props.name: bend
props.description: How much the far end of the tunnel drifts and curves.

props.name: size
props.description: Scale of the tunnel.

props.name: center_x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the tunnel center.

props.name: center_y
props.description: Vertical offset of the tunnel center.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the glow around the pulses.

props.name: fade_near
props.description: How far from the center the tunnel fades in. Higher values keep the middle clear.

props.name: fade_far
props.description: Distance at which the tunnel fades out at the edges.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: color_variance
props.description: Gives every fibre a slightly different brightness.

props.name: grain
props.description: Adds a fine film grain to the light.

props.name: grain_intensity
props.description: Strength of the grain.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: Steers the far end of the tunnel toward the cursor.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How far the cursor steers the tunnel.

props.name: click_surge
props.description: Clicking sends a ring of light down the tunnel.

props.name: intro
props.description: Grows the tunnel out from the center on mount.

props.name: variation
props.description: Picks a different arrangement of fibres and pulses.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the tunnel as ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Lightfall
description: Streaks of light falling down a curved tunnel, bending around the cursor and stretching into warp trails on hold.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the falling streaks, up to 8. Each streak picks one.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Color of the soft light glowing at the top, where the streaks come from.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the streaks fall.

props.name: streak_count
props.description: Layers of streaks, from 1 to 16. More layers fill the tunnel.

props.name: streak_width
props.description: Thickness of the streaks.

props.name: streak_length
props.description: Length of the glowing tails.

props.name: glow
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: density
props.description: How closely the streaks follow each other down the tunnel.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: How much the streaks flicker, from 0 to 1.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Field of view into the tunnel. Higher values zoom further in.

props.name: background_glow
props.description: Brightness of the soft light at the top. 0 turns it off.

props.name: head_glow
props.description: How white-hot the leading tips burn, from 0 to 1.

props.name: depth
props.description: Dims streaks deep in the tunnel so the near ones stand out.

props.name: bloom
props.description: Soft glow around the brightest tips.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: The cursor bends the falling light like a lens and brightens the streaks near it.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How much the cursor brightens nearby streaks.

props.name: mouse_radius
props.description: Reach of the cursor light.

props.name: mouse_dampening
props.description: How long the cursor light takes to catch up, in seconds. 0 follows instantly.

props.name: lens
props.description: How strongly the cursor bends the streaks.

props.name: hold_to_warp
props.description: Holding the pointer down speeds the streaks up into warp trails.

props.name: intro
props.description: The light arrives at warp speed and slows to a steady fall.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the streaks as colored light on a white background.

props.name: mix_blend_mode
props.description: CSS blend mode for the canvas, such as screen or lighten.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Lightning
description: Crackling, branching lightning that bends toward the cursor and strikes wherever you click.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the lightning. The hottest parts glow white.

props.name: bolts
props.description: How many bolts to draw, from 1 to 4.

props.name: spread
props.description: Space between bolts when there is more than one.

props.name: branches
props.description: How many side branches split off and flash along the bolts, from 0 to 1.

props.name: x_offset
props.description: Moves the bolts sideways.

props.name: angle
props.description: Tilts the bolts, in degrees. 90 runs them across.

props.name: size
props.description: Scale of the jagged path. Higher is more crooked.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Thickness of the bright core.

props.name: glow
props.description: How far the glow spreads around the bolts.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the bolts crawl. The motion loops seamlessly every 10 seconds at 1.

props.name: flicker
props.description: Strength of the flicker and sudden flashes, from 0 to 1.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: Bolts bend toward the cursor, crackle and grow extra branches near it.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How strongly the bolts bend toward the cursor.

props.name: click_strike
props.description: Clicking calls down a bolt that strikes the spot and briefly flashes the others.

props.name: intro
props.description: Lets the bolts descend from the top on first load.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the lightning as crisp ink strokes for light backgrounds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: LineWaves
description: Fine lines that flow in silky waves while a band of light drifts through them.

props.name: color1
props.description: First color the lines blend through.

props.name: color2
props.description: Second color the lines blend through.

props.name: color3
props.description: Third color the lines blend through.

props.name: color_cycle_speed
props.description: How fast the colors drift across the lines. 0 keeps them in place.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the waves flow. 0 freezes them.

props.name: line_count
props.description: Number of lines across the height of the container.

props.name: line_width
props.description: Thickness of the lines, in px.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the soft glow around each line.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness of the lines.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Strength of the band of light that drifts through the lines, from 0 to 1. At 0 every line is lit evenly.

props.name: highlight_width
props.description: Width of the band of light. Higher values light more lines at once.

props.name: warp_intensity
props.description: How strongly the lines bend into waves.

props.name: warp_scale
props.description: Size of the waves. Higher values give broad, sweeping curves.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Angle of the lines, in degrees.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fades the lines out toward the edges of the container, from 0 to 1.

props.name: enable_mouse_interaction
props.description: The lines spread apart and light up around the cursor.

props.name: mouse_influence
props.description: How strongly the lines react to the cursor.

props.name: click_ripple
props.description: Clicking sends a smooth wave rolling out through the lines.

props.name: intro
props.description: The lines draw in across the container on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the lines as ink for light backgrounds. Colors turn into deeper inks of the same hue.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity, from 0 to 1.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: LiquidChrome
description: Soft ribbons of liquid chrome that swirl through a dark pool, ripple under the cursor and catch the light as it moves.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the metal. White is polished chrome, warmer tones give gold or copper.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the chrome flows. 0 freezes it.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: How strongly the flow swirls and folds.

props.name: frequency_x
props.description: How tightly the flow folds horizontally.

props.name: frequency_y
props.description: How tightly the flow folds vertically.

props.name: detail
props.description: Layers of swirl, from 1 to 8. Low values give smooth, heavy shapes, high values intricate ones.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of the chrome ribbons.

props.name: depth
props.description: How steeply the chrome rises from the surface. Higher values catch more reflections.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Softens the reflections, from a sharp mirror at 0 to a soft, frosted sheen at 1.

props.name: exposure
props.description: Brightness of the reflections.

props.name: interactive
props.description: The cursor leaves a wake in the liquid, clicks send ripples out and the reflections follow the cursor.

props.name: ripple_strength
props.description: How visible the wake and ripples are.

props.name: ripple_size
props.description: Size of the wake and ripples.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How much the reflections sway and turn toward the cursor. 0 keeps the light still.

props.name: intro
props.description: The chrome rises from the surface when it mounts.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Lights the chrome for light pages, with soft gray contours instead of a dark studio.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: LiquidEther
description: A glowing liquid that swirls under the cursor, colored by how fast it flows.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors from slow to fast flow. Calm areas take the first color, the fastest currents the last.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the flow.

props.name: mouse_force
props.description: How strongly the cursor pushes the liquid.

props.name: cursor_size
props.description: Size of the area the cursor stirs, in px.

props.name: persistence
props.description: How long the motion lingers before it settles, from 0 to 1.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the liquid is, from 0 to 1. Thicker liquid moves in broad, slow swirls.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Detail of the simulation, from 0.1 to 1. Lower values are faster and softer.

props.name: bounce_edges
props.description: The liquid bounces off the edges instead of flowing out of view.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking shoots a puff of liquid in the direction the cursor was moving.

props.name: auto_demo
props.description: Stirs the liquid on its own while the cursor is away.

props.name: auto_speed
props.description: Speed of the automatic stirring.

props.name: auto_intensity
props.description: Strength of the automatic stirring compared with the cursor.

props.name: auto_resume_delay
props.description: Milliseconds without input before the automatic stirring resumes.

props.name: intro
props.description: A swirl sweeps out from the center on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Renders the flow as soft ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Solid color behind the flow. Leave transparent to show the page through.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: MagicRings
description: Glowing rings that pulse outward in a wave, swell toward the cursor and flare on click.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the innermost ring.

props.name: color_two
props.description: Color of the outermost ring. The rings in between blend from one to the other.

props.name: ring_count
props.description: Number of rings, from 1 to 12.

props.name: motion
props.description: How the rings move: a wave that lights them one by one, rings flowing outward from the center, or all rings gently breathing.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed. 0 freezes the rings.

props.name: line_thickness
props.description: Thickness of the rings in px. Rings are thickest at the sides and taper toward the top and bottom.

props.name: glow
props.description: Size and strength of the glow around the rings.

props.name: base_radius
props.description: Radius of the innermost ring, as a share of the smaller side of the container.

props.name: radius_step
props.description: Space between neighboring rings.

props.name: expansion
props.description: How far each ring drifts outward while it glows.

props.name: taper
props.description: How quickly outer rings shorten into side arcs. 1 keeps every ring the same length.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotates the whole pattern, in degrees.

props.name: spin
props.description: Spins the arcs around the center, neighbors turning in opposite directions. Negative values reverse it.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Leans the rings back in 3D, in degrees, like a portal seen at an angle.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Splits each ring into rainbow fringes like light through a prism, from 0 to 1.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain over the glow, from 0 to 1.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity, from 0 to 1.

props.name: follow_mouse
props.description: The rings drift toward the cursor.

props.name: mouse_influence
props.description: How far the rings drift when followMouse is on.

props.name: hover_scale
props.description: How much the rings swell on hover.

props.name: hover_intensity
props.description: How much the rings brighten and thicken near the cursor.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How much the rings shift and lean with the cursor, outer rings the most, for a sense of depth.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking sends a bright ring racing outward that lights up the rings as it passes.

props.name: intro
props.description: The rings open from the sides one by one when they mount.

props.name: theme
props.description: Glowing light for dark pages, or crisp ink with a soft halo for light ones.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: MagnetLines
description: A field of magnetic lines that swing toward the cursor, ripple outward and spin with every click.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between lines in px. The grid fills the area with as many lines as fit.

props.name: rows
props.description: Exact number of rows. Overrides spacing.

props.name: columns
props.description: Exact number of columns. Overrides spacing.

props.name: container_size
props.description: Draws a square field of this width instead of filling the parent. Numbers are in px; strings take any CSS length.

props.name: line_color
props.description: Color of the lines.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color lines take on near the cursor. Compass needles use it for their north half.

props.name: line_width
props.description: Thickness of each line. Numbers are in px; strings take any CSS length.

props.name: line_height
props.description: Length of each line. Numbers are in px; strings take any CSS length.

props.name: base_angle
props.description: Resting angle of the lines in degrees, used before the intro and outside the reach.

props.name: mode
props.description: Shape of the field: rings around the cursor, lines aiming at it, a vortex, or a bar magnet that turns with your movement.

props.name: shape
props.description: Draws each line as a rounded bar, an arrow showing the field direction, or a two-tone compass needle.

props.name: rainbow
props.description: Colors every line by the direction it points, so the field becomes a color wheel.

props.name: radius
props.description: Size of the area around the cursor where lines are brightest and longest, in px.

props.name: fade
props.description: How much lines dim away from the cursor, from 0 to 1. 0 keeps every line at full strength.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much lines grow near the cursor, from 0 to 2.

props.name: reach
props.description: Distance in px within which lines follow the cursor. Lines farther out settle back to their resting angle. 0 means every line follows.

props.name: scatter
props.description: Randomizes the resting angle of each line, from 0 to 1, like loose iron filings. Pairs well with reach.

props.name: inertia
props.description: How slowly the lines swing into place, from 0 to 1. 0 snaps them instantly.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the lines overshoot and wobble as they settle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: ripple
props.description: Delays lines by their distance from the cursor so movement ripples outward, from 0 to 1.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking sends a ring that spins the lines as it travels outward.

props.name: intro
props.description: Lines fade in from the center and swing into place when the field mounts.

props.name: idle
props.description: Moves the field on its own when the cursor is away.

props.name: tilt_x
props.description: Tilts the field back in 3D around the horizontal axis, in degrees. A full-size field stretches to the horizon.

props.name: tilt_y
props.description: Tilts the field in 3D around the vertical axis, in degrees.

props.name: max_device_pixel_ratio
props.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

name: MicroSlats
description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests.

props.name: preset
props.description: A starting look for the sea. Every wave prop below overrides the preset value when you pass it. Signal turns the field into a flat, equalizer style wall.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the slats.

props.name: glint_color
props.description: Color the slats shift towards on wave crests and in the light the cursor leaves.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Color behind the slats. Pass transparent to show the page through.

props.name: slat_width
props.description: Width of one slat in CSS pixels.

props.name: slat_height
props.description: Full height of one slat in CSS pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between slats in CSS pixels.

props.name: roundness
props.description: Corner rounding of each slat, from square at 0 to a full pill at 1.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the swell. Larger values give longer, calmer waves.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the waves roll. 0 freezes the sea while the cursor can still stir it.

props.name: direction
props.description: Heading of the swell in degrees. 270 rolls straight towards the viewer.

props.name: chop
props.description: Sharpens the crests and flattens the troughs, like wind on the water.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much each slat grows and shrinks with the wave under it. 0 keeps every slat full length.

props.name: glint
props.description: Strength of the light caught on the crests.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Spread between dark troughs and bright crests.

props.name: perspective
props.description: How far the sea recedes towards a horizon above the top edge. 0 is a flat wall.

props.name: fog
props.description: Haze that fades the far rows into the background.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets the cursor stir the water. Moving it pushes a real fluid that bends the swell and carries a swirling trail of light, and a click spins out a splash.

props.name: cursor_strength
props.description: Brightness of the light the cursor leaves in the water.

props.name: cursor_size
props.description: Radius of the patch of water the cursor pushes, in CSS pixels.

props.name: swirl
props.description: How strongly the stirred water curls into eddies.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long the stirred water and its light linger, in seconds.

props.name: lean
props.description: How far the slats tilt with the current. 0 keeps them upright.

props.name: intro
props.description: Rolls the sea in from the horizon on mount, unfolding the slats row by row.

props.name: intro_duration
props.description: Length of the intro in seconds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the waves. The cursor can still stir the water.

name: MoltenMetal
description: Swirling caustic filaments with white-hot cores that heat up under the cursor and flare on click.

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient the metal heats through, from the dim glow to the hot body. Up to five colors.

props.name: core_color
props.description: Color of the white-hot cores at the end of the gradient.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Fills the canvas behind the metal. Transparent lets the page show through.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the flow as colored ink for light pages. Pair it with mid-tone colors that deepen toward the core.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the metal flows.

props.name: scale
props.description: Zoom of the flow. Higher fits more of it on screen.

props.name: detail
props.description: Layers of folded filaments, from 1 to 8. Fractions blend between layers.

props.name: glow
props.description: How much heat the filaments carry.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of the filaments and their white-hot cores.

props.name: swirl
props.description: How tightly the flow spirals.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: How strongly each layer folds the flow.

props.name: haze
props.description: Soft glow between the filaments. 0 leaves only the filaments.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: color_mode
props.description: Balance of the gradient. Ember runs hotter, frost stays cooler.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the whole flow in degrees.

props.name: offset_x
props.description: Moves the flow sideways, as a fraction of the width.

props.name: offset_y
props.description: Moves the flow up or down, as a fraction of the height.

props.name: drift
props.description: How far the flow drifts as the cursor moves. 0 keeps it still.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain in the glow. 0 turns it off.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: intro
props.description: Ignites the metal from its hottest cores outward the first time it comes into view.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: The cursor heats the filaments it passes over, leaving a trail that slowly cools.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How hot the cursor runs.

props.name: flare_on_click
props.description: Clicking flares the nearby filaments white-hot before they cool back down.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the flow.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio of the canvas.

name: Orb
description: A glowing ring of swirling color that breathes, trails an orbiting light and reaches toward the cursor.

props.name: colors
props.description: Two colors that swirl around the ring, then the deep color of the glow behind it.

props.name: hue
props.description: Shifts the hue of every color, in degrees.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Color the orb sits on. Light colors switch it to a soft, filled style.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the orb relative to the container.

props.name: glow
props.description: How soft and wide the glow around the ring is.

props.name: bleed
props.description: How far the glow bleeds into the inside of the orb. 0 keeps a tight ring.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How much the ring breathes and warps at rest.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Brightness of the light that orbits the ring.

props.name: trail
props.description: Length of the glowing tail behind the orbiting light. 0 removes it.

props.name: tilt_x
props.description: Tilts the ring back in perspective, in degrees. Positive values push the top away.

props.name: tilt_y
props.description: Turns the ring sideways in perspective, in degrees.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the swirl, the orbiting light and the breathing.

props.name: hover_intensity
props.description: How far the ring reaches toward the cursor and how brightly it lights up there.

props.name: rotate_on_hover
props.description: Slowly turns the orb while it is hovered.

props.name: force_hover_state
props.description: Keeps the hover effect on without hovering.

props.name: follow_cursor
props.description: The orbiting light swings toward the cursor while the orb is hovered.

props.name: click_pulse
props.description: Clicking the orb makes it pulse and swirl.

props.name: intro
props.description: Powers the orb on with a spring and a swirl.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Particles
description: A drifting 3D field of particles with glow, twinkle, constellation lines and cursor interaction.

props.name: particle_count
props.description: How many particles there are.

props.name: particle_spread
props.description: How far the particles spread out from the center.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of the floating motion, twinkle and rotation.

props.name: particle_colors
props.description: Colors the particles are picked from.

props.name: move_particles_on_hover
props.description: Lets the cursor move the particles.

props.name: particle_hover_factor
props.description: Strength of the hover effect.

props.name: alpha_particles
props.description: Draws softer, slightly see-through particles.

props.name: particle_base_size
props.description: Base size of the particles. Nearer particles are drawn larger.

props.name: size_randomness
props.description: How much particle sizes vary. 0 draws every particle at the base size in px.

props.name: camera_distance
props.description: Distance from the camera to the particles. Lower values feel closer and deeper.

props.name: disable_rotation
props.description: Stops the slow rotation of the whole field.

props.name: pixel_ratio
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio. Defaults to the screen's, capped at 2.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of each particle.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft glow around each particle.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: How much the particles flicker, from 0 to 1.

props.name: depth_of_field
props.description: Blurs the nearest particles into soft bokeh, like a camera lens.

props.name: connections
props.description: Joins nearby particles with thin lines, like a constellation.

props.name: connection_distance
props.description: How close particles need to be to connect, in px.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: Parallax shifts the whole field away from the cursor. Repel and attract push or pull nearby particles.

props.name: hover_radius
props.description: Radius around the cursor that repel and attract reach, in px.

props.name: click_burst
props.description: Clicking sends a burst of light rippling through the particles.

props.name: drift
props.description: Sends the particles drifting up like embers, down like snow, or toward you like a starfield.

props.name: drift_speed
props.description: How fast the particles drift.

props.name: variation
props.description: Picks a different particle layout.

props.name: intro
props.description: Flies the particles in from the distance on mount.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the particles as ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

name: PatternWaves
description: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs that moves like draped silk.

props.name: preset
props.description: A complete starting look. Every pattern, wave and light prop below overrides the preset value when you pass it.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The mark that draws the surface. Line traces it as flowing contour lines, glyph uses characters picked by brightness.

props.name: wave
props.description: The shape of the moving surface. Silk is draped fabric folds, swell is rolling parallel waves, ripple is rings travelling in from off screen.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between marks in CSS pixels. Smaller values give a finer print.

props.name: mark_size
props.description: Largest mark as a fraction of the spacing.

props.name: depth
props.description: How tall the surface is. Deeper surfaces cast stronger shading and lift the marks along the crests.

props.name: light
props.description: Angle of the light across the waves in degrees, from -90 to 90. 0 lights the folds head on, larger values graze them.

props.name: shine
props.description: Strength of the glints where the surface catches the light.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Spread between the quiet shadows and the lit areas.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the surface moves. 0 freezes it while the cursor keeps working.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the waves. Larger values give broader, calmer forms.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the waves travel in degrees. The light turns with it.

props.name: color
props.description: The one color of the pattern. Shadows, midtones and highlights are all derived from it. A color darker than the background prints like ink.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Color behind the pattern. Pass transparent to show the page through.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity of the pattern, from 0 to 1.

props.name: fade
props.description: Where the pattern fades into the background. Center keeps the middle calm for a headline, bottom and top fade towards that edge.

props.name: fade_size
props.description: How far the fade reaches, from 0.05 to 1.

props.name: characters
props.description: Characters for the glyph pattern, ordered from the lightest to the densest.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets the cursor disturb the surface. Moving it leaves a wake of ripples that catch the light, a click drops a splash.

props.name: cursor_size
props.description: Radius of the patch of surface the cursor pushes, in CSS pixels.

props.name: cursor_strength
props.description: How hard the cursor pushes the surface, from 0 to 1.

props.name: intro
props.description: On mount the marks fade in from the center, then the surface rises and the light sweeps across it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the surface. The cursor ripples keep working.

name: PixelBlast
description: Dithered pixel clouds that drift, shimmer and light up under the cursor, with ripples, shapes and a perspective floor.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of each pixel.

props.name: pixel_size
props.description: Size of each pixel, in px.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the pixels.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color the densest areas, ripples and the area under the cursor shift toward.

props.name: pattern_scale
props.description: Zoom of the cloud pattern. Higher values make smaller, busier clouds.

props.name: pattern_density
props.description: How many pixels light up. Higher values fill more of the area.

props.name: pixel_size_jitter
props.description: Random size variation between pixels, from 0 to 1.

props.name: enable_ripples
props.description: Clicking sends a ring of pixels out from the click.

props.name: ripple_intensity_scale
props.description: Brightness of ripples.

props.name: ripple_thickness
props.description: Width of the ripple ring.

props.name: ripple_speed
props.description: How fast ripples spread.

props.name: auto_pause_offscreen
props.description: Stops rendering while the background is scrolled out of view.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the clouds change shape.

props.name: transparent
props.description: Shows the page behind the pixels. Turn off for a solid black, or white in light mode, backdrop.

props.name: edge_fade
props.description: Fades the pixels out toward the edges, from 0 to 1.

props.name: noise_amount
props.description: Film grain on the pixels.

props.name: softness
props.description: Lets pixels grow and shrink smoothly as the pattern moves, instead of popping on and off.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Smooths the edges of the clouds. 0 keeps the original blocky steps.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft light behind the densest areas, and a hot core in ripples.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: Lets pixels shimmer at their own pace, from 0 to 1.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the clouds slide across the area. 0 keeps them in place.

props.name: drift_angle
props.description: Direction of the drift, in degrees.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: What the cursor does: light up more pixels around it, or make nearby pixels swell and brighten.

props.name: hover_radius
props.description: Size of the area the cursor affects, in px.

props.name: auto_ripple
props.description: Sends a ripple from a random spot about this many seconds apart. 0 turns it off.

props.name: tilt_x
props.description: Tilts the pixels back into a floor that fades toward the horizon, in degrees.

props.name: tilt_y
props.description: Turns the pixels sideways in perspective, in degrees.

props.name: intro
props.description: Blasts the pixels out from the center in a ring on mount.

props.name: variation
props.description: Picks a fixed pattern. Leave it out for a different one on every mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Darkens hot pixels instead of brightening them, for light pages.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: PixelSnow
description: Pixel-art snowflakes drifting down in layers of depth, brushed aside by the cursor.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the snow.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the flakes: pixel crystals, square pixels or round pixels.

props.name: density
props.description: How much snow is falling, from 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the snow falls. Negative values make it rise.

props.name: wind
props.description: Sideways drift. Negative values blow to the left.

props.name: sway
props.description: How much each flake swings as it falls.

props.name: flake_size
props.description: Size of the flakes, from 0 for mostly tiny specks to 2 for mostly large crystals.

props.name: pixel_size
props.description: Size of one snow pixel in px.

props.name: depth
props.description: How strongly far flakes fall slower and dimmer than near ones, from 0 to 1.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness of the snow.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the soft light around each flake.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: How often flakes catch the light and sparkle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: accumulate
props.description: Lets the snow pile up in soft drifts along the bottom edge.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: Lets the cursor brush the snow aside and stir it as it moves.

props.name: intro
props.description: Lets the snow drift in from the top on mount.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the snow as colored pixels for light backgrounds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the snow in place.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Plasma
description: Folds of satin light twisting slowly through the dark, turning to follow the cursor.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the plasma. Highlights are derived from it.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the plasma flows. Ping pong eases back and forth.

props.name: scale
props.description: Zoom of the plasma. Higher values zoom in.

props.name: twist
props.description: How tightly the plasma spirals.

props.name: wave
props.description: How much the plasma ripples as it flows.

props.name: softness
props.description: How soft the folds of light are, from 0 for crisp to 1 for misty.

props.name: shine
props.description: Strength of the bright highlights along the folds.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: grain
props.description: Strength of the film grain.

props.name: quality
props.description: Render resolution, from 0.25 to 1. Lower values run faster on slow devices.

props.name: mouse_interactive
props.description: Turns the plasma in 3D to follow the cursor and brightens it nearby.

props.name: intro
props.description: Fades the plasma in as it twists into place.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the plasma as tinted satin for light backgrounds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: PlasmaWave
description: Two ribbons of plasma curling through each other, with soft glow and white-hot cores.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the two waves of plasma.

props.name: speed
props.description: Overall speed of the animation.

props.name: speed1
props.description: How fast the first wave travels.

props.name: speed2
props.description: How fast the second wave travels.

props.name: dir2
props.description: Direction of the second wave. Use -1 to make it travel against the first.

props.name: bend1
props.description: How far the first wave curls around its path.

props.name: bend2
props.description: How far the second wave curls around its path.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Thickness of the plasma ribbons.

props.name: focal_length
props.description: Camera lens. Lower values give a wider, deeper view.

props.name: rotation_deg
props.description: Rotation of the whole effect, in degrees.

props.name: x_offset
props.description: Horizontal shift of the view, in px.

props.name: y_offset
props.description: Vertical shift of the view, in px.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Brightness of the plasma.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the soft light spilling around the plasma.

props.name: core
props.description: How white-hot the brightest parts of the plasma get, from 0 to 1.

props.name: grain
props.description: Strength of the film grain.

props.name: quality
props.description: Detail of the plasma, from 0.25 to 1. Lower values render faster on slow devices.

name: Prism

props.description: Which way the camera travels.

props.name: morph
props.description: How quickly the landforms reshape over time. 0 keeps the terrain still.

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft bloom around the lit lines.

props.name: depth_of_field
props.description: Softens lines away from the focus point, which follows the cursor.

props.name: fog
props.description: How quickly the land fades into the distance. 1 leaves only the foreground.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness of the lines.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Overall opacity of the effect.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: Lets the cursor light and shape the terrain, and tilts the camera toward it.

props.name: hover_effect
props.description: Lift raises the land under the cursor, trace lights the contour at its height, light only lights it.

props.name: mouse_radius
props.description: Size of the area the cursor affects.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How high the land lifts and how brightly it lights.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long the lifted land takes to settle back, from 0 to 1.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the camera leans toward the cursor, from 0 to 1.

props.name: click_effect
props.description: Pulse sends a ring of light rolling out over the land, peak raises a new mountain.

props.name: markers
props.description: Survey markers on a grid across the land. A few blink, and the ones near the cursor get a target frame.

props.name: glitch
props.description: How often brief data glitches slice through the lines, from 0 to 1. Clicks set one off too.

props.name: intro
props.description: The map fades in flat and rises into mountains on mount.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the lines as crisp ink for light backgrounds instead of glowing light.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: Waves
description: Dense flowing lines that sway like silk, bend around the cursor and spring back into place.

props.name: line_color
props.description: Color of the lines.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Color the lines take on where the cursor or a click pushes them.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Background behind the lines.

props.name: line_style
props.description: Draws solid lines, or dashes that stream along them.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Space between the lines, in px.

props.name: line_width
props.description: Width of the lines, in px.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Turns the lines, in degrees. 90 lays them flat.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: How far the lines sway, in px.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the wave pattern. Higher values make broader, calmer waves.

props.name: twist
props.description: How much the waves twist the lines, gathering them into bright folds.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the waves flow. 0 holds them still.

props.name: variation
props.description: Picks a different wave pattern.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: Moving the cursor drags the lines along with it.

props.name: mouse_radius
props.description: Radius around the cursor that drags the lines, in px.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How hard a moving cursor drags the lines.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the lines overshoot and wobble as they settle, from 0 to 1.

props.name: return_duration
props.description: Roughly how long the lines take to settle back, in seconds.

props.name: click_ripple
props.description: Clicking parts the lines in a soft ripple.

props.name: intro
props.description: Opens the lines from the center and swells the waves in on mount.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the edges into the page, from 0 to 1.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws the lines as ink for light backgrounds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the waves.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

name: WebThreads
description: Glowing threads woven through luminous pinch points that light up under the cursor and carry light on click.

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient across the threads, from the first thread to the last. Up to six colors.

props.name: core_color
props.description: Hot color where threads overlap and converge.

props.name: background_color
props.description: Fills the canvas behind the threads. Transparent lets the page show through.

props.name: light_mode
props.description: Draws crisp ink strokes for light backgrounds instead of glowing light.

props.name: thread_count
props.description: Number of threads, up to 24.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the threads weave.

props.name: frequency
props.description: How many waves fit across the width.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the threads fan away from the pinch.

props.name: taper
props.description: How much wider each next thread swings, nesting them inside each other.

props.name: position
props.description: Height of the weave, from bottom 0 to top 1.

props.name: pinch
props.description: Where the threads converge across the width, from 0 to 1.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Number of pinch points. More than one braids the threads through each of them.

props.name: angle
props.description: Rotation of the whole weave in degrees.

props.name: glow
props.description: Strength of the light around each thread.

props.name: falloff
props.description: How quickly the glow fades. Higher is tighter.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Width of the threads.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Overall brightness.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of the whole effect.

props.name: depth
props.description: Twists the threads in 3D, so strands behind the bundle turn thinner and dimmer.

props.name: pulses
props.description: Strength of light pulses that travel along the threads toward the pinch.

props.name: mirror
props.description: Weaves each side of the pinch as a mirror.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Adds a gentle, uneven sway to each thread.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the threads out toward both ends so they melt into the page.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain in the light. 0 turns it off.

props.name: intro
props.description: Draws the threads in one after another the first time they come into view, each led by a soft light.

props.name: mouse_interaction
props.description: The strand nearest the cursor lights up while the others recede.

props.name: mouse_strength
props.description: How strongly the focused strand stands out from the rest.

props.name: pulse_on_click
props.description: Clicking sends light along every thread, gathering in the pinch and fading out the far side.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the weaving.

props.name: dpr
props.description: Maximum device pixel ratio of the canvas.

name: BellToggle
description: Pill toggle where a press rings the bell, crossfades the label and unfurls the pill.

props.name: off_label
props.description: The face at rest. Its width sets how far the pill is clipped.

props.name: on_label
props.description: The face after the yes press. The pill reserves the width of the longer label; only the visible part changes, so neighbours never shift.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the bell. Adjust ringPivot for a glyph that hangs elsewhere.

props.name: label
props.description: Constant accessible name. Falls back to offLabel.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink at rest: label, bell and hover tint.

props.name: background
props.description: Pill fill at rest.

props.name: on_color
props.description: Ink when pressed.

props.name: on_background
props.description: Fill when pressed.

props.name: size
props.description: 36, 44 or 52 pixels tall with matching type, icon and padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the pill and of the clip cap.

props.name: ring_amplitude
props.description: Degrees of the first swing. Every later swing scales from it.

props.name: ring_passes
props.description: Half-swings before rest. 2 is a nod, 9 a peal.

props.name: ring_decay
props.description: How fast the swings die. 1 evenly, 2 the second is already small, 0.5 keeps shaking.

props.name: ring_duration
props.description: Milliseconds for the whole ring.

props.name: ring_pivot
props.description: Where the icon hangs from, as a percentage of its height. 16 is the crown, 50 the centre.

props.name: crossfade_ms
props.description: The label and fill crossfade. Also all a keyboard toggle gets.

props.name: reveal_bounce
props.description: Overshoot of the unfurl. 0 is critically damped; 0.2 lets the cap pass its mark and return.

props.name: count
props.description: Notifications waiting. A rise while on rolls the badge and wobbles the bell.

props.name: badge
props.description: Show the count on the bell while on.

props.name: badge_color
props.description: The badge.

props.name: badge_text_color
props.description: The count on the badge.

props.name: waves
props.description: Sound waves leave the rim on every swing.

props.name: clapper
props.description: Draw a bell with a clapper that swings a beat behind the body.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled state. Outside changes only crossfade.

props.name: default_pressed
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every toggle.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the pill and ignores input. The state is kept.

name: BranchedMenu
description: Collapsible menu that branches each section from a trunk and traces a line to your pick.

props.name: items
props.description: Sections: label plus children (value, label, icon), or a leaf with a value. A section with children folds; a leaf selects.

props.name: default_open
props.description: The section, or sections, open at first. -1 for none.

props.name: default_active
props.description: Value selected at first. Empty picks the open section's first child.

props.name: on_select
props.description: A child or a leaf was picked.

props.name: on_toggle
props.description: A section folded or unfolded.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink. Lines and idle text are mixes of it.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: The active line, the active label and the marker.

props.name: line_color
props.description: The rail, trunk and branches. A solid colour, so joints never darken.

props.name: width
props.description: The widest the menu may be, in px. It shrinks to its content.

props.name: row_height
props.description: Height of a child row in px.

props.name: indent
props.description: Where child rows start, in px. Branches end just before it.

props.name: trunk
props.description: The trunk line's x position, in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: The curve of each branch, in px.

props.name: line_width
props.description: Stroke width of the lines.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Child text size in px. Headers are 1px larger.

props.name: draw_duration
props.description: The accent line's travel, in ms.

props.name: fold_duration
props.description: A section's fold and unfold, in ms.

name: CallChip
description: Tool-call chip whose fill wipes across as a live timer ticks, ending green or shaking red.

props.name: icon
props.description: The tool glyph. It rolls out when the call resolves.

props.name: name
props.description: The tool name.

props.name: argument
props.description: The argument.

props.name: status
props.description: Running wipes the fill across and ticks the counter. Done completes it with a wash. Error stops it, tints and shakes.

props.name: expected_ms
props.description: Milliseconds the fill takes to reach its 90% park, the time you expect the call to take.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip height in pixels. Font, padding and glyph follow.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels. Half the height is a pill.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink for the text and the tool glyph.

props.name: surface_color
props.description: The chip surface.

props.name: progress_color
props.description: The fill that wipes across while running.

props.name: progress_opacity
props.description: How strong that fill is.

props.name: done_color
props.description: The success wash and the check.

props.name: error_color
props.description: The stopped fill and the retry glyph on error.

props.name: wash_opacity
props.description: Strength of the success wash and of the error tint.

props.name: shake
props.description: Error shake amplitude in pixels. 0 tints only.

props.name: show_timer
props.description: Shows the millisecond counter.

props.name: on_retry
props.description: When set, the failed chip becomes a retry button.

name: CodeSlots
description: One-time code input whose digits spring into their slots, with paste and SMS autofill.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of slots.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled code. Digits that arrive from outside land with the cascade; digits removed drain.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Uncontrolled initial code, rendered already landed.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every edit, including the clear at the end of a reject.

props.name: on_complete
props.description: Called once when the last hole is filled.

props.name: status
props.description: error drains the slots last to first under the danger tint and clears the code; success merges the fills into one wash and locks the input.

props.name: mask
props.description: Shows a dot instead of each digit.

props.name: caret
props.description: Shows the blinking caret in the active slot.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the row and ignores input.

props.name: auto_focus
props.description: Focuses the input on mount.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: Fill of a landed digit, the active ring and the success wash.

props.name: ink_color
props.description: Caret, and the tint of the active slot.

props.name: slot_color
props.description: Surface of an empty slot.

props.name: digit_color
props.description: Digit colour on the fill.

props.name: danger_color
props.description: Ring and fill colour while status is error.

props.name: slot_size
props.description: Slot width in pixels. Height and digit size follow it.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between slots in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels, capped at half the slot size.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Spring overshoot of the landing fill. 0 is critically damped.

props.name: settle
props.description: Seconds a digit takes to land or drain.

props.name: rise
props.description: Pixels a digit rises into place. 0 fades only.

props.name: cascade
props.description: Milliseconds between slots when several land at once or drain on reject.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the input.

name: CometDial
description: Tick-ring dial you flick by angle, with a comet that streaks behind the lit head.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. A change from outside launches the reading on the tap spring.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value.

props.name: step
props.description: Snapping grid, and the keyboard nudge.

props.name: unit
props.description: Suffix after the figure. Empty hides it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the slider.

props.name: accent
props.description: The lit arc, the bead and the comet.

props.name: ink
props.description: The track and the readout.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in pixels. Everything inside scales with it.

props.name: sweep
props.description: Degrees the arc covers, with the gap centred at the bottom.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width of the track and the arc. The bead follows it.

props.name: speed
props.description: How quickly the reading arrives, 0 to 100.

props.name: tap_bounce
props.description: Ring-down after a tap. 0 stops dead.

props.name: flick_bounce
props.description: Ring-down after a full-speed flick. A slower release lands between the two.

props.name: momentum
props.description: How far a flick carries the reading past where you let go. 0 drops it where released.

props.name: comet_reach
props.description: Degrees of trail behind the bead at full speed.

props.name: comet_width
props.description: Extra stroke width at the head of the trail at full speed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the dial and ignores input.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every snapped change, including during a drag.

props.name: on_change_end
props.description: Called on release and on a key, with the release velocity and the bounce it earned.

name: DodgeField
description: Wrapper that makes any child dodge the pointer until it relents and glides home.

props.name: taunts
props.description: Labels for the built-in pill: the first at rest, then one per dodge, the last once it relents.

props.name: notice
props.description: One line shown under the child on touch devices, where nothing dodges.

props.name: ink_color
props.description: The pill tint and text, the caught fill and the focus ring all derive from it.

props.name: contrast_color
props.description: Text colour while the pill is caught.

props.name: field_height
props.description: Height of the invisible field in pixels; its width is the container.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far it bolts, in pixels, with the pointer on its home.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from home at which it starts to react, in pixels.

props.name: falloff
props.description: Exponent of the reaction curve. 1 drifts away from far off; 4 only flinches at the last moment.

props.name: flee_duration
props.description: Settle time of the dart, in milliseconds.

props.name: return_duration
props.description: Settle time of the glide home, in milliseconds.

props.name: return_bounce
props.description: Overshoot on the way home. 0.1 is a hair, 0.3 a visible wobble.

props.name: axis
props.description: Which way it may flee.

props.name: wall
props.description: At the edge of the field: stop dead, or fold the overflow back so it rebounds.

props.name: patience
props.description: Dodges before it gives in and sits still, at least 1. Never wrap a decline or close control in a field that dodges.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Sits still and stops counting; the child stays clickable.

props.name: on_dodge
props.description: Called on each counted dodge.

props.name: on_relent
props.description: Called when it gives in.

props.name: on_catch
props.description: Called when the child is clicked.

name: FlipCard

props.name: front
props.description: Content of the front face.

props.name: back
props.description: Content of the back face.

props.name: flipped
props.description: Controlled state: true shows the back. Omit it to let the card manage itself.

props.name: default_flipped
props.description: Start on the back face.

props.name: on_flip_change

props.name: axis
