props.name: flip_on_click
props.description: A press without movement flips the card.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Drag to turn the card by hand. On release it springs to the nearest face, carrying the flick velocity.

props.name: drag_distance
props.description: Pixels of drag for a half turn. 0 uses the card width, or its height on the x axis.

props.name: tilt
props.description: The card leans toward the cursor on hover.

props.name: tilt_max
props.description: Largest tilt angle in degrees.

props.name: glare
props.description: A soft sheen that follows the cursor.

props.name: glare_opacity
props.description: Strength of the sheen at its centre.

props.name: hover_scale
props.description: Lift while hovered or held.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Viewing distance in px. Smaller is more dramatic.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Stiffness of the flip spring.

props.name: damping
props.description: Damping of the flip spring. Lower overshoots more.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in px, capped at the parent.

props.name: height
props.description: Card height in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px.

props.name: background
props.description: Surface of both faces.

props.name: color
props.description: Text colour of both faces.

props.name: shadow
props.description: A soft shadow beneath the card that narrows as it turns edge on.

props.name: shadow_color
props.description: Shadow colour.

props.name: shadow_opacity
props.description: Shadow strength.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed, flat and inert.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name. The face is carried by aria-pressed.

name: FolderFloat

props.name: label
props.description: The line on the flap.

props.name: sublabel

props.name: trigger
props.description: Open on hover, or toggle on press.

props.name: default_open
props.description: Start open.

props.name: close_on_select
props.description: Picking a pill closes the folder.

props.name: physics
props.description: Once the pills land, a zero-gravity world takes over: they float, collide, and can be dragged and thrown inside the cloud.

props.name: drift
props.description: Strength of the floating currents in the world. 0 holds still.

props.name: on_select
props.description: A pill was picked.

props.name: on_open_change
props.description: The folder opened or closed.

props.name: folder_color
props.description: The back panel and its tab.

props.name: front_color
props.description: The flap.

props.name: paper_color
props.description: The paper edge that rises as it opens.

props.name: item_color
props.description: The pills.

props.name: item_text_color
props.description: The pill text.

props.name: label_color
props.description: The flap text.

props.name: width
props.description: Folder width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Folder height in px, below the tab.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px.

props.name: spread
props.description: Half the widest the cloud may be, in px. Pills pack into rows within it.

props.name: lift

props.name: tilt

props.name: flap_angle

props.name: rest_angle

props.name: open_duration

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between pills, in ms. The close reverses the order.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Overshoot of the rise. 0 lands dead.

name: FuseButton

props.name: label
props.description: The idle action.

props.name: undo_label
props.description: The label while the fuse burns; the whole pill is the Undo button.

props.name: done_label
props.description: Shown with a check once the fuse burns out and settle is stay; announced to screen readers on arm.

props.name: icon
props.description: The idle glyph; an archive icon when omitted.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink for labels and icons; the seam and tints derive from it.

props.name: background
props.description: The pill surface.

props.name: fuse_color
props.description: The lit line or ring.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 36, 44 or 52 pixels with matching type and icons.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels; 22 is a full pill at the medium size.

props.name: undo_window
props.description: How long the fuse burns and Undo stays on offer, in milliseconds.

props.name: fuse

props.name: fuse_thickness

props.name: on_commit

props.name: on_fuse_end

props.name: on_phase_change

props.name: type

name: GlideSelect

props.name: default_value

props.name: placeholder

props.name: show_tags

props.name: accent_color

props.name: surface_color

props.name: disabled

props.name: aria_label

name: HoldButton

props.name: done_label

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon rendered before the idle label.

props.name: done_icon

props.name: background_color

props.name: fill_color
props.description: Colour of the liquid fill, its wave, the glow and the focus ring.

props.name: size

props.name: radius

props.name: fill_direction

props.name: hold_time

props.name: release_time

props.name: press_scale

props.name: wave

props.name: wave_amplitude

props.name: glow

props.name: reset_after

props.name: disabled

props.name: on_hold

props.name: on_tap

name: JellyRadio
description: Radio group of chips where the chosen one swells and barges its neighbours outward.

props.name: items
props.description: The chips. A string is both value and label.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Outside changes jump.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled. Falls back to the first item.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on the commit, before the motion ends.

props.name: chip_color
props.description: Surface of an unchosen chip.

props.name: active_color
props.description: Surface of the chosen chip.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Label of an unchosen chip, and the hover tone.

props.name: active_text_color
props.description: Label of the chosen chip.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip height 28, 36 or 44 pixels. Large is the touch-first size.

props.name: gap
props.description: Rest spacing between chips in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels. 18 is a pill at medium.

props.name: swell
props.description: How much the chosen chip grows. It also sets the room the neighbours make.

props.name: barge
props.description: Extra pixels every neighbour is shoved beyond that room. 0 only makes room.

props.name: shrink
props.description: How much every unchosen chip gives up.

props.name: jelly
props.description: The wide-before-tall split. 0 swells uniformly, 1.5 exaggerates it.

props.name: bounce
props.description: One minus the damping ratio. 0 arrives and stops, 0.4 rings.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds per row step before a neighbour moves. 0 moves the row as a slab.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness of the chosen chip. Neighbours soften from it with distance.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the group and ignores input.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the group.

name: LatticeLoader
description: Agent status row with a lattice of cells that brighten in a wave beside a live stopwatch.

props.name: label
props.description: The verb while working.

props.name: done_label
props.description: The verb after status turns to done; the frozen time follows it.

props.name: error_label
props.description: The verb after status turns to error.

props.name: status
props.description: Drives everything: the wave runs, or freezes and dissolves into a check or a cross while the stopwatch stops.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The wave geometry. At 3 x 3: arrow, dots, orbit, ripple, snake, spiral. At 4 x 4: sweep, spin, rain, pulse, orbit, snake. A custom object gives one delay per cell in step units (null for a hole), an optional loop and scale, and lit: the share of the cycle a cell stays bright, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45 or 0.62.

props.name: grid
props.description: Cells per side. Each size has its own set of patterns and its own check and cross.

props.name: shape
props.description: Rounded tiles or dots.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink for the cells, the verb and the stopwatch. Inherits the page colour by default.

props.name: done_color
props.description: Colour of the check.

props.name: error_color
props.description: Colour of the cross.

props.name: cell_size
props.description: Cell side in pixels; the lattice is three cells and two gaps.

props.name: gap
props.description: Seam between cells in pixels.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Verb size in pixels; the stopwatch and row gap scale with it.

props.name: step
props.description: Milliseconds between neighbouring cells lighting; the whole loop scales with it.

props.name: idle_opacity
props.description: How visible the dark silhouette is.

props.name: glow
props.description: A halo on the lit cells and the mark.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: The halo colour. Empty follows the ink, and the mark colour for the mark.

props.name: show_timer
props.description: Shows the live stopwatch.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Controlled elapsed seconds. When set, the internal clock never runs.

name: PaperCrumple
description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while you hold and drag it.

props.name: src
props.description: Required image URL. PNG transparency is preserved. Remote image servers must allow CORS.

props.name: alt
props.description: Image description used by the fallback and the accessible hold control.

props.name: back_src
props.description: Optional image printed on the reverse. Otherwise the back uses paperColor.

props.name: width
props.description: Unfolded paper width in pixels. Scales down to fit the stage with a 24px inset.

props.name: height
props.description: Unfolded paper height in pixels. Determines the sheet aspect ratio.

props.name: scene_height
props.description: Height of the full-width stage in pixels, including space to drag.

props.name: image_fit
props.description: Cover crops the texture; contain keeps the entire image and leaves unused space transparent.

props.name: release_behavior
props.description: Freeze the current crumple, unfold completely, or unfold with lasting crease relief.

props.name: crumple_amount
props.description: Maximum fold amount while held, from 0 (flat) to 1 (fully crumpled).

props.name: crumple_duration
props.description: Approximate settling time in seconds while holding. 0 makes the change immediate.

props.name: release_duration
props.description: Approximate unfolding time in seconds. Another press can interrupt it.

props.name: fold_count
props.description: Number of crease guides in the paper solver, from 3 to 16. Each seed produces a different arrangement.

props.name: fold_sharpness
props.description: Blend from rounded wrinkles (0) to angular creases (1).

props.name: wrinkle_depth
props.description: Compression depth, from 0 to 2. Higher values produce a tighter wad and stronger residual folds.

props.name: crease_strength
props.description: Residual relief from 0 to 1 for the creased release mode. Longer holds leave stronger creases.

props.name: paper_color
props.description: Color of the unprinted back of the sheet.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Material roughness, from smooth (0) to matte (1).

props.name: paper_texture
props.description: Fine paper-grain bump strength, from 0 to 1.

props.name: light_intensity
props.description: Strength of the directional light that reveals folds.

props.name: light_angle
props.description: Direction of the key light in degrees. 0 shines from above.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Enable self-shadowing and a soft drop shadow behind the paper.

props.name: shadow_opacity
props.description: Opacity of the cast and drop shadows, from 0 to 1.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Move the sheet while held. The grabbed material point follows the pointer.

props.name: drag_rotation
props.description: Maximum tilt in degrees while dragging. 0 disables tilt.

props.name: drag_radius
props.description: Maximum resting offset on each axis, in pixels. The stage also bounds the resting position.

props.name: return_to_origin
props.description: Restore and creased modes return to the center. Stay mode leaves the paper where it was dropped.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Initial sheet rotation in degrees.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for a repeatable arrangement of folds and paper grain.

props.name: detail
props.description: Simulation detail, clamped to 32–96. Higher values add smaller folds and take longer to prepare.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable pointer and keyboard input and finish any active hold.

props.name: reset_key
props.description: Change this value to reset the position, crumple and accumulated creases immediately.

props.name: on_state_change
props.description: Reports holding, then the selected release state: flat, crumpled or creased.

props.name: on_error
props.description: Called if WebGL initialization or image loading fails. The original image remains as a fallback.

name: PeekRating
description: Star rating that lifts a wave of stars up to the pointer, then commits with a pop on click.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled rating, from 0 to count.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial rating when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called when a rating is committed by click, release or keyboard.

props.name: on_preview
props.description: Called on every slot crossing while previewing, and with null when the preview clears.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of glyphs.

props.name: shape
props.description: Built-in glyph shape.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom glyph that replaces the built-in shape.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per glyph, shown in the tip while previewing. Without labels the tip shows the number.

props.name: active_color
props.description: Colour of lit glyphs and of the focus ring.

props.name: idle_color
props.description: Colour of unlit glyphs.

props.name: tip_color
props.description: Background of the tip that follows the pointer.

props.name: tip_text_color
props.description: Text colour of the tip.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size in pixels; spacing and the tip scale with it.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far previewed glyphs rise, in pixels. 0 makes the preview colour-only.

props.name: magnify
props.description: Scale of the glyph under the pointer.

props.name: rise_duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds of each glyph’s rise and fall, and of the tip’s hop.

props.name: pop_scale
props.description: Peak scale of the pop on the committed glyph. 1 disables it.

props.name: show_tip
props.description: Shows the tip above the pointer glyph while previewing.

props.name: allow_clear
props.description: Clicking the current rating again, or Backspace, clears it to 0.

props.name: read_only
props.description: Display only: no preview, no pop, announced as an image.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the control and ignores input.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the radio group.

name: PromptBar
description: Chat composer with @ sources, / commands, a model picker, dictation and attachments.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty.

props.name: sources
props.description: Rows of the @ menu and the plus button: key, name, description, icon (a Hugeicons icon or any node), and attach: true for the row that adds files.

props.name: commands
props.description: Rows of the / menu: key, name (with the slash), description.

props.name: models
props.description: Rows of the model picker: key, name, tag. An empty list hides the picker.

props.name: default_model
props.description: Key of the model selected at first. Empty picks the first.

props.name: efforts
props.description: Steps of the effort slider, low to high. The last step turns the field to the spark colour with drifting sparks. An empty list hides the control.

props.name: default_effort
props.description: The step selected at first. Empty picks the middle.

props.name: on_effort_change
props.description: The slider moved.

props.name: busy
props.description: A response is in flight. The send tile stays ink and its arrow morphs into a stop square.

props.name: on_send
props.description: Enter or the tile, with a non-empty draft or an attachment. The draft and attachments clear.

props.name: on_stop
props.description: The tile while busy.

props.name: on_attach
props.description: Picked the attach row. Return file names, or a promise of them, and they appear as chips.

props.name: on_dictate
props.description: The mic. Return the transcript, or a promise of it, and it lands in the draft. Omit to hide the mic.

props.name: background
props.description: The field surface, and the glyph on an armed tile.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink: text, icons, and the armed tile.

props.name: menu_background
props.description: The surface of the menus and the effort popover.

props.name: spark_color
props.description: The wash, the sparks and the slider at the top effort.

props.name: spark_boost
props.description: How strongly typing drives the sparks at the top effort: they rise faster, grow and glow brighter with typing speed, and flash on each keystroke. No sparks are added. 0 keeps them calm.

props.name: width
props.description: Field width in px, capped at the parent.

props.name: radius
props.description: Field corner radius in px.

props.name: max_rows
props.description: Rows the field grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: morph_duration
props.description: Arrow to square and back, in ms.

props.name: squash
props.description: Mid-morph pinch. The glyph narrows by this and grows taller to keep its area.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Mid-morph lean in degrees, mirrored on the way back.

props.name: press_scale
props.description: Scale of the send tile while a pointer is down.

name: PulseHeart
description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour and pulses back as the count ticks over.

props.name: liked
props.description: Controlled state. Changes from outside land without a run.

props.name: default_liked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.name: count
props.description: The number shown; a press adds or removes one. Rolls one glyph per press. For a multi-digit odometer with places and decimals, use Counter.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every press with the new state and count.

props.name: show_count
props.description: Shows the count; off collapses the pill to a circle.

props.name: icon
props.description: Built-in glyph, or a custom element.

props.name: idle_outline
props.description: Draws the idle glyph as an outline. Off draws it as a muted solid.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size in pixels; padding, gap and count size derive from it.

props.name: corner
props.description: Pill corner radius in pixels.

props.name: liked_color
props.description: Colour after the flip, and of the hover tint and focus ring.

props.name: idle_color
props.description: Colour before the flip.

props.name: pill_color
props.description: Background of the pill that beats under the glyph.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Colour of the count.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the whole run in milliseconds; the flip is always at 40% of it.

props.name: dot_size
props.description: How small the glyph gets at the flip, as a fraction of its size.

props.name: overshoot
props.description: How far the glyph rebounds past rest on the way back. 0 lands without a rebound.

props.name: beat
props.description: Percent the pill dips at the flip.

props.name: roll_duration
props.description: How long the changed glyph of the count takes to roll, in milliseconds.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the button and ignores input.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the count is appended to it.

name: RefineFrame

props.name: status
props.description: The stage. Each change tweens the media to that stage.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: The box reserved before and during generation, so nothing shifts.

props.name: width
props.description: Frame width in px, capped at the parent.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px.

props.name: background
props.description: The paper behind the media, and the chip surface.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink: chip text, the sweep and the retry pill.

props.name: stage_duration
props.description: Each stage tween, in ms.

props.name: sweep
props.description: A soft band crosses the frame while it works.

props.name: show_status
props.description: The chip with the mark and the stage label.

props.name: hide_after
props.description: Ms after completion before the chip fades. 0 keeps it.

props.name: labels
props.description: Chip text per stage: Queued, Generating, Refining, Ready, Failed.

props.name: retry_label
props.description: The pill on an error.

props.name: on_retry
props.description: The retry pill was pressed. Without it, no pill.

name: RubberSegment
description: Segmented control whose rubber thumb stretches across the gap and squashes into place.

props.name: items
props.description: The slots, in order. A string is both value and label.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. A change from outside jumps the thumb without animation.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled; the first item if omitted.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on a tap, on a drag release and on every arrow key.

props.name: track_color
props.description: The well behind the slots.

props.name: thumb_color
props.description: The rubber thumb, and the focus ring.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Idle labels, drawn at 70%.

props.name: active_text_color
props.description: The label revealed inside the thumb.

props.name: size
props.description: Track height 28, 36 or 44 pixels; font and padding follow.

props.name: radius
props.description: Track corner radius in pixels.

props.name: inset
props.description: Gap between the thumb and the track edge; the thumb corner is radius minus inset.

props.name: equal_slots
props.description: Every slot the same width. Off, slots hug their labels and the thumb changes width per slot.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far a tap dilates the thumb across old and new slot before it contracts. 0 is a plain slide.

props.name: squash
props.description: Pixels the trailing edge lands past the slot edge before relaxing. 0 removes the squash.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scales every phase together; 0.25 is slow motion.

props.name: glide
props.description: How far a flick carries the thumb before it snaps. 0 always lands on the nearest slot.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the thumb be grabbed, dragged and flicked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the control and ignores input.

name: ScrubField
description: Number chip you drag to scrub, with rubber-band limits and click to type.

props.name: label
props.description: The field name. Drag anywhere on the chip to scrub; click without moving to type.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Unit after the number, also read by screen readers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; changes from outside land without motion.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value and the dirty baseline: the ring turns off exactly here.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower bound; the rubber band starts here.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound; the rubber band starts here.

props.name: step
props.description: Granularity of drag and arrows; sets the decimals shown.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip height 28, 34 or 44 pixels.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Pixels of travel per step. 1 is twitchy, 6 is precise.

props.name: rubber_reach
props.description: How far past a bound the number can be pushed, as a percent of the range. 0 is a hard stop.

props.name: return_duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds of the critically damped snap back to the bound.

props.name: coarse_multiplier
props.description: Step multiplier while Shift is held, and for Page Up and Page Down.

props.name: fine_multiplier
props.description: Step multiplier while Alt or Option is held; adds a decimal.

props.name: show_delta
props.description: Shows the signed change in a pill riding the pointer.

props.name: show_dirty
props.description: Rings the chip while the value differs from the default.

props.name: show_fill
props.description: Fills the chip from the left in proportion to where the value sits in the range.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill band, dirty ring and delta pill.

props.name: chip_color
props.description: Chip surface. Text inherits from the page.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the chip and ignores input.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every step, key and typed commit.

props.name: on_commit
props.description: Called on release, on a key step and on blur or Enter.

name: Shredder
description: A list with a paper shredder at the bottom that cuts dragged rows into curling strips.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows to render, top to bottom. Each item needs a unique id.

props.name: render_item
props.description: Renders one row. A snapshot of the rendered row is what gets cut into strips, so plain markup, inline images and inline SVG all work.

props.name: on_shred
props.description: Called the moment a row has gone through the rollers. Remove the item from your list here, unless loop, loopAfterDelete or autoAnimate is on.

props.name: on_reorder
props.description: Called with the items in their new order after a row is dropped somewhere else in the list.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the whole machine in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Total height. The rows stack up from the slit, which sits above the fall zone at the bottom.

props.name: inset
props.description: Horizontal inset of the rows from the edges. The slit is 6px wider than the rows on each side.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between rows in pixels.

props.name: slit_height
props.description: Thickness of the slit. It is always a full pill.

props.name: fall_height
props.description: Height of the zone under the slit where the strips fall and fade out.

props.name: feed_speed
props.description: Roller speed in pixels per second. The first pull is faster and eases into it.

props.name: bite
props.description: How far a row has to be pushed into the slit before the rollers grab it, in pixels.

props.name: auto_feed
props.description: Grab the row as soon as it is pushed in far enough, even while it is still held. Off, it feeds only on release over the slit.

props.name: strip_width
props.description: Target width of each strip in pixels. The row is cut into equal columns.

props.name: curl
props.description: How much the strips curl and wave as they come out. 0 keeps them straight.

props.name: auto_animate
props.description: Plays through the rows on its own, bottom to top, then brings them back and starts over. Keep the rows in your list while it runs; onShred still fires.

props.name: loop
props.description: Once the last row has been shredded, bring them all back. Keep the rows in your list while it is on.

props.name: loop_after_delete
props.description: After a row is shredded it comes back a moment later at a random spot, so the list never runs dry. Keep the rows in your list while it is on.

props.name: drag_tilt
props.description: Maximum lean in degrees while a row is dragged sideways.

props.name: lift
props.description: Scale of a row while it is held.

props.name: slit_color
props.description: Colour of the slit.

props.name: color
props.description: Text colour inherited by the rows.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Rows cannot be dragged or shredded.

name: SlideCommit

props.name: label
props.description: The instruction centred in the pill; the capsule wipes it as you drag.

props.name: done_label
props.description: The words beside the check once confirmed.

props.name: error_label

props.name: on_confirm

props.name: on_done

props.name: on_error

props.name: track_color

props.name: handle_color

props.name: success_color

props.name: danger_color
props.description: Tint of the handle and error label after a reject.

props.description: Called on a loaded release, on a tap when tapSends is on, and on Enter or Space.

props.name: pad_color

props.name: icon_color
props.description: The pad content colour.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: The power arc, the loaded band and the dot.

props.name: well_color

props.name: band_color

props.name: width
props.description: Tank width in px. The readout scales with it.

props.name: height
props.description: Tank height in px.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px, capped at half the smaller side.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Lines etched on the right of the glass. 0 hides them.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: 0 is a rigid gauge. Higher is slower to answer, longer to settle, and overshoots more.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the surface leans per unit of speed. 0 keeps it flat.

props.name: splash
props.description: How much of a slam the top and bottom give back. 0 swallows it, 0.8 nearly bounces.

props.name: unit
props.description: Readout suffix.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the meter or slider.

name: SpringCheck
description: Checkbox row where one spring fills the box, draws the tick and strikes through the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The words beside the box; the strike-through is exactly their width.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. A change from outside animates on the spring.

props.name: default_checked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every toggle.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the row and ignores input.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink: the label, the ring, the rule and the focus outline.

props.name: fill_color
props.description: The fill that swells out of the box centre.

props.name: check_color
props.description: Stroke of the tick drawn over the fill.

props.name: box_size
props.description: Box side in pixels; ring, gap and row height derive from it.

props.name: box_radius
props.description: Box corner radius in pixels; half the size makes a circle.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Label size in pixels; the rule thickness derives from it.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How far the fill swells past full. 0 arrives dead, 0.5 rebounds twice.

props.name: strike_lag
props.description: Where on the spring the rule starts: 0 wipes with the fill, 0.4 waits for the tick.

props.name: done_opacity
props.description: How much ink the words keep once checked.

props.name: strike
props.description: Where the strike-through wipes from, or no rule at all.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name when the label is not text.

name: SquishSwitch
description: Switch whose thumb stretches with speed and squashes against the end when you flick it.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. Leave it out to let the switch keep its own.

props.name: default_checked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: A tap, a drag past the middle, or a key.

props.name: label
props.description: A label beside the switch, wired to it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed and inert.

props.name: track_color
props.description: The track while off.

props.name: track_on_color
props.description: The track while on.

props.name: thumb_color
props.description: The thumb while off. Empty mixes the on colour faintly into the track.

props.name: thumb_on_color
props.description: The thumb while on. Empty uses the off track colour.

props.name: width
props.description: Track width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height in px. The thumb and its inset follow.

props.name: radius
props.description: Track corner radius in px, capped at half the height.

props.name: speed
props.description: Stiffness of the settle spring, 0 to 100. Low is lazy, high is snappy.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How much the thumb lengthens with speed, 0 to 100. It narrows to keep its area.

props.name: hover_scale
props.description: The thumb swells to this on hover.

props.name: color_duration
props.description: The colour cross-fade, in ms.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no label.

props.name: id_
props.description: Id for the switch button; the label uses it.

name: StatusMark
description: Agent task status glyph that morphs from an idle ring to a progress arc, then a check.

props.name: status
props.description: The lifecycle state. Every change morphs the glyph in place.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0 to 1 while running. Leave it out for an indeterminate spinning arc.

props.name: label
props.description: Text beside the glyph. It dims and gets struck.

props.name: color
props.description: Ring, arc, cancelled cross and label.

props.name: done_color
props.description: Ring, wash and check when done.

props.name: error_color
props.description: Ring, wash and cross when failed.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size in pixels. The label gap is half of it.

props.name: stroke_width
props.description: Stroke width in the 24-unit box. The ring shrinks to keep its margin.

props.name: dashes
props.description: Dashes in the idle ring, the ones that fuse into the arc.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Label size in pixels. The strike scales with it.

props.name: spin_duration
props.description: Milliseconds per turn of the indeterminate arc.

props.name: arc_length
props.description: Share of the ring the indeterminate arc covers.

props.name: draw_duration
props.description: Milliseconds the check or cross takes to draw.

props.name: fill_opacity
props.description: The wash inside a finished ring.

props.name: strike
props.description: Strikes the label through when done.

props.name: strike_delay
props.description: Milliseconds after the check starts before the strike wipes in.

name: SwipeRow
description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions and deletes on a full swipe.

props.name: actions
props.description: The drawer, outermost first. Each has id, label, an optional icon, an optional color for secondary actions, dismiss to fold the row when pressed, and onSelect. The first is the full-swipe action and always folds the row.

props.name: action_color
props.description: The full-swipe block that leaps and fills the row.

props.name: drawer_color
props.description: The drawer base and the secondary actions.

props.name: row_color
props.description: The surface.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Row text and the keyboard toggle.

props.name: height
props.description: Row height in pixels. The fold closes from it.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the row and the clipped drawer.

props.name: action_width
props.description: Width of each action in pixels, so the drawer width too.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way you swipe. Everything mirrors.

props.name: snap_bounce
props.description: Overshoot of the open or close settle after a flick. Slow releases never bounce.

props.name: resistance
props.description: How much of the finger the row keeps past the drawer, and the rubber-band beyond the commit point.

props.name: collapse_ms
props.description: How long a deleted row takes to fold shut.

props.name: commit_at
props.description: Fraction of the row width the surface must uncover for the block to leap and a release to delete.

props.name: full_swipe
props.description: Off, the drawer is the end: no leap, no delete.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the row and ignores input.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Outside changes settle the row.

props.name: on_open_change
props.description: Called when a gesture or key opens or closes the drawer.

props.name: on_action
props.description: Called when any action button is pressed.

props.name: on_commit
props.description: Called after a full swipe or a press on a folding action, once the row has shut. Remove the row here.

props.name: close_on_action
props.description: Closes the drawer after an action is pressed.

props.name: haptic
props.description: A short vibration on touch when the block leaps.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the row.

name: SwipeToast
description: Toast that swipes down to dismiss and burns a thin fuse for its remaining time.

props.name: title
props.description: The first line.

props.name: description
props.description: The dimmer second line. Empty hides it.

props.name: icon
props.description: An 18px icon before the text.

props.name: action_label
props.description: The inverted button. Empty hides it.

props.name: on_action
props.description: Called when the action is pressed, before the close.

props.name: open
props.description: Flip to false to close from outside. True again re-enters.

props.name: on_close
props.description: Called after the exit, and after the inline slot has collapsed. Reason is timeout, swipe, action, close, escape or programmatic.

props.name: background
props.description: The card surface, and the action text.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink: title, description at 62% and the action fill.

props.name: fuse_color
props.description: The burning line.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in pixels, capped at the parent when inline.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels.

props.name: slide_ms
props.description: How long the rise and the drop take.

props.name: settle_bounce
props.description: Overshoot of the return after an abandoned swipe. 0 stops dead.

props.name: swipe_distance
props.description: How far a slow drag must go before release dismisses. A flick always does.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds until it closes itself. Changing it re-arms the fuse. 0 keeps it until dismissed.

props.name: fuse
props.description: Which edge the line burns along. None keeps the timer but shows nothing.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Hovering freezes the line and the timer.

props.name: close_button
props.description: Adds a cross at the end of the row.

props.name: inline
props.description: In flow inside the parent instead of fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Off removes the swipe and Escape.

props.title: File archived
props.description: Moved to Archive

name: TearTicket
description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand, fibre by fibre, and drops away.

props.name: stub
props.description: Content of the tear-off stub.

props.name: image
props.description: Artwork behind the body. It shifts against the tilt for parallax and turns grey once used.

props.name: image_alt
props.description: Alt text for the artwork.

props.name: scrim
props.description: A fade from the paper colour up over the artwork, so text stays readable on busy images.

props.name: image_radius
props.description: Corner radius of the artwork panel, in px. Set it to the ticket radius minus 8 to stay concentric.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal puts the stub on the right. Vertical puts the artwork on top and the stub at the bottom.

props.name: torn
props.description: Controlled state. Set it back to false to restore the stub.

props.name: default_torn
props.description: Start already used.

props.name: on_tear
props.description: Fires once the stub has come free and gone.

props.name: width
props.description: Ticket width in px. It scales down to fit a narrower parent.

props.name: height
props.description: Ticket height in px.

props.name: stub_size
props.description: Size of the stub along the ticket, in px: its width when horizontal, its height when vertical.

props.name: radius
props.description: Outer corner radius in px.

props.name: holes
props.description: Perforation holes along the tear line.

props.name: hole_size
props.description: Hole diameter in px.

props.name: notch
props.description: Radius of the notches at both ends of the tear line.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Optional jitter of the torn line between holes, in px. 0 keeps the edge perfectly straight and symmetrical.

props.name: tear_angle
props.description: Degrees of pull at which the last bridge gives way and the stub comes free.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far a paper bridge stretches before it snaps, in px. Bridges far from the hinge reach it first.

props.name: resistance
props.description: How much the intact fibres hold the stub back, 0 to 1. The pull eases as bridges give way, so the paper fights hardest at the start.

props.name: rotate
props.description: A resting tilt of the whole ticket in the page plane, in degrees.

props.name: tilt
props.description: The ticket leans toward the cursor in 3D.

props.name: tilt_max
props.description: Largest tilt angle in degrees.

props.name: tilt_reach
props.description: How far beyond the ticket the pointer still steers the tilt, in px. The tilt tracks the whole page.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How far the artwork travels against the tilt, in px.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Viewing distance in px.

props.name: background
props.description: Paper colour, also used by the fibres.

props.name: color
props.description: Text colour.

props.name: border
props.description: A hairline drawn along the cut edge of each piece, following every hole and notch.

props.name: border_color
props.description: Colour of that hairline. Empty derives a faint tint of the text colour.

props.name: border_width
props.description: Thickness of the hairline in px.

props.name: stub_background
props.description: Stub paper colour. Empty follows background.

props.name: recenter
props.description: Once the stub is gone, the remaining ticket glides over to sit centred in its original box.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed and inert.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the stub. Enter or Space tears it.

props.image_alt: Visitors in a walkway of coloured glass

name: ThoughtLine
description: Reasoning trace header with a live clock that folds its steps into one line when done.

props.name: label
props.description: The working line. It breathes, and it is the spoken text.

props.name: done_label
props.description: The settled line. Empty gives "Thought for", or "Done thinking" without the timer.

props.name: render_label
props.description: Wraps either string, for a sheen or a link. Inline content only.

props.name: glyph
props.description: The mark that breathes and dims.

props.name: steps
props.description: The trace beneath the line. Append as the agent progresses; the last step is current, earlier ones tick.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: The line becomes a toggle for the trace, with a chevron.

props.name: collapse_on_settle
props.description: Fold the trace into the line when it settles.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink of the line and the trace.

props.name: glyph_color
props.description: The glyph alone. Empty follows the ink.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Type size in px. Everything scales in em.

props.name: breath_period
props.description: One breath, up and down, in seconds.

props.name: breath_depth
props.description: How far the glyph and label dim at the trough. 0 is no breath.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: A band of ink sweeps the working label. The label then leaves the breath to the glyph.

props.name: shimmer_duration
props.description: One sweep, in seconds.

props.name: settle_duration
props.description: The settle chord, in ms: crossfade, dim, glide, fold.

props.name: settle_blur
props.description: Blur through the crossfade seam, in px.

props.name: working
props.description: Working or settled. True again starts a new clock.

props.name: settle_after
props.description: Seconds after which the line settles by itself. 0 waits for working.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Controlled seconds. The internal clock never runs.

props.name: show_timer
props.description: The live clock that freezes into the sentence.

props.name: on_settle
props.description: Once per settle, with the frozen time.

name: VoicePill
description: Mic button that swells into a capsule of live equalizer bars and a timer while recording.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: The waveform, the clock and the stop mark.

props.name: icon_color
props.description: The mic at rest, and the hover wash.

props.name: background
props.description: The capsule surface.

props.name: size
props.description: Footprint in px. The icon, the stop mark and the clock scale with it.

props.name: shape
props.description: A circle that opens into a capsule, or a rounded square.

props.name: reach
props.description: The room the capsule leaves before the waveform, in px.

props.name: show_time
props.description: An elapsed clock in the capsule, which grows to the left to hold it.

props.name: waveform
props.description: A history of the level scrolling through the capsule, past the clock.

props.name: slide_to_cancel
props.description: While held, sliding left drags the capsule contents along and reveals Cancel. Crossing the distance scatters the bars and stops without a result.

props.name: cancel_distance
props.description: How far left a held pointer slides before it cancels, in px.

props.name: attack
props.description: How fast the level rises to a louder signal, in ms.

props.name: release
props.description: How long the level hangs after the sound drops, in ms.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Gain on the signal before the envelope.

props.name: floor
props.description: Waveform bar height when silent, as a fraction of its box.

props.name: open_duration
props.description: The capsule open and close, in ms.

props.name: press_scale
props.description: Scale of the button while a pointer is down.

props.name: mode
props.description: Auto: a tap latches, a hold stops on release. Hold: release always stops. Toggle: release never stops.

props.name: hold_after
props.description: In auto, the press length after which a release stops instead of latching, in ms.

props.name: reactive
props.description: What drives the level. Mic asks for microphone permission on the first press and stops if it is refused.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed and inert. A listening pill stops.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name. The state is carried by aria-pressed.

props.name: on_start
props.description: Listening began, with the requested source.

props.name: on_stop
props.description: Listening ended. Reason is release, tap, key, escape, blur, cancel, disabled, mic-denied or unmount; duration in ms.

name: WakeSlider
description: Thumbless range slider of thin bars where drag speed raises a wake behind the handle.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every committed change, from the pointer or the keyboard.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value.

props.name: step
props.description: Snapping grid. Large steps move the handle in notches, and the wake pulses per notch.

props.name: bars
props.description: How many bars draw the track.

props.name: height
props.description: Full bar height in pixels, the ceiling of the wake.

props.name: rest_height
props.description: Bar height at rest in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between bars in pixels.

props.name: fill_color
props.description: Lit bars, up to the value.

props.name: track_color
props.description: Unlit bars.

props.name: crest_color
props.description: Optional tint the raised bars take on by their lift. Empty renders no tint layer.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: How easily speed raises the wake. Low needs a flick; high lifts it on a stroll.

props.name: reach
props.description: Half-width of the wake at full speed, in bars.

props.name: skew
props.description: How much wider the wake is behind the handle than ahead. 0 is symmetric.

props.name: glide
props.description: Seconds the handle takes to settle. Short hugs the finger; long floats behind it.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Milliseconds of velocity lag. Low twitches with every change of speed; high lingers.

props.name: show_value
props.description: Shows the value beside the track.

props.name: format_value
props.description: Formats the readout and the announced value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the slider and ignores input.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the slider.

name: WarmTooltip
description: Tooltip group where the first label waits, then its siblings open instantly while warm.

props.name: content
props.description: The label. Keep it to a few words.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Optional keyboard shortcut, drawn as a keycap beside the label.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge the label hangs from; also where the fuse runs and the pop originates.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a cold open waits, in milliseconds. Inherits the group value when omitted.

props.name: warm_window
props.description: How long after this label closes the group stays warm. Inherits the group value when omitted.

props.name: surface_color
props.description: Label background, arrow and fuse.

props.name: ink_color
props.description: Label text; the keycap is tinted from it.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding of the label.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the label in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between the trigger edge and the label.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows the pointer on the anchored edge.

props.name: pop_duration
props.description: Cold pop-in time in milliseconds; the exit takes 0.8 of it.

props.name: pop_scale
props.description: Scale the label pops from. 1 makes it a fade.

props.name: pop_blur
props.description: Blur in pixels the label arrives through.

props.name: show_fuse
props.description: Draws a thin line along the trigger edge that fills over the delay, or over the long press on touch.

props.name: long_press
props.description: Hold time in milliseconds that opens the label on touch; the click that follows is swallowed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No open path; an open label closes.

name: WarmTooltip
description: Groups WarmTooltips so moving between them skips the open delay.

props.name: delay
props.description: Open delay in ms.

props.name: warm_window
props.description: How long (ms) the group stays warm.
